<ResourceDictionary
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" 
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI" 
    xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
    xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
    mc:Ignorable="d">

    <System:Double x:Key="ModelSelectPanelHeight">458</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="ModelSelectItemHeight">138</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="ModelSelectItemWidth">236</System:Double>

    <local:DriveTrainConverter x:Key="ModelSelectDriveTrainConverter"/>
    <local:LinearTransformConverter x:Key="ModelSelectScaleUp" Scale="23"/>

    <!-- #################### Text Block Styles #################### -->
    <Style x:Key="EventInfoTitleTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="24"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="DescriptionTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="24"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
    </Style>
        
    <Style x:Key="EventInfoLabelTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource MidLightGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="16"/>
    </Style>
        
    <Style x:Key="EventInfoDataTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15,0"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
    </Style>
        
    <Style x:Key="EventInfoDescriptionTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15,0,15,15"/>
        <Setter Property="FontStretch" Value="Normal"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="LineHeight" Value="26"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="EventInfoCreditsTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="30"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15,0"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="SubmenuSceneTitleStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground">
            <Setter.Value>
                <SolidColorBrush Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlackColor}"/>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="StatTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="16"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,8"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Right"/>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ProfilePlayerCardGamerTagTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="22"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ProfilePlayerCardGamerTitleLevelTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectPriceNumberStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="22"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <!-- In FM5 this trigger was checking the 'IsDiscounted' property -->
        <!--<Style.Triggers>     
            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                <Trigger.Value>
                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                </Trigger.Value>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaBlueBrush}"/>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                <Trigger.Value>
                    <System:Boolean>False</System:Boolean>
                </Trigger.Value>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            </Trigger>       
        </Style.Triggers>-->
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectRentedBoxTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="4,0"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground">
            <Setter.Value>
                <SolidColorBrush Color="#FFB785FF"/>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectRecommendedBoxTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource ModelSelectRentedBoxTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="4,0"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
    </Style>

    <!-- #################### Other Styles #################### -->
    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectImage_FZMaterialStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:FZMaterial}">
        <Style.Triggers>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Installed}" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Installed}" Value="False">
                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                <Setter Property="Preset" Value="{StaticResource Normal_FZMaterialPresetAdditive}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>
      
    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectOpacityImageStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Image}">
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                <Trigger.Value>
                    <System:Boolean>False</System:Boolean>
                </Trigger.Value>
                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value=".6"/>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectItemBgPathStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Path}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource ModelSelectItemWidth}"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="{StaticResource ModelSelectItemHeight}"/>
        <Setter Property="Data">
            <Setter.Value>
                <PathGeometry>
                   <PathFigure StartPoint="0,0">
                       <LineSegment Point="100,0"/>
                       <LineSegment Point="200,0"/>
                       <LineSegment Point="200,200"/>
                       <LineSegment Point="0,200"/>
                   </PathFigure>
                </PathGeometry>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="ModelSelectModelItemBgPathStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource ModelSelectItemBgPathStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Path}">
        <Style.Resources>
            <Storyboard x:Key="SelectedGroupStoryboard">
                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)">
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="{DynamicResource ListItemBackgroundColor}"/>
                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard>
            <Storyboard x:Key="UnselectedGroupStoryboard">
                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)">
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="{DynamicResource MidLightGray80Color}"/>
                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard>
        </Style.Resources>
        <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{DynamicResource ListItemBackgroundBrush}"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                <Trigger.Value>
                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                </Trigger.Value>
                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="SelectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectedGroupStoryboard}"/>
                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="SelectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard"/>
                </Trigger.ExitActions>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                <Trigger.Value>
                    <System:Boolean>False</System:Boolean>
                </Trigger.Value>
                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="UnselectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource UnselectedGroupStoryboard}"/>
                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="UnselectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard"/>
                </Trigger.ExitActions>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers> 
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="GrayDotStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
        <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{DynamicResource LightGray60Brush}"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="8"/>
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="8"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
            <Setter.Value>
                <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform/>                
                </TransformGroup>            
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="MenuHeaderDecorationsStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="IsHitTestVisible" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="458"/>
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="912"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="DecorationsTransitionIn">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.2"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.2"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconImage">
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.0"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.15" Value="0"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Clip).(PathGeometry.Figures)[0].(PathFigure.Segments)[0].(LineSegment.Point)" Storyboard.TargetName="DotGrid">
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-23,-27.5"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="-23,-27.5"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="367,-27.5"/>
                            </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Clip).(PathGeometry.Figures)[0].(PathFigure.Segments)[1].(LineSegment.Point)" Storyboard.TargetName="DotGrid">
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-23,117"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="-23,117"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="367,117"/>
                            </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="DarkGrayDot">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="GrayDot1">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="GrayDot3">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.6" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="VerticalRuler">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0.001"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="HorizontalRuler">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0.001"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="DecorationsUnfoldStory">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.2"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.2"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconImage">
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.0"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.15" Value="0"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Clip).(PathGeometry.Figures)[0].(PathFigure.Segments)[0].(LineSegment.Point)" Storyboard.TargetName="DotGrid">
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-23,-27.5"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.6" Value="-23,-27.5"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.2" Value="367,-27.5"/>
                            </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Clip).(PathGeometry.Figures)[0].(PathFigure.Segments)[1].(LineSegment.Point)" Storyboard.TargetName="DotGrid">
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-23,117"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.6" Value="-23,117"/>
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.2" Value="367,117"/>
                            </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="DarkGrayDot">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="GrayDot1">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.4" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="GrayDot3">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="VerticalRuler">
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0.001"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.1" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="HorizontalRuler">
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0.001"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.9" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.3,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="DecorationsTransitionOut">
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="GrayDot1">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="GrayDot3">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0.2"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0.2"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IconImage">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="1"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Clip).(PathGeometry.Figures)[0].(PathFigure.Segments)[0].(LineSegment.Point)" Storyboard.TargetName="DotGrid">
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="-18,-27.5"/>
                            </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Clip).(PathGeometry.Figures)[0].(PathFigure.Segments)[1].(LineSegment.Point)" Storyboard.TargetName="DotGrid">
                                <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="-18,117"/>
                            </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="DarkGrayDot">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="VerticalRuler">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0.001"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Canvas Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}">
                        
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HTransitionIn_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource DecorationsTransitionIn}"/>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="Unfold_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource DecorationsUnfoldStory}"/>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HTransitionOut_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource DecorationsTransitionOut}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <Path x:Name="VerticalRuler" Canvas.Left="227" Style="{StaticResource SmallPillRulerVerticalPathStyle}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <Path.RenderTransform>
                                <TransformGroup>
                                    <ScaleTransform ScaleY="0.001"/>
                                    <SkewTransform/>
                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                    <TranslateTransform/>
                                </TransformGroup>
                            </Path.RenderTransform>
                        </Path>                            
                        <Canvas x:Name="HorizontalRulerContainer" Canvas.Left="261" Canvas.Top="340" Height="10" Width="700" ClipToBounds="True">
                            <Path x:Name="HorizontalRuler" Canvas.Top="2" Canvas.Left="1" Style="{StaticResource SmallPillRulerHorizontalPathStyle}" RenderTransformOrigin="0,1">
                                <Path.RenderTransform>

    <Style x:Key="VerticalMenuButtonStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Button}">
        <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="True"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="35"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,4"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0,0"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
            <Setter.Value>
               <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform/>
                </TransformGroup>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Button}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="SubtitleTransitionIn">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.1"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemTitle">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemTitle">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="50"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContainer">
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="SubtitleTransitionOut">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemTitle">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="1"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0.001" KeySpline="0,0,0.3,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStoryboard" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusGlow">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="0.15" KeySpline="0.5,0,1,1"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.5,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid x:Name="ItemContainer" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Background="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}" RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5">
                        <Grid.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Grid.RenderTransform>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="MouseOver"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Pressed">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Panel.Background).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContainer">
                                            <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                                        </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusBg">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                <VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                    <VisualTransition GeneratedDuration="0:0:0.1"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Focused">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemTitle">
                                            <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                                        </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Focus">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionIn_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource SubtitleTransitionIn}"/>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionOut_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource SubtitleTransitionOut}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Focus" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Opacity="0" ><!-- default Opacity="0" -->
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusBg" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaDarkBlueBrush}"/>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusGlow" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="ItemTitle" Text="{TemplateBinding Content}" Style="{StaticResource SubmenuSceneTitleStyle}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <TextBlock.RenderTransform>
                                <TransformGroup>
                                    <ScaleTransform/>
                                    <SkewTransform/>
                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                    <TranslateTransform/>
                                </TransformGroup>
                            </TextBlock.RenderTransform>
                        </TextBlock>
                    </Grid>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Keyboard.GotKeyboardFocus">
                            <BeginStoryboard x:Name="FocusGlowStoryboard_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStoryboard}"/>
                        </EventTrigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>

                <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
            </DataTrigger>
        </DataTemplate.Triggers>
    </DataTemplate><!-- /AllCarsItemTemplate -->
    
    <DataTemplate x:Key="RentCarItemTemplate">
        <DataTemplate.Resources>
            <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory">

        <DataTemplate.Triggers>

                <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                    <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource DeselectItemStory}"/>

<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
                    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
                    xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
                    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
                    xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
                    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
                    mc:Ignorable="d">
    
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogAreaLeftMargin">@E:158:S:0@</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogAreaTopMargin">74</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogAreaWidth">1604</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogAreaHeight">896</System:Double>
    
    <System:Double x:Key="HeroDialogHeight">750</System:Double>
    
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogMinWidth">700</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogMidWidth">786</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogMaxWidth">1004</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogMaxHeight">888</System:Double>
    <System:Double x:Key="DialogSpinnerWidth">820</System:Double>
    
    
    <!-- This generic style can be the base for dialog boxes, whether they're a StackPanel, Grid, or other descendant of Panel. So we have consistent margins, etc. -->
    <Style x:Key="DialogMessagePanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Panel}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,36"/>
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource DialogMinWidth}"/>
        <Setter Property="MaxHeight" Value="{StaticResource DialogMaxHeight}"/>
        <Setter Property="MaxWidth" Value="{StaticResource DialogMaxWidth}"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="MarketplaceDialogMessagePanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Panel}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,36"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="DialogTitleStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="46"/>
        <Setter Property="LineHeight" Value="40"/>
        <Setter Property="LineStackingStrategy" Value="BlockLineHeight"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="30,30,30,0"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
            <Setter.Value>
               <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform/>
                </TransformGroup>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="OuterGlowDialogTitleStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource DialogTitleStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostWhite30Brush}"/>
        <Setter Property="Effect">
            <Setter.Value>
                <BlurEffect Radius="10"/>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="DialogTutorialTitleStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="46"/>
        <Setter Property="LineHeight" Value="42"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        <Setter Property="LineStackingStrategy" Value="BlockLineHeight"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="DialogMessageLightTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource MidLightGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="LineHeight" Value="24"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="30,15,30,15"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
        <Setter Property="Effect" Value="{DynamicResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="WaitDialogMessageLightTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource DialogMessageLightTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Grid.Column" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="-10,15,30,15"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="DialogVerticalMenuTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="Effect" Value="{DynamicResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="DialogVerticalMenuListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
        <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStoryboard"/>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory"/>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory"/>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid x:Name="Container" Height="34" Margin="0,1,0,0">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="29"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" MinWidth="5"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="MouseOver"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="SelectionStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Unselected"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Selected"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="SelectedUnfocused"/>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Focused">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ParallelTimeline RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Content">
                                                <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}"/>
                                                <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                                <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </ParallelTimeline>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_GlassBg" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack20Brush}"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Content" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding}" Style="{StaticResource DialogVerticalMenuTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Reticle" Grid.ColumnSpan="3">
                            <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_FocusReticle" Style="{StaticResource OptFocusReticleContentControlStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="False">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Rectangle_GlassBg"/>
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Grid_Reticle"/>
                        </Trigger>
                        <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True">
                            <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="SelectItemStory_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                            </Trigger.EnterActions>
                            <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="SelectItemStory_BeginStoryboard"/>
                            </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                        </Trigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style><!-- /DialogVerticalMenuListBoxItemStyle -->
    
    <Style x:Key="HelpTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource MidLightGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="10"/>
    </Style>
        
    <Style x:Key="DialogBodyTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource DarkestGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="LightDialogBodyTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15"/>
        <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        <Setter Property="MaxWidth" Value="820"/>
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="DialogHeaderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="100"/>
        <Setter Property="MaxWidth" Value="{StaticResource DialogMaxWidth}"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="TitleContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="TitleContainer">
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-180"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="-180"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0.7,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="TitleContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid x:Name="TitleContainer" MaxWidth="{TemplateBinding MaxWidth}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                        <Grid.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Grid.RenderTransform>
                        <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding Content}" Style="{StaticResource DialogTitleStyle}"/>
                        <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionIn_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionIn}"/>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionOut_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionOut}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <!-- end remote event -->
                    </Grid>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style><!-- /DialogHeaderStyle -->

    <!-- To be used where dialog width is less than default minimum (i.e., DialogMinWidth) -->
    <Style x:Key="DialogHeaderNarrowStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource DialogHeaderStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="OuterContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="TitleContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="TitleContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="144"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="144"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>

                        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="OuterContainer">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="OuterContainer" MaxWidth="{StaticResource DialogMaxWidth}" Opacity="0">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                           <RowDefinition Height="10"/>
                           <RowDefinition MinHeight="83"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                        <Grid x:Name="TitleContainer" Grid.Row="1" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <Grid.RenderTransform>
                                <TransformGroup>
                                    <ScaleTransform/>
                                    <SkewTransform/>
                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                    <TranslateTransform/>
                                </TransformGroup>
                            </Grid.RenderTransform>
                            <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding Content}" Style="{StaticResource DialogTitleStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>

                        <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionIn_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionIn}"/>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionOut_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionOut}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <!-- end remote event -->
                    </Grid>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="LoadSaveWaitTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HelpTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource MidLightGrayBrush}"/>
        <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Right"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Right"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="10,10,30,10"/>
        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/><!-- Hiding these globally -->
    </Style>

    <Style x:Key="SpinnyProgressStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="42"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="42"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="Spin" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[2].(RotateTransform.Angle)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Out">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.133" Value="360"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Determinate"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Indeterminate">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Track">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Indicator">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="Idle_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource Spin}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <Border x:Name="PART_Track"/>
                        <Border x:Name="PART_Indicator"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Out" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <Grid.RenderTransform>
                                <TransformGroup>
                                    <ScaleTransform/>
                                    <SkewTransform/>
                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                    <TranslateTransform/>
                                </TransformGroup>
                            </Grid.RenderTransform>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="Image_OuterRing" ImageSource="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/LoadingSpinner_Lg.png"
                                Preset="{StaticResource Normal_FZMaterialPresetAdditive}" Opacity=".75" Stretch="Uniform"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                            <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource Spin}"/>
                        </EventTrigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="DarkSpinnyProgressStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="42"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="42"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="Spin" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[2].(RotateTransform.Angle)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Out">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.133" Value="360"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Determinate"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Indeterminate">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Track">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Indicator">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>

                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>

                        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>

                        <Border x:Name="PART_Track"/>

                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Out" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <Grid.RenderTransform>
                                <TransformGroup>
                                    <ScaleTransform/>
                                    <SkewTransform/>
                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                    <TranslateTransform/>
                                </TransformGroup>
                            </Grid.RenderTransform>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="Image_OuterRing" ImageSource="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/LoadingSpinnerDark_Lg.png"

                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                            <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource Spin}"/>
                        </EventTrigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="MiniSpinnyProgressStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="32"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="32"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="Spin" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[2].(RotateTransform.Angle)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Out">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.133" Value="360"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Determinate"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Indeterminate">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Track">

                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

                        </Storyboard>
                        
                        <Storyboard x:Key="HideTransitionStory">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter_PanelHeader">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>

                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_PanelHeaderContainer" Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack70Brush}">
                        <Grid.RenderTransform>

                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>

                        <ContentPresenter x:Name="ContentPresenter_PanelHeader">

                                    <TranslateTransform/>

                            </ContentPresenter.RenderTransform>

                        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_HeaderUnderline" Style="{StaticResource ForzavistaHeaderUnderlineStyle}"/>

                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>

                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HideTransitionStory_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideTransitionStory}"/>

    </Style><!-- /ForzavistaPanelHeaderStyle -->

    <Style x:Key="ForzavistaPanelBodyStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">

                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter_PanelBody">

                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_PanelBodyContainer" Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack40Brush}">

                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>

                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- content -->
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource GridLength_FVPanelRightMargin}"/><!-- right margin -->

                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>

                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
