<ResourceDictionary
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
    xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
    xmlns:ed="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/2010/drawing"
    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
    mc:Ignorable="d">
    
    <!-- #################### Global Default Control Styles #################### -->
    
    <!-- Style used for large panel-style buttons (e.g., used in main menu) -->
    <Style x:Key="NavPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Button}">
        <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="True"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
        <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
            <Setter.Value>
                <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform X="1900"/>
                </TransformGroup>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Button}">
                    <Grid>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="MouseOver">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="DefaultBackground">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="FocusedBackground">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Pressed">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="FocusedBackground">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="DefaultBackground">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="DefaultBackground">
                                            <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhite80Color}"/>
                                        </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FocusedBackground">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                <VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                    <VisualTransition GeneratedDuration="0:0:0.2">
                                        <VisualTransition.GeneratedEasingFunction>
                                            <QuadraticEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/>
                                        </VisualTransition.GeneratedEasingFunction>
                                    </VisualTransition>
                                </VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="Focused">
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="DefaultBackground">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="FocusedBackground">
                                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="DefaultBackground">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FocusedBackground">
                                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </VisualState>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                        <Rectangle x:Name="DefaultBackground">
                            <Rectangle.Fill>
                                <SolidColorBrush Color="{StaticResource MidLightGray70Color}"/>
                            </Rectangle.Fill>
                        </Rectangle>
                        <Rectangle x:Name="FocusedBackground" Fill="{StaticResource RedHighlightBrush}" Visibility="Visible" Opacity="0"/>
                        <ContentPresenter/>
                    </Grid>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="ListFixedFocusGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="186"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="186"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,28"/>
        <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>
    </Style><!-- /ListFixedFocusGridStyle -->
    
    <Style x:Key="FixedFocusReticleControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="FocusedStoryboard">
                             <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_AmbientFocus">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value=".0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value=".0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.0" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="Ambient_Focus" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_NineGlow">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMin}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMax}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMin}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow3KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMax}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow4KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMin}"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </ParallelTimeline><!-- /Ambient_Focus -->
                            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="AmbientFocusGlowStoryboard" Duration="0:0:5.0" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Stroke).(LinearGradientBrush.StartPoint)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_AmbientSweep">
                                    <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-0.5,-0.25"/>
                                    <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3" Value="1,0.25"/>
                                </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Stroke).(LinearGradientBrush.EndPoint)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_AmbientSweep">
                                    <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0,0"/>
                                    <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3" Value="1.5,0.25"/>
                                </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </ParallelTimeline>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_AmbientFocus" Opacity="0">
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_NineGlow" Style="{StaticResource ButtonFocusFrameNineGridStyle}" Visibility="Visible">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_AmbientStroke" Grid.RowSpan="3" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" StrokeThickness="{StaticResource FocusFrameThickness}" Stroke="{StaticResource AlmostWhite50Brush}"/>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_AmbientSweep" Grid.RowSpan="3" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" StrokeThickness="{StaticResource FocusFrameThickness}" >
                                    <Rectangle.Stroke>
                                        <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="-0.5,-0.5" EndPoint="0,0">
                                            <GradientStop Offset="0"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="#FDFFFFFF" Offset="0.5"/>
                                            <GradientStop Offset="1"/>
                                        </LinearGradientBrush>
                                    </Rectangle.Stroke>
                                </Rectangle>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Nine" Style="{StaticResource ButtonFocusFrameNineGridStyle}" Visibility="Visible">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameTOP" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameTOP_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameBOT" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameBOT_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameLFT" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameLFT_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameRHT" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameRHT_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="FocusedStoryboard_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusedStoryboard}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <!-- end remote event -->
                    </Grid>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style><!-- FixedFocusReticleControlStyle -->

    <Style x:Key="FixedFocusReticleControlNascarStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="FocusedStoryboard">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_AmbientFocus">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value=".0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value=".0"/>
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.0" Value="1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="Ambient_Focus" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_NineGlow">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMin}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMax}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMin}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow3KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusGlowOpacityMax}"/>

                            </ParallelTimeline>

                                <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Stroke).(LinearGradientBrush.StartPoint)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_AmbientSweep">
                                    <EasingPointKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-0.5,-0.25"/>

                                </PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <PointAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Stroke).(LinearGradientBrush.EndPoint)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_AmbientSweep">

                    <Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_AmbientFocus" Opacity="0">
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_NineGlow" Style="{StaticResource ButtonFocusFrameNineGridStyle}" Visibility="Visible">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_AmbientStroke" Grid.RowSpan="3" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" StrokeThickness="{StaticResource FocusFrameThickness}" Stroke="{StaticResource AlmostWhite50Brush}"/>

                                    <Rectangle.Stroke>
                                        <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="-0.5,-0.5" EndPoint="0,0">
                                            <GradientStop Offset="0"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="#FDFFFFFF" Offset="0.5"/>
                                            <GradientStop Offset="1"/>
                                        </LinearGradientBrush>
                                    </Rectangle.Stroke>
                                </Rectangle>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Nine" Style="{StaticResource ButtonFocusFrameNineGridStyle}" Visibility="Visible">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource FocusFrameThicknessGridLength}"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameTOP" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameTOP_FZMaterialStyle}" Color="{StaticResource ForzaNascarColor}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameBOT" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameBOT_FZMaterialStyle}" Color="{StaticResource ForzaNascarColor}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameLFT" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameLFT_FZMaterialStyle}" Color="{StaticResource ForzaNascarColor}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_FocusFrameRHT" Style="{StaticResource FocusFrameRHT_FZMaterialStyle}" Color="{StaticResource ForzaNascarColor}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                        <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="FocusedStoryboard_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusedStoryboard}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                        <!-- end remote event -->
                    </Grid>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    <!-- FixedFocusReticleControlNascarStyle -->

    <Style x:Key="LeftSelectorArrowStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="16"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="30"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="MoveStory">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Arrow">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="-15" KeySpline="0.3,0,1,1"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Path x:Name="Arrow" Data="M380.625,396L363,421.065L380.625,446.131" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" 
                        Margin="0" Style="{StaticResource LightRoundedPathStyle}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                        <Path.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Path.RenderTransform>
                        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                            </VisualStateGroup>
                        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                    </Path>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                            <Setter Property="Opacity" TargetName="Arrow" Value=".4"/>
                        </Trigger>
                        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:EventFire.FzEvent">
                            <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource MoveStory}"/>
                        </EventTrigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="RightSelectorArrowStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource LeftSelectorArrowStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
        <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                    <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Storyboard x:Key="MoveStory">
                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Arrow">
                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="0"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="15" KeySpline="0.3,0,1,1"/>
                                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        </Storyboard>
                    </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                    <Path x:Name="Arrow" Data="M297.1875,295.1807L314.8115,320.2457L297.1875,345.3117" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" 
                        Margin="0" Style="{StaticResource LightRoundedPathStyle}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                        <Path.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Path.RenderTransform>
                    </Path>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">

                            <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionOut_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionOut}"/>
                        </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>

        </Setter>

    <Style x:Key="CarSelectPerformanceStatsGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">

    <Style x:Key="ItemSelectorVSPGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">

    <Style x:Key="ItemSelectorFocusGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">

        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorListMargin}"/>

    <Style x:Key="VertItemSelectorVSPGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">

    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="VertItemSelectorFocusGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource VerticalSelectorItemWidth}"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="{StaticResource VerticalSelectorItemHeight}"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="{StaticResource VerticalSelectorListMargin}"/>
        <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
    </Style>
    
    <!-- Nine Grids -->
    <Style x:Key="ButtonFocusFrameNineGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="-5"/><!-- -7, 0 -->
        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="OptFocusFrameNineGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
    </Style>
    
    <Style x:Key="FullScreenZPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:ZPanel}">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}"/>
        <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>

    <Style x:Key="ForzavistaZPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:ZPanel}">

    </Style>
</ResourceDictionary>

<Page x:Name="Page"

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText_Chinese">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="90"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="90"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.933" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText_Chinese">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="90"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="90"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.933" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.933" Value="1"/>

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Stripe">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-2147"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.933" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Stripe">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.1"/>

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Canvas_VisibilityRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="OpaqueTransitionIn">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="startAmbientEvent"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="ButtonGlowEvent"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_HelpButtonAlignment">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.6" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.767" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText">
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="90"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText_Chinese">
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="90"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText_Chinese">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_Bg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Canvas_VisibilityRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_GradientBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /OpaqueTransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="WaitForSignIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleIndicator">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleEventFireSpin">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Idle_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HelpButton">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /WaitForSignIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="FailedSignIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleIndicator">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleEventFireHideSpin">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Idle_Stop"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HelpButton">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /FailedSignIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_ButtonA">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0.25"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_HelpButtonAlignment">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_Bg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForzaText_Chinese">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Stripe">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="1698"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="Ambient_Storyboard" RepeatBehavior="Forever" Duration="0:0:9"/><!-- /Ambient_Storyboard -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="Storyboard_ButtonGlow" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_ButtonGlow">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.500"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.800" Value="1.00"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="0.500" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /Storyboard_ButtonGlow -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
        <!-- Fired by Code Behind -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="IdleEventFireSetup" Storyboard="{StaticResource WaitForSignIn}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="IdleEventFireHideSetup" Storyboard="{StaticResource FailedSignIn}"/>
        <!-- Fired by Storyboards -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="startAmbientEvent" Storyboard="{StaticResource Ambient_Storyboard}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ButtonGlowEvent" Storyboard="{StaticResource Storyboard_ButtonGlow}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}" Opacity="1" Background="Black">
        <Canvas Canvas.Left="@S@" x:Name="Canvas_VisibilityRoot" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" Opacity="0.0">
            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_BlackBg" Fill="Black" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}"/>
            <Image x:Name="Image_GradientBg" Source="/Textures/Backgrounds/Bg_Start_NoStripes.png" Opacity="0.0"/>
            <Image x:Name="Image_Bg" Source="/Textures/Backgrounds/Bg_Start_FM5.png" Opacity="0.0"/>

            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" FlowDirection="LeftToRight">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="362"/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="223"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <Image x:Name="Image_LogoForzaText" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Logo_FM_Splash.png" Grid.Column="1" Width="512" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Top" 
                    Margin="-1,354,0,0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Visibility="{Binding IsSystemRegionChina, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}, FallbackValue=Visible}"><!--  Clip="M3E-13,91 L313,91 313,197 1E-13,197 z" -->
                    <Image.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Image.RenderTransform>
                </Image>
                <Image x:Name="Image_LogoForzaText_Chinese" Source="/Textures/Localized/CHS/Logo_FM_Horizontal.png" Grid.Column="1" Width="512" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Top" 
                    Margin="-1,524,0,0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Visibility="{Binding IsSystemRegionChina, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}, FallbackValue=Collapsed}"><!--  Clip="M3E-13,91 L313,91 313,197 1E-13,197 z" -->
                    <Image.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Image.RenderTransform>
                </Image>
                
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_HelpButtonAlignment" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="0,-72,0,0">
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_HelpButton" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Press" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Press}" Style="{StaticResource HelpTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="18" Margin="0,0,6,0" Visibility="Collapsed">
                            <TextBlock.Foreground>
                                <SolidColorBrush Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                            </TextBlock.Foreground>
                        </TextBlock>
                        <Grid Height="32" Width="32">
                            <Image x:Name="Image_ButtonGlow" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_Glow_Lg.png" Margin="-20"/>
                            <Image x:Name="Image_ButtonA" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_A.png"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ToStart" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_To_Start}" Style="{StaticResource HelpTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="18" Margin="6,0,0,0">
                            <TextBlock.Foreground>
                                <SolidColorBrush Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                            </TextBlock.Foreground>
                        </TextBlock>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Stripe" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Height="1" Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,0,0,49" RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Width="1920" Opacity="0">
                    <Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                </Rectangle>
            </Grid>
        
           <ProgressBar x:Name="IdleIndicator" Canvas.Right="95" Canvas.Bottom="52" IsIndeterminate="True" Style="{StaticResource SpinnyProgressStyle}" Opacity="0"/>
        </Canvas>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="IdleEventFireSpin" TargetName="IdleIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="IdleEventFireHideSpin" TargetName="IdleIndicator"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page
	xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
	xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
	x:Class="ForzaUI.F001_DemoWatermark"
	x:Name="Page"
	WindowTitle="Page"
	FlowDirection="LeftToRight"
	Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}"
	WindowWidth="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" WindowHeight="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}"
	Title="DemoWatermark"
    DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}" >

    <Page.Resources>        
    	<Style x:Key="CodeStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
    		<Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource ForzaBlue50Brush}"/>
    		<Setter Property="Width" Value="1"/>
    		<Setter Property="Margin" Value="1,0,4,0"/>
    		<Setter Property="Height" Value="40"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
    	</Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CodeStyle0" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
        	<Setter Property="Width" Value="4"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="20"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource MidGray30Brush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource ForzaBlue60Brush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3,0,4,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
            	<Setter.Value>
            		<ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            			<Grid>
            				<Grid.RowDefinitions>
            					<RowDefinition Height="1*"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="1*"/>           				
            				</Grid.RowDefinitions>
            				<Rectangle Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
                            <Rectangle Grid.Row="1" Fill="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>
                		</Grid>
                	</ControlTemplate>            	
            	</Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CodeStyle1" BasedOn="{StaticResource CodeStyle0}" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
            	<Setter.Value>
            		<ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            			<Grid Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
                	</ControlTemplate>            	
            	</Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CodeStyle2" BasedOn="{StaticResource CodeStyle0}" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
            	<Setter.Value>
            		<ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            			<Grid>
            				<Grid.RowDefinitions>
            					<RowDefinition Height="1*"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="1*"/>           				
            				</Grid.RowDefinitions>
            				<Rectangle Fill="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>
                            <Rectangle Grid.Row="1" Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
                		</Grid>
                	</ControlTemplate>            	
            	</Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CodeStyle3" BasedOn="{StaticResource CodeStyle0}" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
            	<Setter.Value>
            		<ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            			<Grid Background="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>
                	</ControlTemplate>            	
            	</Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="MessageTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,4"/>
            <Setter Property="Effect">
            	<Setter.Value>
            		<DropShadowEffect Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlackColor}" BlurRadius="0" ShadowDepth="2"/>            	
            	</Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>      
    </Page.Resources>
    
	<Grid x:Name="LayoutRoot" Opacity="0" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}">
		<VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
			<VisualStateGroup x:Name="VisualStateGroup">
				<VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
					<VisualTransition GeneratedDuration="0:0:0.2"/>
				</VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
				<VisualState x:Name="Active">
					<Storyboard>
						<DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
							<EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
						</DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
					</Storyboard>
				</VisualState>
				<VisualState x:Name="NotActive">
					<Storyboard>
						<DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
							<EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
						</DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
					</Storyboard>
				</VisualState>
			</VisualStateGroup>
		</VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
        
        <StackPanel Margin="0,27,48,0" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Right">

<Page x:Name="Page" 
      x:Class="ForzaUI.Scenes.WPF.F002_DemoSplash"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="startAmbientEvent"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="ButtonGlowEvent"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HelpButton">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForza">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="200"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="200"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForza">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_Divider">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-350"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_Divider">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_GradientBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--E3 Demo Hide video buffer ugliness on video load with a fade in for the video.-->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Video">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.75" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:2.0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="OpaqueTransitionIn">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="startAmbientEvent"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="ButtonGlowEvent"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HelpButton">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForza">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /OpaqueTransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ShowVideoStory">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HideVideo_Background">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.75" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HideVideo_Image_LogoForza">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.75" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ShowVideoStory -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="WaitForSignIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleIndicator">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleEventFireSpin">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Idle_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HelpButton">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /WaitForSignIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="FailedSignIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleIndicator">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleEventFireHideSpin">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Idle_Stop"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HelpButton">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /FailedSignIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_ButtonA">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForza">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Alignment">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.067" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_Divider">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="-1050"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_GradientBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="Ambient_Storyboard" RepeatBehavior="Forever" Duration="0:0:9"/><!-- /Ambient_Storyboard -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="Storyboard_ButtonGlow" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_ButtonGlow">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.500"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.800" Value="1.00"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="0.500" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /Storyboard_ButtonGlow -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
        <!-- Fired by Code Behind -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="IdleEventFireSetup" Storyboard="{StaticResource WaitForSignIn}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="IdleEventFireHideSetup" Storyboard="{StaticResource FailedSignIn}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ShowVideoEventFire" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowVideoStory}"/>
        <!-- Fired by Storyboards -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="startAmbientEvent" Storyboard="{StaticResource Ambient_Storyboard}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ButtonGlowEvent" Storyboard="{StaticResource Storyboard_ButtonGlow}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        
        <!--E3 Demo Hide video buffer ugliness on video load with a fade in for the video.-->
        <MediaElement x:Name="Video" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Opacity="0"/>
        
        <Grid Canvas.Left="@S@" x:Name="Grid_Body" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="160"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="100"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_GradientBg" Grid.ColumnSpan="2" Grid.RowSpan="2" Style="{StaticResource BottomLeftGradientContentControlStyle}"/>
            <Image x:Name="Image_LogoForza" Grid.Column="1" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Logo_FM_Horizontal.png" Width="580" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" 
                Margin="50,0,0,23" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                <Image.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Image.RenderTransform>
            </Image>
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Divider" Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalEtchContentControlStyle}"/>
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Alignment" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="50,28,0,0">
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_HelpButton" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center" Visibility="{Binding IsAutoSignInActive, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Press" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Press}" Style="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="27" Margin="0,0,20,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
                    <Grid Height="46" Width="46">
                        <local:FZMaterial x:Name="Image_ButtonGlow" ImageSource="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_GlowBlue_Lg.png" Margin="-25"
                            Preset="{StaticResource Normal_FZMaterialPresetAdditive}"/>
                        <Ellipse Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack20Brush}" Margin="2"/>
                        <Image x:Name="Image_ButtonA" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_A_Lg.png"/>
                        
                    </Grid>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ToStart" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_To_Start}" Style="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="27" Margin="20,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid Canvas.Left="@S@" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}">
        	<Rectangle  x:Name="HideVideo_Background" Fill="Black" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Opacity="1" />
            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="HideVideo_Image_LogoForza" ImageSource="/Textures/Data_Bound/Logo_FM_Vertical.png" Width="366" Stretch="None" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
        </Grid>
        
        <ProgressBar x:Name="IdleIndicator" Canvas.Right="185" Canvas.Bottom="52" IsIndeterminate="True" Style="{StaticResource SpinnyProgressStyle}" Height="56" Opacity="0"/>
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="IdleEventFireSpin" TargetName="IdleIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="IdleEventFireHideSpin" TargetName="IdleIndicator"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F003_DemoMenu"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"

            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- /TimelineTemplate -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_GoRace">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="200"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_GoRace">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="ButtonGlowEvent"/>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">

                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>

                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- /TimelineTemplate -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_GoRace">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_GradientBg">

                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:2" Value="0.15"/>

        </Storyboard><!-- ButtonGlowStoryboard -->

    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>

        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ButtonGlowEvent" Storyboard="{StaticResource Storyboard_ButtonGlow}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Menu" Canvas.Left="@E:169:S:0@" Canvas.Bottom="86" Width="1730">
            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_GoRace" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Orientation="Horizontal" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>

        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">

            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F006_DemoPostRace"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="EndOfRaceTimeNoticeTextBlockStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:FastTextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Planer"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="100"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
            <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Left"/>
            <Setter Property="Effect" Value="{StaticResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                   <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>1</System:Int32><!-- Binding CurrTargetAchieved -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>2</System:Int32><!-- Binding CurrTargetAchieved -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>3</System:Int32><!-- Binding CurrTargetAchieved -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- /EndOfRaceTimeNoticeTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <!-- Career progress wheel -->
        <Style x:Key="CareerProgressTickImageStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Image}">
            <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick06.png"/>
            <Setter Property="Stretch" Value="None"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>4</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick04.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>5</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick05.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>6</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick06.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>7</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick07.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>

                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>

        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F019_LoadingInitialExperience"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="TrackImageContentControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="Container">
                            <ContentPresenter x:Name="ContentPresenter" Opacity="0"/>
                            <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                            <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                                <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionIn_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionIn}"/>
                                <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionOut_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionOut}"/>
                            </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <!-- end remote event -->
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /TrackImageContentControlStyle -->
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleIndicator">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.05" Value="startTrackImageStory"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TrackImageStory" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_TrackImage01">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:00.0" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:05.6" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:44.0" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
