<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F021_HudTutorial"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      mc:Ignorable="d">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <System:Double x:Key="Double_IconHeight">30</System:Double>
        
        <Style x:Key="HUDTutorialMessageBackgroundStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource ForzaBlue40Brush}"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0,0.5"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                   <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter> 
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="HUDTutorialStackPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type StackPanel}">
            <Setter Property="Orientation" Value="Horizontal"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0,0.5"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TutorialTransitionIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard> <!-- TutorialTransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TutorialTransitionOut">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard> <!-- TutorialTransitionOut -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
       <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionIn_Footer" Storyboard="{StaticResource TutorialTransitionIn}"/>
       <local:EventFireTrigger Event="TransitionOut_Footer" Storyboard="{StaticResource TutorialTransitionOut}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Opacity="0">
        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="HudTutorialStateGroup">
                <VisualState x:Name="NoTutorial">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="TutorialTransitionOutEventFire">
                            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="TransitionOut_Footer"/>
                        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
            
                <VisualState x:Name="ThrottleTutorial">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="TutorialTransitionInEventFire">
                            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="TransitionIn_Footer"/>

<Page x:Name="Page" 
      x:Class="ForzaUI.Scenes.WPF.F030_VideoPlayer"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}"
      mc:Ignorable="d">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="VideoPlayerBackgroundStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:ZPanel}">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Black"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding FadeToWhite}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="White"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="VideoPlayerSubtitleBackgroundRectangleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="{x:Null}">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="VideoPlayerSubtitleBarRectangleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="{x:Null}">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="VideoPlayerTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource InfoPanelDescriptionLightTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="22"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F040_SimulationLoadingWait"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <!-- preset for additive blend mode -->
        <local:FZMaterialPresetAdditive x:Key="AdditiveMode_FZMaterialPreset"/>

        <!-- preset for no alpha rendering / material will not receive shadow -->
        <local:FZMaterialPreset x:Key="AlphaModeClear_FZMaterialPreset" AlphaMode="Clear"/>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="Show"><!-- The car is loaded -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="IdleEventFire">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Idle_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_CarSimulation">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Manufacturer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard> <!-- Show -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="Hide"><!-- The car is loading -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_CarSimulation">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard> <!-- Hide -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn"/>
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}" Opacity="1">
        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CarSimulation_VisualStateGroup">
                <VisualState x:Name="ShowCarVisualState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:SimProxy.Hidden)" Storyboard.TargetName="SimProxy">
                            <DiscreteBooleanKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="False"/>
                        </BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="SlowShowCarVisualState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:SimProxy.Hidden)" Storyboard.TargetName="SimProxy">
                            <DiscreteBooleanKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="False"/>
                        </BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="HideCarVisualState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:SimProxy.Hidden)" Storyboard.TargetName="SimProxy">
                            <DiscreteBooleanKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="True"/>
                        </BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="SlowHideCarVisualState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:SimProxy.Hidden)" Storyboard.TargetName="SimProxy">
                            <DiscreteBooleanKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="True"/>
                        </BooleanAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
            </VisualStateGroup>
            
            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="Logo_VisualStateGroup">
                <VisualState x:Name="ForzaLogo">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForza">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoManufacturer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="ManufacturerLogo">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoForza">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_LogoManufacturer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
            </VisualStateGroup>
            
            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="Area_VisualStateGroup">
                <VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                    <VisualTransition GeneratedDuration="0:0:0.5"/>
                </VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                <VisualState x:Name="MainMenuVisualState"/>
                <VisualState x:Name="CareerVisualState"/>
                <VisualState x:Name="MultiplayerVisualState"/>
                <VisualState x:Name="RivalsVisualState"/>
                <VisualState x:Name="FreeplayVisualState"/>
                <VisualState x:Name="MarketPlaceVisualState"/>
            </VisualStateGroup>
        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
        
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CarSimulation" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Opacity="0"><!-- default Opacity="0" -->
            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="Image_BackgroundGradient1" ImageSource="/Textures/Backgrounds/Bg_Start_NoStripes.png" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}"/>
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Manufacturer" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}">
                <Image x:Name="Image_LogoManufacturer" Grid.Column="0" Source="{Binding IconPath}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Width="440" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                <local:FZMaterial x:Name="Image_LogoForza" Grid.Column="0" ImageSource="/Textures/Data_Bound/Logo_FM_Vertical.png" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" 
                    Width="366" Stretch="None" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
            </Grid>
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Loading" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,185,52" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <TextBlock x:Name="Message" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Loading_Generic}" Style="{StaticResource LoadSaveWaitTextBlockStyle}"/>
                <ProgressBar x:Name="IdleIndicator" Grid.Column="1" IsIndeterminate="True" Style="{StaticResource SpinnyProgressStyle}"/>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
        
        <local:FZMaterialGlassCapture/><!-- Prevents foreground scenes from stenciling -->
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="IdleEventFire" TargetName="IdleIndicator"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        
        <local:SimProxy x:Name="SimProxy"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

</Page>

                    <RowDefinition/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <Grid Background="{StaticResource DarkPanelBackgroundBrush}">
                    <TextBlock Margin="15,10" Text="{local:Loc InGameMarketplace.IDS_CarsAvailable}" Style="{StaticResource PanelInfoTextBlockStyle}" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                    <TextBlock Margin="15" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="{Binding CarCount}" Style="{StaticResource ProgressNumberStyle}" FontSize="75"/>
                </Grid>
                
                <Grid Grid.Row="2" Background="{StaticResource DarkPanelBackgroundBrush}">
                    <Control Style="{StaticResource WatermakControlStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
                
                <Rectangle Grid.Row="4" Fill="{StaticResource DarkPanelBackgroundBrush}"/>
            </Grid>
            
            <Rectangle x:Name="RightFillerPanel" Canvas.Right="@E:0:F:0:-1@" Width="@E:300:S:0@" Height="{StaticResource PanelHeight}" Fill="{StaticResource DarkPanelBackgroundBrush}"/>
            
            <Control x:Name="LeftArrow" Canvas.Top="210" Canvas.Left="520" Style="{StaticResource LeftSelectorArrowStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectPrev, ElementName=ManufacturerList}"/>
            <Control x:Name="RightArrow" Canvas.Top="210" Canvas.Right="520" Style="{StaticResource RightSelectorArrowStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectNext, ElementName=ManufacturerList}"/>
        </Canvas>
        
        <local:ItemsSelector Canvas.Left="@S@" x:Name="ManufacturerList" Canvas.Top="726" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" Height="227"
            ItemTemplate="{StaticResource ManufacturerItemTemplate}" IsTabStop="True" RenderTransformOrigin="0,1">
            <local:ItemsSelector.Template>
                <ControlTemplate>
                    <local:VirtualizingScrollPanel IsItemsHost="True" 
                        Padding="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorPadding}" 
                        ItemHeight="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorItemHeight}" 
                        ItemWidth="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorSlideDistance}" 
                        EmptyItemStyle="{StaticResource SelectorEmptyItemStyle}" 
                        SlideDuration="{StaticResource SlideDurationTimeSpan}"/>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </local:ItemsSelector.Template>
            <local:ItemsSelector.RenderTransform>
                <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform/>
                </TransformGroup>
            </local:ItemsSelector.RenderTransform>
        </local:ItemsSelector>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Select}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectPrevEventFire" TargetName="RightArrow"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectNextEventFire" TargetName="LeftArrow"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel> 
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page" 
      x:Class="ForzaUI.Scenes.F111_ModelSelect"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d" 
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <System:Double x:Key="ManufacturerGroupItemWidth">236</System:Double>
        <System:Double x:Key="ManufacturerGroupItemHeight">41</System:Double>
        
        <Style x:Key="IsAffordableRectangleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
            <Setter Property="Grid.ColumnSpan" Value="4"/>
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack40Brush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="-4,0"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>2</System:Int32><!-- IsAffordable -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack40Brush}"/>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>0</System:Int32><!-- NotAffordable -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource ForzaRedBrush}"/>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value=".4"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- /IsAffordableRectangleStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="ManufacturerGroupListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource ManufacturerGroupItemWidth}"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="{StaticResource ManufacturerGroupItemHeight}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="IsSelectStoryboard">
                                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Content">
                                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusMenuTextColor}"/>
                                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Border x:Name="PorscheHighlight">
                            <Border.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="{x:Type Border}">
                                    <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,3,0,0"/>
                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="Transparent"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsPorsche}" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,3,0,0"/>
                                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </Border.Style>
                            <Grid x:Name="OuterContainer">
                                <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                    <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Pressed"/>
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                    </VisualStateGroup>
                                    <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Focused"/>
                                    </VisualStateGroup>
                                    <VisualStateGroup x:Name="SelectionStates">
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Unselected"/>
                                        <VisualState x:Name="Selected"/>
                                        <VisualState x:Name="SelectedUnfocused"/>
                                    </VisualStateGroup>
                                </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <Grid x:Name="Container">
                                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_ButtonBg" Style="{StaticResource ManufacturerTabButtonBgContentControlStyle}"/>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Content" Text="{Binding}" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </Grid>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="SelectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource IsSelectStoryboard}"/>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="SelectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard"/>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        <!-- /ManufacturerGroupListBoxItemStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="ManufacturerGroupScrollingListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
            <Setter Property="ItemContainerStyle" Value="{StaticResource ManufacturerGroupListBoxItemStyle}"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
                        <Border >
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <local:VirtualizingScrollPanel Padding="389,0,0,0"
                                Height="{StaticResource ManufacturerGroupItemHeight}" 
                                IsItemsHost="True"
                                ItemWidth="{StaticResource ManufacturerGroupItemWidth}" 
                                ItemHeight="{StaticResource ManufacturerGroupItemHeight}" 
                                SlideDuration="{StaticResource SlideDurationTimeSpan}"/>
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate> 
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ManufacturerGroupScrollingListBoxStyle -->
        
        <Geometry x:Key="PurviewArrow">
            M0,0 L-3,9 3,9 z
        </Geometry>
        
        <Style x:Key="ManufacturerPurviewListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="3"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="IsSelectStoryboard">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Focused">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="OuterContainer">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Pressed"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Focused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_TickSm" Margin="0,3,0,0" Width="1" Height="5" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Brush}" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Path x:Name="Path_Focused" Data="{StaticResource PurviewArrow}" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Height="8" Width="10" Stretch="Fill" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Top" d:LayoutOverrides="Width, Height" Margin="0,8,0,0" Opacity="0"/>                            
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="SelectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource IsSelectStoryboard}"/>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="SelectedGroupStoryboard_BeginStoryboard"/>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ManufacturerPurviewListBoxItemStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="ManufacturerPurviewListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
            <Setter Property="ItemContainerStyle" Value="{StaticResource ManufacturerPurviewListBoxItemStyle}"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="1344"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Right"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,133,34"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
                        <Grid>
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Track" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Brush}" Height="2" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="0,1,0,0"/>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_EndLFT" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" Width="3" Height="4" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="-3,0,0,0"/>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_EndRHT" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" Width="3" Height="4" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,-3,0"/>
                            <ScrollViewer Focusable="False" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" Margin="-5,0">
                                <UniformGrid IsItemsHost="True" Rows="1" Margin="5,0" Height="18"/>
                            </ScrollViewer>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate> 
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ManufacturerPurviewListBoxStyle -->
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="startTransitionInContent"/><!-- Needs to fire on last frame of TransitionIn -->
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFireStoryboard">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="startTransitionInContent"/><!-- Needs to fire on last frame of TransitionIn -->
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionInContent">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_LeftPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_LeftPanelNull">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_RightPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ListBox_ManufacturerPurview">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MidPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionInContent -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Selector">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="Content_TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Selector">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="Content_TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="FireSelectionEventsStory">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Selector">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Content_TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_FixedFocusReticle">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="FocusedStoryboard_Start"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource MenuItemSelectorResetTime}" Value=""/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="MoneyEventFire">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="SelectionChanged"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource MenuItemSelectorResetTime}" Value=""/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /FireSelectionEventsStory -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <Page.Triggers>
        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Selector.SelectionChanged" SourceName="ModelList">
            <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource FireSelectionEventsStory}"/>
        </EventTrigger>
    </Page.Triggers>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
        <!-- Fired by Storyboards -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="startTransitionInContent" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionInContent}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers> 
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ModelSelectStateGroup">
                <VisualState x:Name="CareerState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextBlock.Text)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_SceneTitleText">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{local:Loc MainMenu.IDS_Buy_Cars}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_IconGifted">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Cost">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_IconCurrent">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                
                <VisualState x:Name="InitialExperienceState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextBlock.Text)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_SceneTitleText">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_SelectCar}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="BButton">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_CareerBar">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Cost">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>

                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_NoCars" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">

                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_IconLegend" Margin="115,10,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Top" Orientation="Horizontal" Height="32">

                            <TextBlock Margin="10,0,40,0" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_ModelSelect_IsCurrent}" Style="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" Effect="{DynamicResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_IconOwned" Height="28" Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <Image Width="28" Stretch="None" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_ModelSelect_Owned.png"/>

                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_IconRecommended" Height="28" Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <Image Width="28" Stretch="None" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_ModelSelect_Recommended.png"/>

                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_IconGifted" Height="28" Orientation="Horizontal" Visibility="Collapsed">

        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="MoneyEventFire" TargetName="StackPanel_CareerBar"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page" 
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F117_CarColorListPopup"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d" 
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Thickness x:Key="PaintChipFocusBorderThickness">2</Thickness>
        
        <ControlTemplate x:Key="CarColorListBoxTemplate" TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
            <ScrollViewer Focusable="False" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" Margin="-14">
                <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="14"/>
            </ScrollViewer>
        </ControlTemplate><!-- /CarColorListBoxTemplate -->
        
        <Style x:Key="CarColorItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="1,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="44"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="196"/>
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.Background>
                                <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0.5,0" EndPoint="0.5,1">
                                    <GradientStop Color="{Binding PrimaryColor}" Offset="0"/>
                                    <GradientStop Color="{Binding SecondaryColor}" Offset="1"/>
                                </LinearGradientBrush>
                            </Grid.Background>
                            <Rectangle Margin="0,0,0,22" Height="42" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Visibility="{Binding HasStripe, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                <Rectangle.Fill>
                                    <SolidColorBrush Color="{Binding StripeColor}"/>
                                </Rectangle.Fill>
                            </Rectangle>
                            <Control x:Name="SelectionShadow" Width="36" Height="188" Style="{StaticResource ItemInnerShadowControlStyle}" Opacity="0"/>
                            <Border x:Name="Border_SelectionIndicator" BorderThickness="4" BorderBrush="Transparent"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <MultiTrigger>
                                <MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Property="Selector.IsSelected" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Property="Selector.IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" TargetName="SelectionShadow" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" TargetName="Border_SelectionIndicator" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientBrush}"/>
                            </MultiTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /CarColorItemStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="MiniCarColorListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStory"  RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Border_FocusIndicator">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="0.15" KeySpline="0.5,0,1,1"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.5,1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Border_FocusIndicator">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Border_FocusBevel">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Border_Focus">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_Shadow">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ButtonShadowDouble}"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <ThicknessAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(FrameworkElement.Margin)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_BorderBg">
                                    <EasingThicknessKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="-1,0"/>
                                </ThicknessAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory"/>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_OuterContainer" Width="44" Height="46">
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Container" Margin="0">
                                <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_Shadow" Style="{StaticResource LiveryItemShadow_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                                <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_BorderBg" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}" Margin="1,2"/>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_ColorChip" Margin="1,2">
                                    <Rectangle.Fill>
                                        <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0.5,0" EndPoint="0.5,1">
                                            <GradientStop Color="{Binding PrimaryColor}" Offset="0"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="{Binding SecondaryColor}" Offset="1"/>
                                        </LinearGradientBrush>
                                    </Rectangle.Fill>
                                </Rectangle>
                                <Border x:Name="Border_FocusBevel" BorderThickness="{StaticResource PaintChipFocusBorderThickness}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}" Opacity="0" Margin="1,2"/>
                                <Border x:Name="Border_Focus" BorderThickness="{StaticResource PaintChipFocusBorderThickness}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Opacity="0" Margin="-3,-2"/>
                                <Border x:Name="Border_FocusIndicator" BorderThickness="{StaticResource PaintChipFocusBorderThickness}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientBrush}" Opacity="0" Margin="-3,-2"/>
                                <Path Data="M42,20 L42,35 35,42 20,42 z M42,10 L42,15 15,42 10,42 z" Margin="1,2"
                                    Visibility="{Binding HasStripe, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                    <Path.Fill>
                                       <SolidColorBrush Color="{Binding StripeColor}"/>
                                    </Path.Fill>
                                </Path>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Selector.IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <MultiTrigger>
                                <MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Property="Selector.IsSelected" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                <MultiTrigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_Focus" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStory}"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.EnterActions>
                                <MultiTrigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_Focus"/>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.ExitActions>
                            </MultiTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /MiniCarColorListBoxItemStyle -->
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- TimelineTemplate -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- /TimelineTemplate -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_ColorChooserContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="200"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_ColorChooserContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- TimelineTemplate -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- /TimelineTemplate -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_ColorChooserContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- TransitionOut -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_ColorChooserContainer" Canvas.Left="@E:170:S:0@" Canvas.Bottom="184" MaxWidth="1704" MinHeight="46" MinWidth="46" Opacity="0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
            <Grid.RenderTransform>
                <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform/>
                </TransformGroup>
            </Grid.RenderTransform>
            <local:FZMaterialGlassCapture/>
            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_BorderBg" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
            <local:CommonListBox x:Name="ColorChooser" Margin="2,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" MaxWidth="1700" Template="{StaticResource CarColorListBoxTemplate}"
                ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource MiniCarColorListBoxItemStyle}" ItemsSource="{Binding ColorDataSource}" SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedColorIndex}"/>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Select}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <!-- Buttons added in code -->
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_GlassBg" TargetName="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
