<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F300_PlaygroundPlayerLobby"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d" 
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <local:LobbyStateData x:Key="LobbyStateData"/>
        
        <local:FZBooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="InverseBoolVisConverter" InvertResult="true"/>
        <BooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="BoolVisConverter"/>
        <local:CarClassConverter x:Key="CarClassConverter"/>
        <local:PIConverter x:Key="PIConverter"/>
        
        <GridLength x:Key="InfoColumnWidth">193</GridLength>
        
        <Style x:Key="HorizontalMenuListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuItemHeight}"/>
            <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="false"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <Grid x:Name="OuterContainer" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Focused">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Content">
                                                <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusKeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusMenuTextColor}"/>
                                            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="MouseOver"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Pressed"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Grid x:Name="Container">
                                <ContentControl x:Name="Control_ButtonBg" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuButtonBgContentControlStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Content" Text="{Binding}" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /HorizontalMenuListBoxItemStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="GamerTagTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="28"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="PlayerCardStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="ButtonGlowStoryboard" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_ButtonGlow">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.250"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="1.00"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="0.250" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerCard">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="26"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="380"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="448"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Empty" Grid.Row="1" Grid.ColumnSpan="2" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Height="375" Margin="-132,-76,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Top" Width="960"
                                Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}">
                                <Canvas Height="Auto" Width="Auto" ClipToBounds="True">
                                    <Path Style="{StaticResource NullItemDiagonalLinesPathStyle}" StrokeThickness="1" Stroke="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
                                </Canvas>
                            </Grid>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerInfo" Grid.Row="1">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="80"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="116"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="54"/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_GamerTag" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_GamerTagText" Text="{Binding GamerTag}" Style="{StaticResource GamerTagTextBlockStyle}" Margin="15,-2,15,0"/>
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_HelpButton" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                        Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}" Margin="0,-1,0,0">
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Press" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Press}" Style="{StaticResource GamerTagTextBlockStyle}" Margin="15,0,7,0" Panel.ZIndex="1"/>
                                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Button" Height="32" Width="32">
                                            <Image x:Name="Image_ButtonGlow" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_Glow_Lg.png" Margin="-20"/>
                                            <Image x:Name="Image_ButtonStart" Height="32" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_Start.png" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                        </Grid>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ToStart" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_To_Start}" Style="{StaticResource GamerTagTextBlockStyle}" Margin="7,0,15,0" Panel.ZIndex="1"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerTitle" Grid.Row="1" Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PlayerLevelLabel" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_PlayerCardLevelTitle}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PlayerLevel" Text="{Binding Level, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}"/>                                   
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerBadge" Width="120" Height="120" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Grid.Row="2" Margin="15,0,0,0">
                                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_PlayerBadgeBg" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack70Brush}" Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_PlayerBadge" Source="{Binding BadgeImage}" Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </Grid>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PlayerCarLabel" Grid.Column="1" Text="{local:Loc Lobby.IDS_Car}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" 
                                Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerCarInfo" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_PlayerCarNameContainer" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CarYearMake" Text="{Binding CarYearMake}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="15,0,0,0"/>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CarModel" Text="{Binding CarName}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="15,0,0,0"/>
                                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_RentalIndicatorContainer" Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}" Margin="15,6,0,0">
                                        <Control x:Name="Control_RentalIndicator" Style="{StaticResource RentalBoxControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding IsRentalCar}" HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerCarClassContainer" Grid.Row="0" Height="36" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="305,-23,0,0" 
                                    Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"><!-- {Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}} -->
                                    <Grid Visibility="{Binding IsCarValid, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"><!-- {Binding IsCarValid, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}} -->
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="36"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <Rectangle Fill="{Binding CarClassID, Converter={StaticResource CarClassConverter}}"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CarClass" Text="{Binding CarClassID, Converter={StaticResource CarClassConverter}}" Style="{StaticResource CarClassTextBlockStyle}"
                                            Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CarPI" Text="{Binding CarPerformanceIndex, Converter={StaticResource PIConverter}}" Style="{StaticResource CarClassPiTextBlockStyle}" 
                                            Effect="{StaticResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Grid>
                            </Grid>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_PlayerCarImageContainer" Width="396" Height="226" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="-50,0,0,28">
                                <!--Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource LightGray70Brush}" Visibility="{Binding IsValidPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/-->
                                <Image x:Name="Image_PlayerCar" Source="{Binding CarImageLarge}" Stretch="Uniform" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5"><Image.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="@K@"/></Image.RenderTransform></Image>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded" SourceName="Grid_PlayerCard">
                                <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource ButtonGlowStoryboard}"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                   </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <!--DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/-->
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <!--DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/-->
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueOut -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Header" Style="{StaticResource HeaderGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_Player_Lobby}" Style="{StaticResource HeaderContentControlStyle}"/>
            
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_CareerBar" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarContentControlStyle}">
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CareerBar" Orientation="Horizontal"/>
            </ContentControl>
            
            <ScrollViewer x:Name="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuScrollViewerStyle}">
                <local:CommonListBox x:Name="ListBox_Menu" Margin="135,0"
                    ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuListBoxItemStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" 
                    VerticalAlignment="Top" SelectedValuePath="Text" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5"
                    Focusable="False"/>
            </ScrollViewer>
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_TwoPlayerTimer" Width="532" Height="{StaticResource SceneHeaderHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_2PlayerTimerTitle" Text="{Binding TimerTitle}" Style="{StaticResource ProgressTitleStyle}" Margin="0,0,0,102" VerticalAlignment="Bottom"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_2PlayerTimer" Text="{Binding TimerData}" Style="{StaticResource ProgressNumberStyle}" Margin="0,0,0,70" VerticalAlignment="Bottom"/>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition/>
                <RowDefinition/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyBgContentControlStyle}" Grid.RowSpan="2" Grid.ColumnSpan="2">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_BodyContent">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition/>
                        <RowDefinition/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition/>
                        <ColumnDefinition/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Player1_Bg" Opacity="0.75" Visibility="Collapsed">
                        <Rectangle.Fill>
                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="-0.1,1.5" EndPoint="1.1,-.5">
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset="0.1"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="Transparent" Offset="0.4"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="Transparent" Offset="0.6"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset="0.9"/>
                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                        </Rectangle.Fill>
                    </Rectangle>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Player2_Bg" Grid.Row="1" Opacity="0.2" Fill="#FF000000"/>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_EventInfo_Bg" Grid.Column="1" Grid.RowSpan="2" Opacity="0.75" Visibility="Collapsed">
                        <Rectangle.Fill>
                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="-0.75,-1" EndPoint="1.75,2">
                                <GradientStop Color="Transparent" Offset="0.1"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset="0.5"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="Transparent" Offset="0.9"/>
                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                        </Rectangle.Fill>
                    </Rectangle>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_Player1CardInfoContainer" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,50,0,0">
                        <Control x:Name="Player1Card" Style="{StaticResource PlayerCardStyle}" DataContext="{Binding LobbyPlayerData1}"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Player1Number" Height="32" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_P1" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Splitscreen_PlayerOne}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_Player2CardInfoContainer" Grid.Row="1" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,50,0,0">
                        <Control x:Name="Player2Card" Style="{StaticResource PlayerCardStyle}" DataContext="{Binding LobbyPlayerData2}"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Player2Number" Height="32" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_P2" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Splitscreen_PlayerTwo}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_RaceInfo" Grid.Column="1" Grid.RowSpan="2" DataContext="{StaticResource LobbyStateData}">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_TrackPhoto">
                            <Image x:Name="Image_TrackPhoto" Source="{Binding TrackPhoto}" Stretch="UniformToFill" ClipToBounds="True" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_TrackSpec" Grid.RowSpan="2" Grid.Row="1">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="20"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="200"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="278"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="278"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="96"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_TrackLogo" Height="200" Width="200" VerticalAlignment="Bottom"  Grid.Row="1">
                                <Image x:Name="Image_TrackLogo" Source="{Binding TrackLogo}" Stretch="Uniform" Margin="0,0,1,0"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <Rectangle Grid.Row="1" Fill="{StaticResource MidGrayBrush}" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Width="1" Margin="0,24"/>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_TrackRibbon" Height="200" Width="200" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" FlowDirection="LeftToRight">
                                <Image x:Name="Image_TrackRibbon" Source="{Binding TrackRibbon}" Stretch="None"/>
                                <Image x:Name="Image_TrackScenario" Source="{Binding ScenarioIcon}" Stretch="None" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Top"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Grid.Row="1" Margin="40,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PlaylistName" Grid.Row="0" Text="{Binding PlaylistName}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="28" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TrackName" Grid.Row="1" Text="{Binding EnvironmentName}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="28" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Margin="40,0">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CircuitLabel" Text="{local:Loc Calendar.IDS_Track_Ribbon}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Circuit" Text="{Binding TrackName}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Vertical" Visibility="{Binding NumQuickStops, Converter={StaticResource InverseStringVisConverter}}" >
                                	<TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ConditionLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_World_Tour_Track_Condition_Title}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Condition" Text="{Binding TrackCondition}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Vertical" Visibility="{Binding NumQuickStops, Converter={StaticResource StringVisConverter}}">
                                	<TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_QuickStopLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_World_Tour_Quick_Stop_Title}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_QuickStop" Text="{Binding NumQuickStops}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1" Margin="40,0">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LengthLabel" Grid.Row="2" Text="{local:Loc Lobby.IDS_Lobby_Track_Length_Title}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Length" Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding TrackLength}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LapsLabel" Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding RaceProgressTitle}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Laps" Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding RaceProgressData}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="2" Margin="40,0,0,0">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ClassLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_World_Tour_Class_Title}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Class" Text="{Binding LobbyClass}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PlayersLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Player_Title}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,12,0,0"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Players" Text="{Binding NumPlayers}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,3,0,5"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Select}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F311_MultiplayerLobby"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <local:LobbyStateData x:Key="LobbyStateData"/>
        <local:LobbyVotingData x:Key="LobbyVotingData"/>
        
        <System:Double x:Key="Double_StatusIndicatorWidth">30</System:Double>
        <System:Double x:Key="Double_EnvironmentWeatherIconWidth">24</System:Double>
        
        <BooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="BoolVisConverter"/>
        
        <Style x:Key="LobbyGridItemDividerStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Stretch" Value="Fill"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
            <Setter Property="Fill">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                        <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite00Color}"/>
                        <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite15Color}" Offset="0.1"/>
                        <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite15Color}" Offset="0.9"/>
                        <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite00Color}" Offset="1"/>
                    </LinearGradientBrush>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /LobbyGridItemDividerStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="LobbyCarStatProgressBarStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:DeltaProgressBar}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="15,25,15,20"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="472"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="MaxValue" Value="10"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:DeltaProgressBar}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Border x:Name="PART_Track" Background="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Brush}"/>
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                <Border x:Name="PART_Indicator_Base"
                                    Background="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"
                                    Width="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.TemplatedParent}, Path=BaseValueWidth}"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                                <Border x:Name="PART_Indicator_Delta"
                                    Style="{StaticResource PerformanceStatsDeltaBorderStyle}"
                                    Width="{Binding NewValueWidth, RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.TemplatedParent}}"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /LobbyCarStatProgressBarStyle -->
        
        
        <DataTemplate x:Key="LobbyAreasListItemTemplate">
            <DataTemplate.Resources>
                <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory">
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Content">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusKeyTime}" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaFocusMenuTextColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory">
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Content">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusKeyTime}" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaMenuTextColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut"/>
            </DataTemplate.Resources>
            <Grid x:Name="OuterContainer">
                <Grid x:Name="Container">
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_ButtonBg" Style="{StaticResource TabMenuButtonBgContentControlStyle}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Content" Text="{Binding Text}" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True">
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="HideSelected_BeginStoryboard" HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource DeselectItemStory}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="ShowSelected_BeginStoryboard" HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsEnabled, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" Value="False">
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="HideItems_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionOut}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate><!-- /LobbyAreasListItemTemplate -->  

        <Style x:Key="MultiplayerLobbyConditionalGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="{x:Null}">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- /MultiplayerLobbyConditionalGridStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="MultiplayerLobbyInverseConditionalGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="{x:Null}">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- /MultiplayerLobbyInverseConditionalGridStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PlayerListBoxScrollViewerStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ScrollViewer}">
            <Setter Property="KeyboardNavigation.IsTabStop" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="CanContentScroll" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Disabled"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Auto"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="630"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ScrollViewer}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="auto"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="auto"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ScrollContentPresenter x:Name="PART_ScrollContentPresenter" ClipToBounds="true" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" 
                                Content="{TemplateBinding Content}" CanContentScroll="{TemplateBinding ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll}" Margin="0"/>
                            <ScrollBar x:Name="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Orientation="Vertical" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" Width="8"
                                Minimum="0" Maximum="{TemplateBinding ScrollableHeight}" Value="{TemplateBinding VerticalOffset}"
                                ViewportSize="{TemplateBinding ViewportHeight}" Visibility="{TemplateBinding ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibility}" 
                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Right"/>  
                            <ScrollBar x:Name="PART_HorizontalScrollBar" Orientation="Horizontal" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" Height="8"
                                Minimum="0" Maximum="{TemplateBinding ScrollableWidth}" Value="{TemplateBinding HorizontalOffset}"
                                ViewportSize="{TemplateBinding ViewportWidth}" Visibility="{TemplateBinding ComputedHorizontalScrollBarVisibility}" 
                                Margin="0,6,0,0"/>  
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- PlayerListBoxScrollViewerStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PlayerListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
                        <Grid Background="{x:Null}">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Grid x:Name="ItemLines">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                   <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="0" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="3" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="4" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="5" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="6" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="7" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="8" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="9" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="10" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="11" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="12" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="13" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="14" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="15" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="16" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="17" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="18" Style="{StaticResource LobbyGridItemDividerStyle}"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <ScrollViewer Style="{StaticResource PlayerListBoxScrollViewerStyle}">
                                <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Vertical"/>
                            </ScrollViewer>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- PlayerListBoxStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="LobbyDataImageUpArrowStyle" TargetType="Image">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding IsSpectating}" Value="True" />
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.1" />
                </MultiDataTrigger>
                <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding IsReady}" Value="False" />
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.1" />
                </MultiDataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsFirstSlotXAML}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.1" />
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- LobbyDataImageUpArrowStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="LobbyDataImageDownArrowStyle" TargetType="Image">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding IsSpectating}" Value="True" />
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.1" />
                </MultiDataTrigger>
                <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding IsReady}" Value="False" />
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.1" />
                </MultiDataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsLastSlotXAML}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.1" />
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- LobbyDataImageDownArrowStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="LobbyDataTextBlockStyleWithManualGrid" BasedOn="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding IsSpectating}" Value="True" />
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowManualGridXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4" />
                </MultiDataTrigger>
                <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding IsReady}" Value="False" />
                        <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4" />
                </MultiDataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- LobbyDataTextBlockStyleWithManualGrid -->

        <Style x:Key="GridPlaceTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSpectating}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsReady}" Value="False">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- GridPlaceTextBlockStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="PlayerListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="35"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="TalkingStory">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Image_Talking">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.883" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="LayoutRoot">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="20"/><!-- team color -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- grid place -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- manual arrows -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="210"/><!-- status indicators -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="290"/><!-- gamertag -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="106"/><!-- car class -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><!-- car name-->
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Focus" Grid.ColumnSpan="7" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}"/>
                            <Rectangle Grid.Column="0" x:Name="Rectangle_TeamColor" Width="6" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="2">
                                <Rectangle.Fill>
                                    <SolidColorBrush Color="{Binding TeamColor}"/>
                                </Rectangle.Fill>
                            </Rectangle>


                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" x:Name="StackPanel_GridPlace" 
                                        Visibility="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"
                                        Orientation="Horizontal" Width="40">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_GridPlace"
                                           Text="{Binding GridPlaceXAML}" 
                                           Style="{StaticResource GridPlaceTextBlockStyle}" 
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="5,0,0,0"/> 
                            </StackPanel>


                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" x:Name="StackPanel_Arrows" Orientation="Vertical" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Width="40" Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                        Visibility="{Binding ShowManualGridXAML, ElementName=Page, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                <Image x:Name="Image_ArrowUp" 
                                           Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataImageUpArrowStyle}"
                                           Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Seed_Arrow_Up.png" Stretch="None" />
                                <Image x:Name="Image_ArrowDown"
                                           Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataImageDownArrowStyle}"
                                           Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Seed_Arrow_Down.png" Stretch="None"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            
                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" x:Name="StackPanel_StatusIndicators" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="5,0,10,0">
                                <StackPanel.Style>
                                    <Style TargetType="{x:Type StackPanel}">
                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsSpectating}" Value="True" />
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowManualGridXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4" />
                                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsReady}" Value="False" />
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4" />
                                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                    </Style>
                                </StackPanel.Style>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_TalkingContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}" 
                                    Visibility="{Binding IsMicConnected, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_NotTalking" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_NotTalking.png" Stretch="None" Visibility="Visible"/>
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_Talking" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_Talking.png" Stretch="None" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_Muted" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_Muted.png" Stretch="None" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_HostingContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_HostIcon" Stretch="None" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_PrivateLobbyHost.png" 
                                        Visibility="{Binding IsHost, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_DrivatarContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}" 
                                    Visibility="{Binding IsAIPlayer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_DrivatarIcon" Text="{Binding DrivatarIcon}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="32"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_DrivingContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_Driving" Stretch="None" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_Driving.png" 
                                        Visibility="{Binding IsDriving, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_ReadyContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_Ready" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_Ready.png" Stretch="None" 
                                        Visibility="{Binding IsReady, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_FinishedContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_Finished" Stretch="None" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_Finished.png" 
                                        Visibility="{Binding IsFinished, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_SpectatingContainer" Width="Auto" MaxWidth="{StaticResource Double_StatusIndicatorWidth}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_SpectatingIcon" Stretch="None" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_Lobby_Spectating.png" 
                                        Visibility="{Binding IsSpectating, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </StackPanel>

                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="4" x:Name="TextBlock_GamerTag" Text="{Binding GamerTag}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyleWithManualGrid}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            
                            <Grid Grid.Column="5" x:Name="ClassBadge" Margin="-5,0,0,0" 
                                Visibility="{Binding IsCarValid, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                <Grid.Style>
                                    <Style TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsSpectating}" Value="True" />
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowManualGridXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4" />
                                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsReady}" Value="False" />
                                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowGridPlaceXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True" />
                                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.4" />
                                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                    </Style>
                                </Grid.Style>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="36"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Rectangle Height="27" Width="27" Fill="{Binding CarClassID, Converter={StaticResource CarClassConverter}}"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding CarClassID, Converter={StaticResource CarClassConverter}}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" 
                                    VerticalAlignment="Center" TextAlignment="Center"/>
                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" Text="{Binding CarPerformanceIndex, Converter={StaticResource PIConverter}}" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                    Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Grid>

                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="6" x:Name="TextBlock_CarName" Text="{Binding CarModelShortName}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataTextBlockStyleWithManualGrid}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            
                        </Grid><!-- /LayoutRoot -->
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Control_Focus"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" TargetName="Control_Focus"/>
                            </Trigger>

                            <!-- Shows and hides position change arrows during manual grid mode -->
                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsKeyboardFocused, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowManualGridXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsConsoleHostXAML}" Value="True"/>
                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1" TargetName="StackPanel_Arrows"/>
                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsKeyboardFocused, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="False"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding ShowManualGridXAML, ElementName=Page}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsConsoleHostXAML}" Value="True"/>
                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0" TargetName="StackPanel_Arrows"/>
                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsConsoleHostXAML}" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0" TargetName="StackPanel_Arrows"/>
                            </DataTrigger>

                            <!-- Change gamertag color if the selected item is the player -->
                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                <!-- Not selected, and gamertag is the player's -->
                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="False"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsLocalPlayer}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsAIPlayer}" Value="False"/>
                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}" TargetName="TextBlock_GamerTag"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}" TargetName="TextBlock_CarName"/>
                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                <!-- Selected, and gamertag is the player's -->
                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsLocalPlayer}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsAIPlayer}" Value="False"/>
                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}" TargetName="TextBlock_GamerTag"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}" TargetName="TextBlock_CarName"/>
                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                <!-- Selected, and gamertag is AI -->
                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsLocalPlayer}" Value="False"/>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsAIPlayer}" Value="True"/>
                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaFocusListTextBrush}" TargetName="TextBlock_GamerTag"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaFocusListTextBrush}" TargetName="TextBlock_CarName"/>
                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                            <MultiDataTrigger>
                                <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsLocalPlayer}">
                                        <Condition.Value>
                                            <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                        </Condition.Value>
                                    </Condition>
                                    <Condition Binding="{Binding IsAIPlayer}">
                                        <Condition.Value>
                                            <System:Boolean>False</System:Boolean>
                                        </Condition.Value>
                                    </Condition>
                                </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaBlueBrush}"/>
                            </MultiDataTrigger>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsTalking}">
                                <DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </DataTrigger.Value>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Image_NotTalking"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" TargetName="Image_Talking"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Image_Muted"/>
                                <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="Storyboard_TalkingStory" Storyboard="{StaticResource TalkingStory}"/>
                                </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="Storyboard_TalkingStory"/>
                                </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                            </DataTrigger>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSystemMuted}">
                                <DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </DataTrigger.Value>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Image_NotTalking"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Image_Talking"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" TargetName="Image_Muted"/>
                            </DataTrigger>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsMuted}">
                                <DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </DataTrigger.Value>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Image_NotTalking"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Image_Talking"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" TargetName="Image_Muted"/>
                            </DataTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /PlayerListBoxItemStyle -->

                                        Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>

                                        Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>

                                        Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>

                                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_RaceStats" Grid.Row="1">
                                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_Length">
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Length" Text="{Binding Length}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,5,15,5"
                                            Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LengthNull" Text="{local:Loc Lobby.IDS_Empty}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,5,15,5"
                                            Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Laps" Orientation="Horizontal">
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_RaceLapCount" Text="{Binding RaceLapCount}" Style="{StaticResource LobbyDataHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,5,6,0"
                                            Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>

                                            Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>

                                        Visibility="{Binding IsRandom, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>

                            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Focus" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}"/>

                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Control_Focus"/>

                            <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True">

                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="TextBlock_VotesLabel"/>
