                                <DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <System:Int32>1</System:Int32><!-- singular lap -->
                                </DataTrigger.Value>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="TextBlock_LapsLabel"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" TargetName="TextBlock_LapLabel"/>

                </Setter.Value>

                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_HandlingLabel" Grid.Row="1" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_Stat_Handling}" Style="{StaticResource PanelInfoTextBlockStyle}"/>

                        </Grid>

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="Control_TabMenu"/>
    </local:ZPanel>

<Page x:Class="ForzaUI.Scenes.WPF.F350_Leaderboard"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      Title="Leaderboard">
    
    
    <!-- Dead scene. Was cut from FM5. -->
    <Page.Resources>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column0Width">105</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column1Width">552</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column2Width">175</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column3Width">343</GridLength>
        
        <Style x:Key="HeaderTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource WhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="14,0"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="SecondaryHeaderTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HeaderTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Light"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="ItemTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HeaderTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="30"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        
        <DataTemplate x:Key="FriendItem">
            <Border Height="66">
                <Grid Background="{StaticResource PanelBackgroundBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,2">
                   <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column0Width}"/>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column1Width}"/>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column2Width}"/>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column3Width}"/> 
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Border x:Name="MedalImage" Style="{StaticResource PodiumBorderStyle}" Tag="{Binding PodiumPosition}" Visibility="{Binding IsRivals, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}">
                        <TextBlock x:Name="PositionValueText" Style="{StaticResource ItemTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Position}"/>
                    </Border>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="GamertagValueText" Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource ItemTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Gamertag}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="PayoutValueText" Grid.Column="3" Style="{StaticResource ItemTextBlockStyle}" 
                        Text="{Binding Payout, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}, ConverterParameter=money}"/>
                        
                    <Rectangle Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                    <Rectangle Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                    <Rectangle Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Border>
        </DataTemplate>
        
        <Style x:Key="ListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
                        <Border Background="{x:Null}">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <ScrollViewer Focusable="false" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                                <VirtualizingStackPanel Orientation="Vertical" IsItemsHost="true" />
                            </ScrollViewer>          
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
        </Storyboard><!-- /Transition In -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
        </Storyboard><!-- /Transition Out -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Header" Style="{StaticResource HeaderGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_EventLeaderboard}" Style="{StaticResource HeaderContentControlStyle}"/>
        </Grid>
        
        <Canvas x:Name="Body" Canvas.Top="240" Canvas.Left="@E:361:S:0@">
            <Border x:Name="FriendsContainer" Canvas.Top="47" Background="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}" Height="43" 
                RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                <Border.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Border.RenderTransform>
                <Border.Clip>
                    <PathGeometry>
                        <PathFigure IsClosed="True" StartPoint="0,0">
                            <LineSegment Point="1000,0"/>
                            <LineSegment Point="1000,43"/>
                            <LineSegment Point="0,43"/>
                        </PathFigure>
                    </PathGeometry>
                </Border.Clip>
                <TextBlock x:Name="FriendsText" Text="{local:Loc Clan.IDS_Friends}" Style="{StaticResource HeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
            </Border>
            <Border x:Name="ListHeaderContainer" Canvas.Top="90" BorderThickness="0,2,0,0" BorderBrush="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}">
                <Grid Background="{StaticResource MidGrayBrush}" Height="45">
                   <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column0Width}"/>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column1Width}"/>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column2Width}"/>
                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column3Width}"/> 
                   </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                   <TextBlock x:Name="PositionTitle" Style="{StaticResource SecondaryHeaderTextBlockStyle}" Text="{local:Loc Scoreboard.IDS_Pos}"/>
                   <TextBlock x:Name="GamertagTitle" Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource SecondaryHeaderTextBlockStyle}" Text="{local:Loc Scoreboard.IDS_Gamertag}"/>
                   <TextBlock x:Name="RankingTitle" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource SecondaryHeaderTextBlockStyle}" Text="{local:Loc Scoreboard.IDS_Ranking}"/>
                   <TextBlock x:Name="PayoutTitle" Grid.Column="3" Style="{StaticResource SecondaryHeaderTextBlockStyle}" Text="{local:Loc Scoreboard.IDS_Payout}"/>
                   
                   <Rectangle Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                   <Rectangle Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                   <Rectangle Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Border>
            
            <ListBox x:Name="FriendsList" Canvas.Top="137" ItemTemplate="{StaticResource FriendItem}" ItemsSource="{Binding Friends}"
                MaxHeight="528" Style="{StaticResource ListBoxStyle}"/>
        </Canvas>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Select}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
    x:Class="ForzaUI.F511_LiveryColorSliders"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
    xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
    xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
    mc:Ignorable="d"
    DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="ColorFineTuneSliderNameControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="Auto"/>
            <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="226"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStory" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <ParallelTimeline RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator">
                                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Name">
                                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                </ParallelTimeline>
                                <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator">
                                    <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                                </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator">
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusKeyTime}" Value="1" KeySpline="{StaticResource MinEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid Height="40">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="15"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusIndicator" Grid.Column="1" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Height="2"  
                                VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,0,0,5" RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5">
                                <Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                                    <TransformGroup>
                                        <ScaleTransform ScaleX="0.1"/>
                                        <SkewTransform/>
                                        <RotateTransform/>
                                        <TranslateTransform/>
                                    </TransformGroup>
                                </Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                            </Rectangle>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Name" Text="{TemplateBinding Content}" Style="{StaticResource TuningSliderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                                <Trigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </Trigger.Value>
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStory}"/>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow"/>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ColorFineTuneSliderNameControlStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="ColorFineTuneSliderValueControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Grid.Column" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="84"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="84"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStory" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <ParallelTimeline RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_Name">
                                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                </ParallelTimeline>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid Height="40">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="15"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Name" Text="{TemplateBinding Content}" Style="{StaticResource TuningSliderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Tag">
                                <Trigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </Trigger.Value>
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStory}"/>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow"/>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ColorFineTuneSliderValueControlStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="ColorFineTuneThumbStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
            <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="16"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                        <Grid Margin="-6,19,-6,0" Height="8" Width="10">
                            <Path Data="M0,0 L-3,9 3,9 z" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" Height="8" Width="10" Stretch="Fill"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ColorFineTuneThumbStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="ColorFineTuneFocusedThumbStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneThumbStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                        <Grid Margin="-6,19,-6,0" Height="8" Width="10">
                            <Path Data="M0,0 L-3,9 3,9 z" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Height="8" Width="10" Stretch="Fill"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ColorFineTuneFocusedThumbStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="ColorFinetuneSliderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
            <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Grid.Column" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="16"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="16,0"/>
            <Setter Property="SmallChange" Value="0.005"/>
            <Setter Property="LargeChange" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Border x:Name="TrackBackground" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}"/>
                            <Track x:Name="PART_Track">
                                <Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>
                                    <RepeatButton Style="{StaticResource SliderButtonStyle}"/>
                                </Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>
                                <Track.Thumb>
                                    <Thumb x:Name="Thumb" Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneThumbStyle}"/>
                                </Track.Thumb>
                                <Track.IncreaseRepeatButton>
                                    <RepeatButton Style="{StaticResource SliderButtonStyle}"/>
                                </Track.IncreaseRepeatButton>
                            </Track>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsFocused" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Thumb" Property="Style" Value="{DynamicResource ColorFineTuneFocusedThumbStyle}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /ColorFinetuneSliderStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="CustomColorVisualizationControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="80"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="144"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Control}">
                        <Grid>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_BorderBg" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_PrimaryColor" Margin="1">
                                <Rectangle.Fill>
                                    <SolidColorBrush Color="{Binding PrimaryColor}"/>
                                </Rectangle.Fill>
                            </Rectangle>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_SecondaryColor" Visibility="{Binding HasSecondaryColor, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}" Margin="1,0,0,0">
                                <Rectangle.Fill>
                                    <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0.5,0" EndPoint="0.5,1">
                                        <GradientStop Color="#00000000" Offset="0"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="{Binding SecondaryColor}" Offset="1"/>
                                    </LinearGradientBrush>
                                </Rectangle.Fill>
                            </Rectangle>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Stripe" Margin="1,0,1,22" Height="24" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Visibility="{Binding HasStripe, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                <Rectangle.Fill>
                                    <SolidColorBrush Color="{Binding StripeColor}"/>
                                </Rectangle.Fill>
                            </Rectangle>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /CustomColorVisualizationControlStyle -->
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames><StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_ColorSlidersContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_OpacitySliderContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_ColorSlidersContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_OpacitySliderContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
               <ContentControl x:Name="Control_TabMenu" Style="{StaticResource PaintTabMenuContentControlStyle}" Margin="35,0,0,5" Opacity="0">
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_TabMenu">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource SpinTabMenuBumperWidth}"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource SpinTabMenuViewWidth}"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource SpinTabMenuBumperWidth}"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Control x:Name="LeftBumperArrow" Style="{StaticResource LeftSpinBumperIndicatorStyle}" IsEnabled="False"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Tab" Grid.Column="1" Width="{StaticResource SpinTabMenuItemWidth}" Height="{StaticResource SpinTabMenuItemHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Bg" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ItemText" Text="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_ColorSpectrum}" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Control x:Name="RightBumperArrow" Style="{StaticResource RightSpinBumperIndicatorStyle}" IsEnabled="False"/>
                    </Grid>
                </ContentControl>
                
                <Grid Margin="@E:0:F:0:-1@,0,@E:0:F:0:-1@,0" x:Name="Grid_ColorSlidersContainer" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="144" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" 
                    Visibility="{Binding IsTinting, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="118"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="118"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_BorderBg" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_ColorChips" Grid.Column="1" Grid.RowSpan="3" Orientation="Horizontal">
                        <Control x:Name="PrevColor" DataContext="{Binding PreviousColor}" Style="{StaticResource CustomColorVisualizationControlStyle}" Margin="0,0,2,0"/>
                        <Control x:Name="CurrColor" DataContext="{Binding CurrentColor}" Style="{StaticResource CustomColorVisualizationControlStyle}" Margin="2,0,4,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Sliders" Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Vertical" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Hue" Height="40" >
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="180"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="98"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderNameControlStyle}" Content="{local:Loc Livery.IDS_Hue}" Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=HueSlider}" 
                                VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Slider x:Name="HueSlider" Maximum="1" Value="{Binding Hue}" Style="{StaticResource ColorFinetuneSliderStyle}" Panel.ZIndex="9">
                                <Slider.Background>
                                    <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FFFF0000" Offset="0"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FFFFFF00" Offset="0.167"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FF00FF00" Offset="0.333"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FF00FFFF" Offset="0.5"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FF0000FF" Offset="0.667"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FFFF00FF" Offset="0.833"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="#FFFF0000" Offset="1"/>
                                    </LinearGradientBrush>
                                </Slider.Background>
                            </Slider>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderValueControlStyle}" Content="{Binding Hue, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter2}}" 
                                Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=HueSlider}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Grid>
                    
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Saturation" Height="40" >
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="180"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="98"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderNameControlStyle}" Content="{local:Loc Livery.IDS_Saturation}" Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=SaturationSlider}" 
                                VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            <Slider x:Name="SaturationSlider" Maximum="1" Value="{Binding Saturation}" Style="{StaticResource ColorFinetuneSliderStyle}" Panel.ZIndex="10">
                                <Slider.Background>
                                    <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                        <GradientStop Color="White" Offset="0"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="{Binding SaturationColor}" Offset="1"/>
                                    </LinearGradientBrush>
                                </Slider.Background>
                            </Slider>   
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderValueControlStyle}" Content="{Binding Saturation, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter2}}" 
                                Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=SaturationSlider}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Grid>
                        
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Brightness" Height="40" >
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="180"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="98"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderNameControlStyle}" Content="{local:Loc Livery.IDS_Brightness}" Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=BrightnessSlider}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>   
                            <Slider x:Name="BrightnessSlider" Maximum="1" Value="{Binding Brightness}" Style="{StaticResource ColorFinetuneSliderStyle}" Panel.ZIndex="11">
                                <Slider.Background>
                                    <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                        <GradientStop Color="Black" Offset="0"/>
                                        <GradientStop Color="{Binding BrightnessColor}" Offset="1"/>
                                    </LinearGradientBrush>
                                </Slider.Background>
                            </Slider>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderValueControlStyle}" Content="{Binding Brightness, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter2}}" Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=BrightnessSlider}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
                
                <Grid Margin="@E:0:F:0:-1@,0,@E:0:F:0:-1@,0" x:Name="Grid_OpacitySliderContainer" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="56" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" 
                    Visibility="{Binding IsTinting, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="118"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="118"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_OpacitySliderBg" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_Tint" Grid.Column="2" Height="40">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="180"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="98"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderNameControlStyle}" Content="{local:Loc Livery.IDS_Tint_Opacity}" Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=TintSlider}"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="TintSlider" Maximum="1" Value="{Binding TintOpacity}" Style="{StaticResource ColorFinetuneSliderStyle}" Panel.ZIndex="9">
                            <Slider.Background>
                                <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                    <GradientStop Color="#00000000" Offset="0"/>
                                    <GradientStop Color="{Binding TintColor}" Offset="1"/>
                                </LinearGradientBrush>
                            </Slider.Background>
                        </Slider>
                        <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource ColorFineTuneSliderValueControlStyle}" Content="{Binding Tint, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter2}}" 
                            Tag="{Binding IsFocused, ElementName=TintSlider}"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <!-- Buttons added in code -->
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectPrevCategoryEventFire" TargetName="RightBumperArrow"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectNextCategoryEventFire" TargetName="LeftBumperArrow"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="Control_TabMenu"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
    xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    x:Class="ForzaUI.F539_RecommendedUpgrades">

    <Page.Resources>
        <GridLength x:Key="ImageColumnWidth">102</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="SectionColumnWidth">720</GridLength>

        <Style x:Key="RecommendedUpgradesListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
                        <Border Background="{x:Null}">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <ScrollViewer Focusable="false" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                                <VirtualizingStackPanel Orientation="Vertical" IsItemsHost="true"/>
                            </ScrollViewer>
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="RecommendedUpgradesListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                               <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource ImageColumnWidth}"/>
                               <ColumnDefinition/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="MouseOver"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="SelectionStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unselected"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Selected"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="SelectedUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup> 
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Focused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_UpgradeImageBG" Margin="0,0,2,0" MinHeight="100" Fill="{StaticResource LightestGray80Brush}"/>
                            <Image Source="{Binding Image}"/>

                            <Grid Grid.Column="1">
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="35"/>
                                    <RowDefinition/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_UpgradeSectionPriceContainer" Background="{StaticResource DarkPanelBackgroundBrush}">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource SectionColumnWidth}"/>
                                       <ColumnDefinition/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Section}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                    <Rectangle Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>

                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Price}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <Rectangle Grid.Row="1" Fill="{StaticResource DarkGray80Brush}"/>
                                <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Margin="15,10,15,0" Text="{Binding PartName}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderGrayTextBlockStyle}" VerticalAlignment="Top"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>

                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Selector.IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Background" TargetName="Grid_UpgradeSectionPriceContainer" Value="{StaticResource RedMenuHighlightBrush}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Fill" TargetName="Rectangle_UpgradeImageBG" Value="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

		<Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"><!-- Template :  v1 05.07.13 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_BlurBG">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_DarkenBG">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.417" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.584" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ListBox_Menu">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="144"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="144"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.3,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline><!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn : v1 05.07.13 -->
        </Storyboard> <!-- TransitionIn -->

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"><!-- Template :  v1 05.07.13 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_BlurBG">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_DarkenBG">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ListBox_Menu">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline><!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut : v1 05.07.13 -->
        </Storyboard>
    </Page.Resources>

    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Opacity="0">
        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_BlurBG" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Effect="{StaticResource DefaultBlur}"/>
        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_DarkenBG" Fill="{StaticResource BlackoutBrush}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}"/>

        <Border x:Name="Border_OuterContainer" Canvas.Left="{StaticResource DialogAreaLeftMargin}" Canvas.Top="{StaticResource DialogAreaTopMargin}" Width="{StaticResource DialogAreaWidth}" Height="{StaticResource DialogAreaHeight}">
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_DialogContainer" Width="{StaticResource DialogMaxWidth}" MaxHeight="{StaticResource DialogMaxHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="4"/>
                    <RowDefinition/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <ContentControl x:Name="Control_DialogHeader" Style="{StaticResource DialogHeaderStyle}" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_Recommended_Upgrades}"/>

                <Grid x:Name="Grid_MessageContainer" Grid.Row="2">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                       <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                       <RowDefinition Height="4"/>
                       <RowDefinition/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <Grid MinHeight="36" Background="{StaticResource MidGray90Brush}">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                           <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource ImageColumnWidth}"/>
                           <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource SectionColumnWidth}"/>
                           <ColumnDefinition/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Rectangle Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{local:Loc UpgradeCar.IDS_ManufacturerAndSection}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderDarkTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        <Rectangle Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" Text="{local:Loc Upgrades_flow.IDS_Price}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderDarkTextBlockStyle}"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <local:CommonListBox x:Name="ListBox_Menu" Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource RecommendedUpgradesListBoxStyle}" ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource RecommendedUpgradesListBoxItemStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Canvas.Bottom="0" Height="{StaticResource SceneFooterHeight}" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}">
            <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" StartPadding="95" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Layout="RightToLeft">
                <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
            </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
        </Grid>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_DialogHeader"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F550_EverymanAreaSelect"
      Title="UpgradeAreaSelect"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <DataTemplate x:Key="UpgradeAreaListItemTemplate">
            <DataTemplate.Resources>
                <System:Double x:Key="ItemHeight">200</System:Double>
                <System:Double x:Key="ItemWidth">200</System:Double>
                
                <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory">
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Background">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="{DynamicResource FocusedListItemBackgroundColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectionShadow">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory">
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Background">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="{DynamicResource ListItemBackgroundColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectionShadow">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStory" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                    <ParallelTimeline BeginTime="0:0:0.3">
                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectionGlow">
                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                            <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.5,1"/>
                            <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="0" KeySpline="0.5,0,0,1"/>
                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </ParallelTimeline>
                </Storyboard>
            </DataTemplate.Resources>
            
            <Grid x:Name="Container" Margin="2,0" Width="{StaticResource ItemWidth}" Height="{StaticResource ItemHeight}" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Background">
                    <Rectangle.Fill>
                        <SolidColorBrush Color="{StaticResource ListItemBackgroundColor}"/>
                    </Rectangle.Fill>
                </Rectangle>
                
                <Image x:Name="Thumb" Source="{Binding IconPath}"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="Title" Text="{Binding Name}" Style="{StaticResource ListItemTitleStyle}"/>
                
                <Control x:Name="SelectionShadow" Style="{StaticResource ItemInnerShadowControlStyle}" Opacity="0"/>
                <Control x:Name="SelectionGlow" Style="{StaticResource ItemInnerGlowControlStyle}" Opacity="0"/>
            </Grid>
            
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True">
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStory}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource DeselectItemStory}"/>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="UpgradeAreaList">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.833" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="UpgradeAreaList">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="FireSelectionEventsStory">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="MoneyEventFire">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="SelectionChanged"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value=""/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Stroke).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusReticle">
                <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource MidGrayColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="{StaticResource MidGrayColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="{StaticResource ForzaRedColor}"/>
            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_FocusedDelta">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="0"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_ListFocus">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="UpgradeAreaList">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.267" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /FireSelectionEventsStory -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <Page.Triggers>
        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="Selector.SelectionChanged" SourceName="UpgradeAreaList">
            <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource FireSelectionEventsStory}"/>
        </EventTrigger>
        
        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:ItemsSelector.PrevSel" SourceName="UpgradeAreaList">
            <BeginStoryboard>
                <Storyboard>
                    <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectPrevEventFire">
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="SelectPrev"/>
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.01" Value=""/>
                    </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
            </BeginStoryboard>
        </EventTrigger>
        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:ItemsSelector.NextSel" SourceName="UpgradeAreaList">
            <BeginStoryboard>
                <Storyboard>
                    <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectNextEventFire">
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="SelectNext"/>
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.01" Value=""/>
                    </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
            </BeginStoryboard>
        </EventTrigger>
    </Page.Triggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Header" Style="{StaticResource HeaderGridStyle}">
            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Header" Margin="95,64,0,0" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_Customize}" Style="{StaticResource MiniHeaderContentControlStyle}"/>
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle" Height="32" Margin="0,-32,0,0" Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_SceneSubtitle" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="{Binding TypeName}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemInfoLightTextBlockStyle}" Margin="15,0,0,0"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </StackPanel>
            
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_CareerBar" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarContentControlStyle}">
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CareerBar" Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_PiggyBank" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarItemGridStyle}">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CreditsProgress" Tag="{Binding Profile.TokensEnabled}" Style="{StaticResource CreditsPiggyBankGridStyle}">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowA}"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowB}"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CreditsProgressTitle" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_BankCredits}" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarTitleStyle}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CreditsProgressNumber" Text="{Binding Profile.Credits, ConverterParameter=money, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" 
                                Style="{StaticResource CareerBarNumberStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_BankTokens" Tag="{Binding Profile.TokensEnabled}" Style="{StaticResource TokensPiggyBankGridStyle}" 
                            Visibility="{Binding Profile.TokensEnabled, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowA}"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowB}"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_BankTokensLabel" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_BankTokens}" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarTitleStyle}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_BankTokens" Text="{Binding Profile.Tokens, ConverterParameter=tokenmoney, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" 
                                Style="{StaticResource CareerBarNumberStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </StackPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <local:ItemsSelector x:Name="UpgradeAreaList" Height="186" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,37"
                ItemTemplate="{StaticResource UpgradeAreaListItemTemplate}" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" IsTabStop="True"
                RenderTransformOrigin="0,1" Opacity="0">
                <local:ItemsSelector.Template>
                    <ControlTemplate>
                        <local:VirtualizingScrollPanel IsItemsHost="True" 
                            Padding="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorPadding}" 
                            ItemHeight="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorItemHeight}" 
                            ItemWidth="{StaticResource HorizontalSelectorSlideDistance}" 
                            EmptyItemStyle="{StaticResource SelectorEmptyItemStyle}" 
                            SlideDuration="{StaticResource SlideDurationTimeSpan}"/>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </local:ItemsSelector.Template>
                <local:ItemsSelector.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </local:ItemsSelector.RenderTransform>
            </local:ItemsSelector>
            
            <Grid Margin="@E:0:F:0:-1@,0,@E:0:F:0:-1@,0" x:Name="Grid_ListFocus" Canvas.Top="748" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="208" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Opacity="0">
                <Grid.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Grid.RenderTransform>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_FocusedDelta" Grid.Column="1" DataContext="{Binding UpgradeSummary}" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Top" Opacity="0" Margin="10,5">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FocusedDeltaLabel" Text="{Binding Dimension}" Style="{StaticResource BenchmarkHeaderTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="14" Margin="0,0,5,0"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FocusedDelta" Text="{Binding Change}" Tag="{Binding Quality}" Style="{StaticResource FocusedDeltaTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="14" Margin="0"/>
                </StackPanel>
                
                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusReticle" Grid.Column="1" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Height="208" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Width="208" Stroke="{StaticResource MidGrayBrush}" StrokeThickness="4"/>
                <Control x:Name="LeftArrow" Style="{StaticResource MiniLeftSelectorArrowStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectPrev, ElementName=UpgradeAreaList}" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                <Control x:Name="RightArrow" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource MiniRightSelectorArrowStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectNext, ElementName=UpgradeAreaList}" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="10,0,0,0"/>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Select}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="MoneyEventFire" TargetName="StackPanel_CareerBar"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectPrevEventFire" TargetName="RightArrow"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectNextEventFire" TargetName="LeftArrow"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
