<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F552_EverymanPartSelect"
      Title="UpgradePartSelect"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d" 
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <local:DriveTrainConverter x:Key="DriveTrainConverter"/>
        
        <DataTemplate x:Key="UpgradePartListItemTemplate">
            <DataTemplate.Resources>
                <System:Double x:Key="ItemHeight">186</System:Double>
                <System:Double x:Key="ItemWidth">186</System:Double>
                <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory">
                    <ThicknessAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(FrameworkElement.Margin)" Storyboard.TargetName="Container">
                        <SplineThicknessKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusedButtonMarginThickness}" KeySpline="{StaticResource MaxEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                    </ThicknessAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:FZMaterial.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_BodyBg">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource FocusedListItemBgColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory">
                    <ThicknessAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(FrameworkElement.Margin)" Storyboard.TargetName="Container">
                        <EasingThicknessKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="0"/>
                    </ThicknessAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:FZMaterial.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_BodyBg">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ListItemBgColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Container">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
            </DataTemplate.Resources>
            <Grid x:Name="OuterContainer" Background="{x:Null}" Width="{StaticResource ItemWidth}" Height="{StaticResource ItemHeight}" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                <Grid x:Name="Container">
                    <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_BodyBg" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                    <Image x:Name="Image_Thumbnail" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="None" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" ClipToBounds="True"/>
                    <Image x:Name="Image_UpgradePartStatus" Margin="5,0,0,5" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Style="{StaticResource UpgradePartStatusImageStyle}" Tag="{Binding Status}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Canvas.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource DeselectItemStory}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsEnabled, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" Value="False">
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource TransitionOut}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_CarInfoContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_InfoBenchmark">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_PriceContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.433" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.6" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_InfoRightBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_PriceBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_ForzaVista_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Selector">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="Content_TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_InfoPanels">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_PriceContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_InfoRightBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="FZMaterial_PriceBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="FireSelectionEventsStory">

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_FixedFocusReticle" TargetName="Control_FixedFocusReticle"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>

      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="CurrentCarTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="25"/>

            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        </Style><!-- /CurrentCarTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="CurrentLevelProgressBarStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="61,0,0,0"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>

                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
                        <Grid Height="12" Width="215">
                            <Border x:Name="PART_Track" Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack80Brush}"/>
                            <Border x:Name="PART_Indicator" Background="{StaticResource LightestGrayBrush}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /CurrentLevelProgressBarStyle -->
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">

                                Effect="{StaticResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlPorscheStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">

                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

                            <RowDefinition Height="4"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>

                                <ColumnDefinition/>

                            	    <Image Source="{Binding Thumbnail}" Visibility="{Binding UseLinearToSRGB, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>

                                    </Rectangle>
                            	</Grid>
                            </Border>

                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" MinWidth="250"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" MinWidth="250"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto" MinHeight="60"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto" MinHeight="60"/>
                                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto" MinHeight="60"/>
                                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Currently}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock Margin="15,20,15,10" Text="{Binding ShareStatus}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemInfoLightTextBlockStyle}"/>

                                <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Text="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_LabelCreator}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Margin="15,20,15,10" Text="{Binding Creator}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemInfoLightTextBlockStyle}"/>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="Text_Popularity" Grid.Row="2" Text="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_LabelRating}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <ProgressBar x:Name="Value_Popularity" Grid.Row="2" Margin="15,20,15,0" Value="{Binding Popularity}" Style="{StaticResource PopularityRatingStarsProgressBarStyle}"/>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="Text_DownloadCount" Grid.Column="1" Text="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_NumberDownloads}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="Value_DownloadCount" Grid.Column="1" Margin="15,20,15,10" Text="{Binding DownloadCount}" Style="{StaticResource CurationStatsTextBlockStyle}"/>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="Text_LikeCount" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" Text="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_NumberLikes}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="Value_LikeCount" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" Margin="15,20,15,10" Text="{Binding LikeCount}" Style="{StaticResource CurationStatsTextBlockStyle}"/>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="Text_UseCount" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="2" Text="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_NumberUses}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="Value_UseCount" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="2" Margin="15,20,15,10" Text="{Binding UseCount}" Style="{StaticResource CurationStatsTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>  
                        
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_FileDescriptionContainer" Grid.Row="2">
                            <TextBlock Margin="0,10,15,0" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Description}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            <local:ScrollingTextBlock Margin="0,30,15,0" Style="{StaticResource ScrollingTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Description}"/>
                        </Grid>

                        <ProgressBar x:Name="LoadDataIndicator" IsIndeterminate="True" Style="{StaticResource SpinnyProgressStyle}" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Visibility="{Binding HasItems, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>
                    </Grid>
                
                    <local:CommonListBox x:Name="Menu" Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource VerticalMenuStyle}" ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource DialogVerticalMenuListBoxItemStyle}"/>
                    
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </ContentControl>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <!-- Buttons added in code -->
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_GlassBg" TargetName="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="LoadDataEventFire" TargetName="LoadDataIndicator"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page
	xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
	xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"

	x:Class="ForzaUI.F606_RateDialog"
	x:Name="Page"
	WindowTitle="Page"
	FlowDirection="LeftToRight"	>
	
    <Page.Resources>
			
        <Style x:Key="StarRatingSliderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
			<Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="true"/>
			<Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
            <Setter Property="Maximum" Value="5"/> 
            <Setter Property="Ticks" Value="1,2,3,4,5"/>             
            <Setter Property="IsSnapToTickEnabled" Value="True"/>  
            <Setter Property="Template">
            	<Setter.Value>
            		<ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
            			<ControlTemplate.Resources>
            				<Style x:Key="ArrowPathStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Path}">
                        		<Setter Property="StrokeStartLineCap" Value="Round"/>
                        		<Setter Property="StrokeEndLineCap" Value="Round"/>
                        		<Setter Property="StrokeLineJoin" Value="Round"/>
                        		<Setter Property="Stretch" Value="Fill"/>
                        		<Setter Property="StrokeThickness" Value="3"/>
                        		<Setter Property="Stroke" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Height" Value="24"/>
                                <Setter Property="Width" Value="12"/>
                                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="22,0"/>
                        	</Style>  
                            
                            <Style x:Key="StarImageStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Image}">
                            	<Setter Property="Stretch" Value="None"/>
                                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="8,0"/>
                            </Style>              			
            			</ControlTemplate.Resources>
            			<Grid>
            				<Border x:Name="TrackBackground">
            				    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
            				    	<Path x:Name="LeftArrow" Data="M380.625,396L363,421.065L380.625,446.131" Style="{StaticResource ArrowPathStyle}"/>
                    				<Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Empty.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}"/>
                                    <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Empty.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}"/>
                                    <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Empty.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}"/>
                                    <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Empty.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}"/>
                                    <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Empty.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}"/>  
                                    <Path x:Name="RightArrow" Data="M297.1875,295.1807L314.8115,320.2457L297.1875,345.3117" Style="{StaticResource ArrowPathStyle}"/>     			
                    			</StackPanel>
            				</Border>
                            <Track x:Name="PART_Track">
                              <Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>
                                <RepeatButton Style="{StaticResource SliderButtonStyle}" Command="Slider.DecreaseLarge" />
                              </Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>
                              <Track.IncreaseRepeatButton>
                                <RepeatButton Style="{StaticResource SliderButtonStyle}" Command="Slider.IncreaseLarge" />
                              </Track.IncreaseRepeatButton>

            				<StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="56,0">
            					<Image x:Name="S1" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Full.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}" Visibility="Hidden"/>
            					<Image x:Name="S2" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Full.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}" Visibility="Hidden"/>
            					<Image x:Name="S3" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Full.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}" Visibility="Hidden"/>
            					<Image x:Name="S4" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Full.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}" Visibility="Hidden"/>
            					<Image x:Name="S5" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Star_Full.png" Style="{StaticResource StarImageStyle}" Visibility="Hidden"/>              			
            				</StackPanel>
            			</Grid>
            			<ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            				<Trigger Property="Value" Value="0">
            					<Setter TargetName="LeftArrow" Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
            				</Trigger>
            				<Trigger Property="Value" Value="1">
            					<Setter TargetName="S1" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
            				</Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="Value" Value="2">
            					<Setter TargetName="S1" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S2" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
            				</Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="Value" Value="3">
            					<Setter TargetName="S1" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S2" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S3" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
            				</Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="Value" Value="4">
            					<Setter TargetName="S1" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S2" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S3" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S4" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
            				</Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="Value" Value="5">
            					<Setter TargetName="S1" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S2" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S3" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S4" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="S5" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="RightArrow" Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
            				</Trigger>
            			</ControlTemplate.Triggers>                            
            		</ControlTemplate>                	
            	</Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
			</Style>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"><!-- Template :  v1 05.07.13 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>

                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_DarkenBG">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="144"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="144"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.3,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline><!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn : v1 05.07.13 -->

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="RateContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.417" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.584" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard> <!-- TransitionIn -->

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"><!-- Template :  v1 05.07.13 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_BlurBG">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_DarkenBG">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">

                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>

            </ParallelTimeline><!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut : v1 05.07.13 -->

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="RateContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>
    </Page.Resources>

    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" FocusManager.FocusedElement="{Binding ElementName=StarRating}" Opacity="0">

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F620_CreatorsLeaderboard"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column0Width">95</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column1Width">456</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column2Width">190</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column3Width">156</GridLength>
        <GridLength x:Key="Column4Width">487</GridLength>
        
        <Style x:Key="CreatorLeaderboardListItemContainerStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource PanelBackgroundBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnKeyDownStory" FillBehavior="Stop" Duration="0:0:0.1">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="PressIndicator">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,2" Height="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderHeight}">
                            <Rectangle x:Name="ItemBackground" Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
                            <Grid x:Name="RowContent">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column0Width}"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column1Width}"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column2Width}"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column3Width}"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource Column4Width}"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="FocusIndicator" Grid.ColumnSpan="7" Fill="{StaticResource RedMenuHighlightBrush}" Opacity="0"/>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="PositionValueText" Text="{Binding Position}" Style="{StaticResource GridDarkTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="GamertagValueText" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Gamertag}" Style="{StaticResource GridDarkTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="PointsValueText" Grid.Column="2" Text="{Binding Score}" Style="{StaticResource GridDarkTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="DateValueText" Grid.Column="3" Text="{Binding RaceDate}" Style="{StaticResource GridDarkTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Foreground}"/>

                                <Rectangle Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle Grid.Column="3" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                             <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" TargetName="FocusIndicator" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CreatorLeaderboardListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBox}">
                        <Border Background="{x:Null}">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <ScrollViewer Focusable="False" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Visible">
                                <VirtualizingStackPanel Orientation="Vertical" IsItemsHost="True"/>
                            </ScrollViewer>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F730_PhotoMode"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
      xmlns:ed="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/2010/drawing"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <local:NumUnitConverter x:Key="NumUnitConverter0" FractionDigits="0"/>
        <local:NumUnitConverter x:Key="NumUnitConverter1" FractionDigits="1"/>
        <local:NumUnitConverter x:Key="TelephotoConverter" FractionDigits="1" FormatString="InGame.IDS_Photo_Mode_Zoom_Fmt"/>
        
        <local:LinearTransformConverter x:Key="EffectSettingScaleUp" Scale="100"/>
        
        <System:Double x:Key="Double_MeasurementNumberWidth">50</System:Double>
        
        <Style x:Key="PhotoTelemetryLabelTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type local:FastTextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Baksheesh"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="PhotoTelemetryDataTextBlockStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Baksheesh"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="TextBlock.RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="BlackFocusBracketsPathStyle" TargetType="Path">
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="37"/>
            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="StrokeThickness" Value="4"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="56"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="WhiteFocusBracketsPathStyle" TargetType="Path">
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CameraEffectsSliderThumbStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource TuningAdjustSliderThumbStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                        <Grid Margin="-6,5,-6,0" Height="8" Width="10">
                            <Path Data="M0,0 L-3,9 3,9 z" Fill="{DynamicResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" Height="8" Width="10" Stretch="Fill"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CameraEffectsSliderFocusedThumbStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource TuningHistorySliderThumbStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                        <Grid Margin="-6,5,-6,0" Height="8" Width="10">
                            <Path Data="M0,0 L-3,9 3,9 z" Fill="{DynamicResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Height="8" Width="10" Stretch="Fill"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="PhotoTelemetrySmallTitleLeftContentControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Container" MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleHeight}">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                               <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                               <ColumnDefinition/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Label" Text="{TemplateBinding Content}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetryLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="PictureModeSpinnerControl" TargetType="{x:Type local:SpinnerControl}">
            <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="66"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,14"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="202"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:SpinnerControl}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Style x:Key="ArrowPathStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Path}">
                                <Setter Property="StrokeStartLineCap" Value="Round"/>
                                <Setter Property="StrokeEndLineCap" Value="Round"/>
                                <Setter Property="StrokeLineJoin" Value="Round"/>
                                <Setter Property="Stretch" Value="Fill"/>
                                <Setter Property="StrokeThickness" Value="4"/>
                                <Setter Property="Stroke" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Width" Value="12"/>
                                <Setter Property="Height" Value="25"/>
                                <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
                                <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                                    <Setter.Value>
                                        <TransformGroup>
                                            <ScaleTransform/>
                                            <SkewTransform/>
                                            <RotateTransform/>
                                            <TranslateTransform/>
                                        </TransformGroup>
                                    </Setter.Value>
                                </Setter>
                            </Style>
                            
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnGotFocus1">
                                <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Arrows">
                                    <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                                </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Arrows">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Text">
                                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnNextRight">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_R">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.067" Value="8"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.133" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnPrevLeft">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_L">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.067" Value="-8"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.133" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_LayoutRoot" FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="LeftArrowStateGroup">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="LeftDisabled">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_L">
                                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.3"/>
                                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="LeftEnabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="RightArrowStateGroup">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="RightDisabled">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_R">
                                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.3"/>
                                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="RightEnabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition MinWidth="178"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                <RowDefinition/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="PART_Label" Grid.ColumnSpan="2" Margin="20,10,20,0" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDs_Photo_Label_Presets}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" TextWrapping="NoWrap"/>
                            <Viewbox x:Name="Viewbox_FitText" Grid.Row="1" Margin="20,0,0,0" Width="Auto" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Top" StretchDirection="DownOnly">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="PART_Text" Grid.Row="1" Width="{Binding ActualWidth, ElementName=Rectangle_SpinnerTextWidth}" Text="{Binding SelectedItem, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"
                                    Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemInfoLightTextBlockStyle}" TextWrapping="NoWrap" Margin="0"/>
                            </Viewbox>
                            
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Arrows" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,0,15,0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Top" UseLayoutRounding="False" Orientation="Horizontal" Visibility="Visible" Opacity="0">
                                <Path x:Name="Path_Arrow_L" Data="M380.625,396L363,421.065L380.625,446.131" Style="{StaticResource ArrowPathStyle}" Margin="0,0,5,0"/>
                                <Path x:Name="Path_Arrow_R" Data="M297.1875,295.1807L314.8115,320.2457L297.1875,345.3117" Style="{StaticResource ArrowPathStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                        
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:SpinnerControl.PrevSel">
                                <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource OnPrevLeft}"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:SpinnerControl.NextSel">
                                <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource OnNextRight}"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FocusManager.GotFocus">
                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="GotFocus1_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource OnGotFocus1}"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FocusManager.LostFocus">
                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="GotFocus1_BeginStoryboard"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <!-- ==================== Photo Effects Slider Style ==================== -->
        <Style x:Key="PhotoEffectsDecreaseSliderButtonStyle" TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
            <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                        <Border Background="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="PhotoEffectsDecreaseFocusedSliderButtonStyle" TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
            <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                        <Border Background="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}"/>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="PhotoEffectsIncreaseSliderButtonStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsDecreaseSliderButtonStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                        <Border Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="CamSetSliderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,4"/>
            <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="138"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
                        <Grid>
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Focused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Track Grid.Row="1" x:Name="PART_Track" Grid.Column="1">
                                <Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>
                                    <RepeatButton Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsDecreaseSliderButtonStyle}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}"/>
                                </Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>
                                <Track.Thumb>
                                    <Thumb Style="{StaticResource SliderThumbStyle}" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                                </Track.Thumb>
                                <Track.IncreaseRepeatButton>
                                    <RepeatButton Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsIncreaseSliderButtonStyle}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}"/>
                                </Track.IncreaseRepeatButton>
                            </Track>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="PhotoEffectsSliderStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource CamSetSliderStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
            <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,8,0,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="200"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Top"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Slider}">
                        <Grid>
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                    <VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                       <VisualTransition GeneratedDuration="0"/>
                                    </VisualStateGroup.Transitions>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Focused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Track x:Name="PART_Track">
                                <Track.DecreaseRepeatButton>

            <Path x:Name="BottomRightWhite" Data="F1M54,35L54,0 55,0 55,35 55,36 54,36 0,36 0,35z" Style="{StaticResource WhiteFocusBracketsPathStyle}" Canvas.Right="251" Canvas.Bottom="181"/>

            <Path x:Name="TopLeftBlack" Data="F1M1,1L1,37 0,37 0,1 0,0 1,0 56,0 56,1z" Style="{StaticResource BlackFocusBracketsPathStyle}" Canvas.Left="250" Canvas.Top="180"/>
            <Path x:Name="TopLeftWhite" Data="F1M1,1L1,36 0,36 0,1 0,0 1,0 55,0 55,1z" Style="{StaticResource WhiteFocusBracketsPathStyle}" Canvas.Left="251" Canvas.Top="181"/>

            <Path x:Name="TopRightBlack" Data="F1M55,1L55,37 56,37 56,1 56,0 55,0 0,0 0,1z" Style="{StaticResource BlackFocusBracketsPathStyle}" Canvas.Right="250" Canvas.Top="180"/>
            <Path x:Name="TopRightWhite" Data="F1M54,1L54,36 55,36 55,1 55,0 54,0 0,0 0,1z" Style="{StaticResource WhiteFocusBracketsPathStyle}" Canvas.Right="251" Canvas.Top="181"/>     	
        </Canvas>
        
        <Grid Canvas.Left="@S@" x:Name="Grid_FocusRing" Width="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}">
            <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/Camera_Crosshairs.png" Stretch="Uniform" Width="100" Height="100"/>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CameraTelemetry" Canvas.Left="@E:416:S:0@" Canvas.Bottom="180" Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack20Brush}">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="30,0,60,0">
                <ContentControl x:Name="AltitudeLabel" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Photo_Mode_Altitude_Label}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetrySmallTitleLeftContentControlStyle}"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Altitude" Text="{Binding CurrentSettings.Altitude, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter1}, ConverterParameter=length}" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                    Width="{StaticResource Double_MeasurementNumberWidth}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetryDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                <Slider x:Name="Slider_Altitude" Value="{Binding CurrentSettings.Altitude}" Style="{StaticResource CamSetSliderStyle}" Maximum="{Binding CurrentSettings.MaxAltitude}"/>
            </StackPanel>
            
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,60,0">
                <ContentControl x:Name="ZoomLabel" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Photo_Mode_XZoom_Label}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetrySmallTitleLeftContentControlStyle}"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Zoom" Text="{Binding CurrentSettings.TelephotoMultiplier, Converter={StaticResource TelephotoConverter}}" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                    Width="{StaticResource Double_MeasurementNumberWidth}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetryDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                <Slider x:Name="Slider_Zoom" Value="{Binding CurrentSettings.FOVRatio}" Style="{StaticResource CamSetSliderStyle}" Maximum="1.01" Margin="-15,0,0,4"/>
            </StackPanel>
            
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,60,0">
                <ContentControl x:Name="PitchLabel" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Photo_Mode_Pitch_Label}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetrySmallTitleLeftContentControlStyle}"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Pitch" Text="{Binding CurrentSettings.Pitch, ConverterParameter=angle, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter1}}" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                    Width="{StaticResource Double_MeasurementNumberWidth}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetryDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
            </StackPanel>
            
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,60,0">
                <ContentControl x:Name="YawLabel" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Photo_Mode_Yaw_Label}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetrySmallTitleLeftContentControlStyle}"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Yaw" Text="{Binding CurrentSettings.Yaw, ConverterParameter=angle, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter1}}" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                    Width="{StaticResource Double_MeasurementNumberWidth}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetryDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
            </StackPanel>
            
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="4" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,30,0">
                <ContentControl x:Name="RollLabel" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Photo_Mode_Roll_Label}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetrySmallTitleLeftContentControlStyle}"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Roll" Text="{Binding CurrentSettings.Roll, ConverterParameter=angle, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter1}}" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                    Width="{StaticResource Double_MeasurementNumberWidth}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoTelemetryDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CameraEffects" Canvas.Right="@E:30:S:0@" Canvas.Bottom="180" Width="360" IsEnabled="False" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained">
            <Grid.RenderTransform>
                <TransformGroup>
                    <ScaleTransform/>
                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                   <TranslateTransform X="390"/>
                </TransformGroup>
            </Grid.RenderTransform>
            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_BG"  Style="{StaticResource ClearGlassLow_FZMaterialStyle}" Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack20Color}" Height="{Binding ElementName=StackPanel_CameraEffects, Path=ActualHeight}"/>
            
            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CameraEffects">
                <local:SpinnerControl ItemsSource="{Binding Presets}" SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedPresetIndex}" Style="{StaticResource PictureModeSpinnerControl}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_ShutterSpeed}" Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.ShutterSpeed}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Focus}"        Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Focus}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Aperture}"     Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Aperture}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Exposure}"     Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Exposure}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Contrast}"     Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Contrast}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Color}"        Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Color}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Brightness}"   Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Brightness}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Sepia}"        Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Sepia}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_Vignette}"     Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentControlStyle}"        DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.Vignette}"/>
                <ContentControl Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Label_WaterOnLens}"  Style="{StaticResource PhotoEffectsContentZeroOneControlStyle}" DataContext="{Binding CurrentSettings.WaterOnLens}" Visibility="{Binding IsWetScenario, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonA" Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_TakePhoto}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonB" Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Exit}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonX" Button="X" Description="{Binding XButtonDescription}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonY" Button="Y" Description="{Binding YButtonDescription}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonBack" Button="Back" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_HideUI}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonLBumper" Button="LBumper" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_ToggleHeadlights}" />
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="ButtonRBumper" Button="RBumper" Description="{Binding RBumperDescription}" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Image x:Name="Image_WatermarkLogo" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Logo_FM.png" Stretch="Fill" Width="360" Canvas.Right="@E:114:S:0@" Canvas.Top="84" Visibility="Visible"/><!-- default Visibility="Visible" -->
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_AltitudeLabel" TargetName="AltitudeLabel"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_ZoomLabel" TargetName="ZoomLabel"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_PitchLabel" TargetName="PitchLabel"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_YawLabel" TargetName="YawLabel"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_RollLabel" TargetName="RollLabel"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
