<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F800_Profile"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <System:Double x:Key="PanelHeight">536</System:Double>
        
        <local:DriveTrainConverter x:Key="DriveTrainConverter"/>
        
        <Style x:Key="ProfileDataHeaderTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="16"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,24,0,4"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="ProfileDataTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemInfoLightTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="ProfileLargeDataTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="22"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,20"/>
        </Style>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueOut -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Header" Style="{StaticResource HeaderGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_MyProfile}" Style="{StaticResource HeaderContentControlStyle}"/>
            
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_CareerBar" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarContentControlStyle}">
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CareerBar" Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_PiggyBank" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarItemGridStyle}">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CreditsProgress" Tag="{Binding TokensEnabled}" Style="{StaticResource CreditsPiggyBankGridStyle}">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowA}"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowB}"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CreditsProgressTitle" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_BankCredits}" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarTitleStyle}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CreditsProgressNumber" Text="{Binding PlayerCredits, ConverterParameter=money, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" 
                                Style="{StaticResource CareerBarNumberStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_BankTokens" Tag="{Binding TokensEnabled}" Style="{StaticResource TokensPiggyBankGridStyle}" 
                            Visibility="{Binding TokensEnabled, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowA}"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource CareerBarItemRowB}"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_BankTokensLabel" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_BankTokens}" Style="{StaticResource CareerBarTitleStyle}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_BankTokens" Text="{Binding PlayerTokens, ConverterParameter=tokenmoney, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" 
                                Style="{StaticResource CareerBarNumberStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </StackPanel>
            </ContentControl>
            
            <ScrollViewer x:Name="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer" Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuScrollViewerStyle}">
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_MenuContainer" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Button x:Name="Button_Affinity"
                        Content="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Affinity_UpperCase}"
                        Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuLeftEndButtonStyle}"/>
                    <Button x:Name="Button_MyStats"
                        Content="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_PlayerStats_Uppercase}"
                        Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuButtonStyle}"/>
                    <Button x:Name="Button_MyDrivatar"
                        Content="{local:Loc MainMenu.IDS_MyDrivatar}"
                        Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuButtonStyle}"/>
                    <Button x:Name="Button_TeamCredits"
                        Content="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Credits}"
                        Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuButtonStyle}"/>
                    <Button x:Name="Button_Help"
                        Content="{local:Loc PauseMenu.IDS_Help}"
                        Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuButtonStyle}"/>
                    <Button x:Name="Button_SwitchProfile"
                        Content="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_SwitchProfile}"
                        Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuRightEndButtonStyle}"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </ScrollViewer>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_BodyContent">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="552"/><!-- description -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><!-- list -->
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_LFTPanelBg">
                        <Rectangle.Fill>
                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0.5,0" EndPoint="0.5,1">
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset="0"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack00Color}" Offset="1"/>
                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                        </Rectangle.Fill>
                    </Rectangle>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Description" Margin="96,60,20,0">
                        <Control x:Name="Control_PlayerCard" Style="{StaticResource ProfilePlayerCardStyle}" DataContext="{Binding LobbyPlayerData1}"/>
                        <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhite70Brush}" Height="1" Margin="0,40,0,0"/>
                        <StackPanel Margin="0,36,0,0">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PlayerStatsTitle" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Stats_Title}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Mileage">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_MileageLabel" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Milage}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Mileage" Text="{Binding DistanceDrivenText}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CurrentLevel">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CurrentLevelLabel" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Current_Level}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CurrentLevel" DataContext="{Binding LobbyPlayerData1}" Text="{Binding Level, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_TotalXp">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TotalXpLabel" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_TotalXP}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TotalXp" Text="{Binding TotalXP}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_XpToNext">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_XpToNextLabel" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_XpToNextLevel}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_XpToNext" Text="{Binding XPToNextLevel}" Style="{StaticResource ProfileDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </StackPanel>
                    
                    <StackPanel x:Name="MidPanel_CarInfo" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="22,48,380,0" Grid.Column="1">
                        <Viewbox x:Name="Viewbox_ModelName" StretchDirection="DownOnly" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Height="46" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Model" Text="{Binding ModelName}" FontSize="29" Margin="0"
                                Style="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Viewbox>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Year" Text="{Binding ModelYear}" FontSize="21"
                                Style="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Manufacturer" Text="{Binding ManufacturerName}" FontSize="21"
                                Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}" Style="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,0,0,0"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <Image x:Name="Image_CountryFlag" Source="{Binding ManufacturerCountryFlagPath}"
                            VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Height="24" Margin="0,10,0,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_CenterPanel" Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <Image x:Name="Image_PlayerCar" Source="{Binding CarImage}" Width="816" Height="459" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="130,0,0,0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5"><Image.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="@K@"/></Image.RenderTransform></Image>
                    </Grid>
                    
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_RightPanel" Grid.Column="1" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,60,130,0">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_ClassDrivetrain" Grid.Row="1" Width="240">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- Badge -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/><!-- PI -->
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/><!-- Drivetrain -->
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_CarClassBg" Style="{StaticResource CarClassColorRectangleStyle}" 
                                Fill="{Binding CarClassID, Converter={StaticResource CarClassConverter}}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CarClass" Style="{StaticResource CarClassTextBlockStyle}"
                                Text="{Binding CarClassID, Converter={StaticResource CarClassConverter}}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CarPI" Style="{StaticResource CarClassPiTextBlockStyle}"
                                Text="{Binding CarPerformanceIndex, Converter={StaticResource PIConverter}}"/>

<Page x:Name="Page" 
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F803_PlayerCardTitleSelect"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <local:PlayerCardData x:Key="PlayerCardData"/>
        
        <DataTemplate x:Key="TitleCategoryItemTemplate">
            <DataTemplate.Resources>
                <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStoryboard" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientColor}" KeySpline="0,0,0.5,1"/>
                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.2" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}" KeySpline="0,0,0.5,1"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory">
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusBackground">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value=".3"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_ItemText">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusKeyTime}" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusBackground">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.1"/>
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory">
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusBackground">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="0"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="0"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_ItemText">
                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusKeyTime}" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostBlack90Color}"/>
                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleY)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusBackground">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ItemFocusedKeyTime}" Value="0.1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
                <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
                </Storyboard>
            </DataTemplate.Resources>
            <Canvas x:Name="OuterContainer" Width="300" Height="38">
                <Grid x:Name="Container" Width="300" Height="38" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                       <RowDefinition Height="34"/>
                       <RowDefinition Height="4"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusBackground" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Opacity="0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,1">
                        <Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                    </Rectangle>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusIndicator" Grid.Row="1" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaFocusBrush}" Opacity="0"/>
                    <StackPanel Grid.RowSpan="2" Orientation="Horizontal" ClipToBounds="True">
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ItemText" Text="{Binding CategoryName}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeaderLightNoWrapTextBlockStyle}"
                             Margin="15,0,10,0" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="24" TextWrapping="NoWrap" Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostBlack90Brush}"/>
                        <Control Style="{StaticResource NewBoxControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding IsNew, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </Canvas>
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding (Selector.IsSelected), RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" Value="True">
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="HideSelected_BeginStoryboard2" HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource DeselectItemStory}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="ShowSelected_BeginStoryboard2" HandoffBehavior="SnapshotAndReplace" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                        <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStoryboard}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate><!-- /TitleCategoryItemTemplate -->
        
        <Style x:Key="TitleOptionScrollViewerStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ScrollViewer}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ScrollViewer}">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="auto" />
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ScrollContentPresenter x:Name="PART_ScrollContentPresenter" ClipToBounds="true"
                               Content="{TemplateBinding Content}" CanContentScroll="{TemplateBinding ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll}" Margin="0"/>
                            <ScrollBar x:Name="PART_VerticalScrollBar" Orientation="Vertical" Grid.Column="1" Width="9"
                               Minimum="0" Maximum="{TemplateBinding ScrollableHeight}" Value="{TemplateBinding VerticalOffset}"
                               ViewportSize="{TemplateBinding ViewportHeight}" Visibility="{TemplateBinding ComputedVerticalScrollBarVisibility}" Margin="10,0,6,0"/> 
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="TitleOptionListBoxStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:CommonListBox}">
                        <Border Background="{x:Null}">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="ValidationStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Valid"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidFocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="InvalidUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <ScrollViewer Focusable="False" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Style="{StaticResource TitleOptionScrollViewerStyle}">
                                <VirtualizingStackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Vertical" VirtualizationMode="Recycling"/>
                            </ScrollViewer>
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        <Style x:Key="TitleOptionListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,2,0,0"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="35"/>
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStory"  RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_FocusGlow">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.8" Value="0.15" KeySpline="0.5,0,1,1"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.6" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.5,1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        
                        <Grid Background="{StaticResource LightestGray80Brush}">
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusIndicator" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaDarkRedBrush}" Opacity="0"/>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_FocusGlow" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaRedBrush}" Opacity="0"/>
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TitleOption" Margin="15,0,10,0" Text="{Binding TitleString}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderDarkTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <Control Style="{StaticResource NewBoxControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding IsNew, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                        
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="Selector.IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow" Storyboard="{StaticResource FocusGlowStory}"/>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" TargetName="Rectangle_FocusIndicator" Value="1"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" TargetName="TextBlock_TitleOption">
                                    <Setter.Value>
                                        <SolidColorBrush Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                                    </Setter.Value>
                                </Setter>
                                
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_FocusGlow"/>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>

            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->

                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_PlayerCard">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.267" Value="0"/>

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_LeftFillerPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="BadgeTitleItemList">

                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0"/>

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_RightPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueIn">

                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_PlayerCard">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.267" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_LeftFillerPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="BadgeTitleItemList">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.633" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_RightPanel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.533" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">

                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_TitleOptionListContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>

            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Control_PlayerCard">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_TitleOptionListContainer">

                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0"/>

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_HeaderSubTitle">

    <Page.Triggers>
        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:ItemsSelector.PrevSel">
            <BeginStoryboard>
                <Storyboard>
                    <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectPrevEventFire">
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="SelectPrev"/>
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value=""/>
                    </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
            </BeginStoryboard>
        </EventTrigger>
        <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:ItemsSelector.NextSel">
            <BeginStoryboard>
                <Storyboard>
                    <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="SelectNextEventFire">
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="SelectNext"/>
                        <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value=""/>

                        <ColumnDefinition Width="80"/>

                        SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedCategoryIndex}">
                        <local:ItemsSelector.Template>
                            <ControlTemplate>
                                <!-- Padding="(ItemWidth + MaxSceneWidth) / 2" -->
                                <local:VirtualizingScrollPanel Padding="900,0,0,0" ItemHeight="38" ItemWidth="300" IsItemsHost="True" SlideDuration="{StaticResource SlideDurationTimeSpan}"/> 
                            </ControlTemplate>
                        </local:ItemsSelector.Template>
                    </local:ItemsSelector>
                    
                    <Control x:Name="RightBumperArrow" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource RightBumperIndicatorStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectNext, ElementName=CategoryList}"/>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}" DataContext="{Binding SelectedItem, ElementName=ItemList}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid>
                    <Control x:Name="Control_PlayerCard"  Style="{StaticResource ProfilePlayerCardStyle}" DataContext="{StaticResource PlayerCardData}" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="80,46,0,0"/>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_TitleOptionListContainer" Height="479" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Margin="@E:0:F:0:-1@,136,@E:0:F:0:-1@,0">

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F860_GameOptions" 
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"

      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="TabSpinnerControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:SpinnerControl}">
            <Setter Property="local:Audio.PlayFocusSound" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="34"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:SpinnerControl}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Style x:Key="ArrowPathStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Path}">
                                <Setter Property="Stretch" Value="Fill"/>
                                <Setter Property="StrokeThickness" Value="3"/>
                                <Setter Property="Stroke" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaFocusBrush}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Width" Value="12"/>
                                <Setter Property="Height" Value="20"/>
                                <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
                                <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                                    <Setter.Value>
                                        <TransformGroup>
                                            <ScaleTransform/>
                                            <SkewTransform/>
                                            <RotateTransform/>
                                            <TranslateTransform/>
                                        </TransformGroup>
                                    </Setter.Value>
                                </Setter>
                            </Style>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnGotFocus">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Arrows">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <ParallelTimeline RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Text">
                                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Label">
                                        <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                        <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                    </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                </ParallelTimeline>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="IsLockedOnGotFocus">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Arrows">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(TextElement.Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Text">
                                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnNextRight">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_R">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.067" Value="8"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.133" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="OnPrevLeft">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_L">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.067" Value="-8"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.133" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_LayoutRoot" FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False">
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="LeftArrowStateGroup">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="LeftDisabled">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_L">
                                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.15"/>
                                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="LeftEnabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="RightArrowStateGroup">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="RightDisabled">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Path_Arrow_R">
                                                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.15"/>
                                            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="RightEnabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource TabMenuBumperWidth}"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource TabMenuViewWidth}"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource TabMenuBumperWidth}"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_ButtonBg" Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource TabMenuButtonBgContentControlStyle}"/>
                            
                            <TextBlock x:Name="PART_Text" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding SelectedItem, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"  
                                Style="{StaticResource HorizontalMenuTextBlockStyle}" >
                                <TextBlock.Foreground>
                                    <SolidColorBrush Color="{DynamicResource AlmostWhiteColor}"/>
                                </TextBlock.Foreground>
                            </TextBlock>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Arrows" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="30,0" Opacity="0"><!-- Right arrow not working correctly. Hiding both. -->
                                <Path x:Name="Path_Arrow_L" Data="M380.625,396L363,421.065L380.625,446.131" Style="{StaticResource ArrowPathStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
                                <Path x:Name="Path_Arrow_R" Data="M297.1875,295.1807L314.8115,320.2457L297.1875,345.3117" Style="{StaticResource ArrowPathStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Right"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled">
                                <Trigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>False</System:Boolean>
                                </Trigger.Value>
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsLocked">
                                <Trigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </Trigger.Value>
                                <Setter TargetName="PART_Text" Property="TextBlock.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource MidGrayBrush}"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="Grid_Arrows" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:SpinnerControl.PrevSel">
                                <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource OnPrevLeft}"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                            <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="local:SpinnerControl.NextSel">
                                <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource OnNextRight}"/>
                            </EventTrigger>
                            <MultiTrigger>
                                <MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Property="IsFocused" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Property="IsLocked" Value="False"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                <MultiTrigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="GotFocus_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource OnGotFocus}"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.EnterActions>
                                <MultiTrigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="GotFocus_BeginStoryboard"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.ExitActions>
                            </MultiTrigger>
                            <MultiTrigger>
                                <MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                    <Condition Property="IsFocused" Value="True"/>
                                    <Condition Property="IsLocked" Value="True"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.Conditions>
                                <MultiTrigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="IsLockedGotFocus_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource IsLockedOnGotFocus}"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.EnterActions>
                                <MultiTrigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="IsLockedGotFocus_BeginStoryboard"/>
                                </MultiTrigger.ExitActions>
                            </MultiTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- TabSpinnerControlStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="SpinnerControlFullScreenStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Type local:SpinnerControl}}" TargetType="{x:Type local:SpinnerControl}">

    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ShowCarsText" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowCarCountStory}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HideCarsText" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideCarCountStory}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
            <VisualStateGroup x:Name="TabsVisualStateGroup">
                <VisualState x:Name="ShowTabsVisualState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_TabMenu">
                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="HideTabsVisualState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_TabMenu">
                            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_MultiplayerHostOnly">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
            </VisualStateGroup>
        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Header" Style="{StaticResource HeaderGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_GameOptions}" Style="{StaticResource HeaderContentControlStyle}"/>
            
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_TabMenu" Style="{StaticResource TabMenuContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_TabMenu" Margin="{StaticResource TabMenuMargin}">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource TabMenuBumperWidth}"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource TabMenuViewWidth}"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource TabMenuBumperWidth}"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="TabbedMenu" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Style="{DynamicResource TabSpinnerControlStyle}"
                        ItemsSource="{Binding MenuItems}" SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedTab}"/>
                    <Control x:Name="LeftBumperArrow" Style="{StaticResource LeftBumperIndicatorStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectPrev, ElementName=TabbedMenu}"/>
                    <Control x:Name="RightBumperArrow" Style="{StaticResource RightBumperIndicatorStyle}" IsEnabled="{Binding CanSelectNext, ElementName=TabbedMenu}"/>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid><!-- /Grid_Header -->
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CarAvailable" Width="476" Canvas.Right="@S@" Height="{StaticResource SceneHeaderHeight}" Opacity="0">
            <TextBlock x:Name="CarsAvailableTitle" Text="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_Cars_Available}" 
                Style="{StaticResource ProgressTitleStyle}" Margin="0,97,0,0"/>
            <TextBlock x:Name="CarsAvailableText" Text="{Binding GarageCarCount}"
                Style="{StaticResource ProgressNumberStyle}" Margin="0,111,0,93"/>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_BodyContent">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource OptionsDescriptionPanelWidth}"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_MultiplayerHostOnly" Text="{local:Loc Assists.IDS_HostOnlyDisclaimer}" Style="{StaticResource OptionsDescriptionTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="#FFFFD900" Margin="130,17,30,15"/>
                    
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_DescriptionPanelBg" Style="{StaticResource OptionsMidPanelBgStyle}"/>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_OptionsList" Margin="107,42,34,0">
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_HeaderOptions" Content="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Options}" Style="{StaticResource AssitsOptionsHeaderControlStyle}"/>
                        <local:CommonListBox x:Name="OptionsList" Style="{StaticResource OptionsListBoxStyle}"
                            ItemsSource="{Binding OptionList}" ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource OptionsListBoxItemStyle}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                            <local:CommonListBox.RenderTransform>
                                <TransformGroup>
                                    <ScaleTransform/>
                                    <SkewTransform/>
                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                    <TranslateTransform/>
                                </TransformGroup>
                            </local:CommonListBox.RenderTransform>
                        </local:CommonListBox>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_InfoPanelRight" Grid.Column="1" Margin="11,42,0,0">
                        <Grid Height="34">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TitleDescription" Text="{local:Loc Assists.IDS_Title_Description}" Style="{StaticResource OptionsHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FocusedDescription" Text="{Binding CurrDesc}" Style="{StaticResource OptionsDescriptionTextBlockStyle}"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Accept}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Discard}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="Y" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_ResetDefault}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="X" Description="{local:Loc Lobby.IDS_OptionLoadSave}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!--local:EventFire x:Name="SelectPrevEventFire" TargetName="RightBumperArrow"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="SelectNextEventFire" TargetName="LeftBumperArrow"/-->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="Control_TabMenu"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
