<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F867_LanguageOptions"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
	  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
	  xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
   	  WindowTitle="Page"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">

    <Page.Resources>
        
        <Style x:Key="LanguageListBoxItemStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="FocusGlowStoryboard"/>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="SelectItemStory"/>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="DeselectItemStory"/>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="Container" Height="34" Margin="0,1,0,0">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="29"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" MinWidth="5"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Normal"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="MouseOver"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Disabled"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="SelectionStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unselected"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Selected"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="SelectedUnfocused"/>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="FocusStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Unfocused"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Focused">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <ParallelTimeline RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:FZMaterial.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="fZMaterial">
                                                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}"/>
                                                    <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow1KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextAmbientColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                                    <SplineColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ButtonFocusGlow2KeyTime}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusListTextColor}" KeySpline="{StaticResource PulseEaseInKeySpline}"/>
                                                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                            </ParallelTimeline>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_GlassBg" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack20Brush}"/>
                            <local:FZMaterial x:Name="fZMaterial" Width="220" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" ImageSource="{Binding ImagePath}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Reticle" Grid.ColumnSpan="3">
                                <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_FocusReticle" Style="{StaticResource OptFocusReticleContentControlStyle}"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Rectangle_GlassBg"/>
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="Grid_Reticle"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="SelectItemStory_BeginStoryboard" Storyboard="{StaticResource SelectItemStory}"/>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="SelectItemStory_BeginStoryboard"/>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                                <Setter Property="Panel.ZIndex" Value="5"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /LanguageListBoxItemStyle -->
            
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.7" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ContinueOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Body">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="ContinueOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_ContinueOut : v0 10.31.14 -->
        </Storyboard><!-- /ContinueOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="FadeToBlack">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Black">
            	<EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.33" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /FadeToBlack -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Black" Fill="Black" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Opacity="0" Panel.ZIndex="10"/>
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Header" Style="{StaticResource HeaderGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc ScreenTitles.IDS_LanguageOptions}" Style="{StaticResource HeaderContentControlStyle}"/>
        </Grid>

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_BodyContent">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource OptionsDescriptionPanelWidth}"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_OptionsBG" Style="{StaticResource OptionsMidPanelBgStyle}"/>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_OptionsList" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" Margin="107,42,34,0">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_HeaderLanguage" Height="32">
                            <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc MainMenu.IDS_Language}" Style="{StaticResource OptionsHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <local:CommonListBox x:Name="Menu" Width="1225"
                            Style="{StaticResource VerticalMenuStyle}" ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource LanguageListBoxItemStyle}"
                            ItemsSource="{Binding Languages}" SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedIndex}" />
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_InfoPanelRight" Grid.Column="1" Margin="11,42,0,0">
                        <Grid Height="34">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TitleDescription" Text="{local:Loc Assists.IDS_Title_Description}" Style="{StaticResource OptionsHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FocusedDescription" Text="{local:Loc MyProfile.IDS_Language_Desc}" Style="{StaticResource OptionsDescriptionTextBlockStyle}"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Accept}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Cancel}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Body" TargetName="Control_Body"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F872_PopupImageMenu"

        <Style x:Key="PopupImageMenuConditionalGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>

                </Trigger>

            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>

                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>

                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>

                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F878_UserContentSearchPopup"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}"
      Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="UserContentSearchPopupSpinnyProgressStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ProgressBar}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="Spin" RepeatBehavior="Forever">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[2].(RotateTransform.Angle)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Out">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1.133" Value="360"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid>
                            <VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                                <VisualStateGroup x:Name="CommonStates">
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Determinate"/>
                                    <VisualState x:Name="Indeterminate">
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Track">
                                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                            <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PART_Indicator">
                                                <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Collapsed}"/>
                                            </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </VisualState>
                                </VisualStateGroup>
                            </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <Border x:Name="PART_Track"/>
                            <Border x:Name="PART_Indicator"/>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_Out" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <Grid.RenderTransform>
                                    <TransformGroup>
                                        <ScaleTransform/>
                                        <SkewTransform/>
                                        <RotateTransform/>
                                        <TranslateTransform/>
                                    </TransformGroup>
                                </Grid.RenderTransform>
                                <Image x:Name="Image_OuterRing" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/LoadingSpinner_Lg.png"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSearching}">
                                <DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                                </DataTrigger.Value>
                                <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard x:Name="BeginStoryboard_Spin" Storyboard="{StaticResource Spin}"/>
                                </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                    <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="BeginStoryboard_Spin"/>
                                </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                            </DataTrigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsSearching}">
                    <DataTrigger.Value>
                        <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                    </DataTrigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template :  v0 12.18.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_GlassBg">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- /TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn : v0 12.18.14 -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_SpinnerContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.367" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.467" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template :  v0 12.18.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_GlassBg">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- /TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut : v0 12.18.14 -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_SpinnerContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxGlassBgContentControlStyle}">
             <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_ModalBoxBg" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_DialogBoxContainer" Style="{StaticResource DialogMessagePanelStyle}" Width="{StaticResource DialogSpinnerWidth}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- header -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- message -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- listbox -->
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Search}" Style="{StaticResource DialogHeaderStyle}"/>
                    
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_SpinnerContainer" Grid.Row="1" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" Visibility="{Binding Path=IsSearching, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}" 
                        Style="{StaticResource DialogMessagePanelStyle}" Width="{StaticResource DialogSpinnerWidth}">
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_LayersSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowLayers, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="LayersSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Layers}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding LayersOptions}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_MakeSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowMake, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="MakeSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Make}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding MakeOptions}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_ModelSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowModel, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="ModelSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Model}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding ModelOptions}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_EnvironmentSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowEnvironment, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="EnvironmentSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Environment}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding EnvironmentOptions}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_TrackSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowTrack, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="TrackSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_TrackLabel}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding TrackOptions}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_SuggestedLine" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowCarClass, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="CarClassSpinner" Label="{local:Loc CarFlow.IDS_CarFilter_CarClass}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding CarClassOptions}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Keyword1Spinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="Keyword1Spinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Keyword1}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding Keyword1Options}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Keyword2Spinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="Keyword2Spinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_Keyword2}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding Keyword2Options}"/>
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_CreatorSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="CreatorSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_LabelCreator}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthTextSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding LabelCreatorOptions}"/><!-- no arrows / player entered text -->
                        </ContentControl>
                        <ContentControl x:Name="Control_DescriptionSpinner" Style="{StaticResource AssistsOptionsControlStyle}">
                            <local:SpinnerControl x:Name="DescriptionSpinner" Label="{local:Loc Storefront.IDS_LabelDescription}" Style="{StaticResource DialogMidWidthTextSpinnerControlStyle}"
                                ItemsSource="{Binding LabelDescriptionOptions}"/><!-- no arrows / player entered text -->
                        </ContentControl>
                        <Button x:Name="Button_Menu" Content="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Search}" Style="{StaticResource DialogVerticalMenuButtonStyle}" Margin="0,30,0,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_MessageContainer" Grid.Row="1">
                        <ProgressBar x:Name="SearchingIndicator" Margin="30,20" Height="56" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center" Style="{StaticResource UserContentSearchPopupSpinnyProgressStyle}" IsIndeterminate="True" Width="42"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </ContentControl>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="B" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Back}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_GlassBg" TargetName="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F883_NascarCarSuggestion"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">

    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="UpsellBulletStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ListBoxItem}">
                    <Border>
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding }" FontFamily="Baksheesh" FontSize="20" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}" Margin="0,0,0,2"/>
                    </Border>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    <!-- /UpsellBulletStyle -->


    <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
        <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"-->
        <!-- Template :  v1 05.07.13 -->
        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_GlassBg">
            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Message">
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.417" Value="0"/>
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.584" Value="1"/>
        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ListBox_Menu">
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0"/>
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1"/>
        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <!--/ParallelTimeline-->
        <!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn : v1 05.07.13 -->
    </Storyboard>
    <!-- TransitionIn -->

    <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
        <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"-->
        <!-- Template :  v1 05.07.13 -->
        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_GlassBg">
            <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
        </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Message">
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ListBox_Menu">
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
        </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        <!--/ParallelTimeline-->
        <!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut : v1 05.07.13 -->
    </Storyboard>
    </Page.Resources>

    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxGlassBgContentControlStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_ModalBoxBg" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_DialogBoxContainer" Width="{StaticResource DialogMidWidth}" MaxHeight="{StaticResource DialogMaxHeight}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- header -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- message -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- menu -->
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{Binding Title}" Style="{StaticResource DialogHeaderStyle}"/>

                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_Message" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource DialogMessagePanelStyle}" Width="786" Margin="0,0,0,36">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="418"/><!-- image -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" /><!-- car details -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" MinHeight="92"/><!-- text -->
                            
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Image" ClipToBounds="True" Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}">
                            <Image x:Name="Image_BGImage" Source="{Binding CarBackground}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Height="458" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Image x:Name="Image_ThumbnailImage" Source="{Binding CarDetails.ImageLarge}" Stretch="UniformToFill" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5"><Image.RenderTransform><ScaleTransform ScaleX="@K@"/></Image.RenderTransform></Image>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CarDetails" Grid.Row="1" Margin="30,22,30,0">

                    </Grid>
                    <local:CommonListBox x:Name="ListBox_Menu" Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource VerticalMenuStyle}" ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource DialogVerticalMenuListBoxItemStyle}"/>

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

                <!-- Available states: AutocrossState, BowlingState, CatAndMouseState, DragState, DriftState, EliminationState, PassCarsState, PointToPointState, SoccerState,
                                       TagKeepState, TagPassState, TagVirusState, TimeTrialState and KeepItCleanState -->
                <VisualState x:Name="AutocrossState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="AutocrossAwardedContainer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="AutocrossPenaltyContainer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="BowlingState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="BowlingAwardedContainer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="DriftState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="BankedContainer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="AwardedContainer">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="EliminationState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="PlayerEliminatedNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="HurryNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="YouAreEliminatedNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="PassCarsState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="CarPassedNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="SoccerState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="RaceTimeNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
                <VisualState x:Name="TagVirusState">
                    <Storyboard>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="YouAreItNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                        <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="YouAreItVirusNotification">
                            <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                        </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    </Storyboard>
                </VisualState>
            </VisualStateGroup>
        </VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
        
        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_TopNotifications" Canvas.Left="@E:420:S:0@" Canvas.Top="70" Width="1080">
            <!-- RearViewMirror must be 480x160, Source texture is 3:1 = 768x256 -->
            <Rectangle x:Name="RearViewMirror" Width="480" Height="160" Margin="0,-18,0,0" Opacity="0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5"
                Visibility="{Binding ShowMirror, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                <Rectangle.Effect><!-- NOTE: Radius corners & anti-aliasing does not work with effects -->
                    <local:TextureMaskEffect Input="{StaticResource RearViewMirrorBrush}" Mask="{StaticResource RearViewMirrorMaskBrush}"/>
                </Rectangle.Effect>
                <Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform ScaleY="1" ScaleX="-1"/>
                        <SkewTransform AngleY="0" AngleX="0"/>
                        <RotateTransform Angle="0"/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Rectangle.RenderTransform>
            </Rectangle><!-- /RearViewMirror -->

                    <StackPanel.RenderTransform>

                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </StackPanel.RenderTransform>

                </StackPanel>
            </Grid><!-- /BeatRivalNotification -->
            
            <Grid x:Name="NextRivalNotification" Tag="{Binding ShowMirror}" MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDLargerTitleHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}"

                    <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Rivals_NextRivalIs}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>

                </StackPanel>
            </Grid><!-- /NextRivalNotification -->
            
            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Player1" DataContext="{Binding Player1}">

                    Visibility="{Binding IsTagVirus, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>

                    Visibility="{Binding IsTag, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>

                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>

                </Grid><!-- /BankedContainer -->
                
                <StackPanel x:Name="BowlingAwardedContainer" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" Opacity="0"
                    Visibility="{Binding IsBowling, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">

                    <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="BowlingAwardedText" Text="{Binding BowlCurrScore}" Style="{StaticResource HudScreenSpaceCurrPositionTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </StackPanel><!-- /BowlingAwardedContainer -->

                    <Grid x:Name="AutocrossAwardedContainer" Height="{StaticResource HUDLargerTitleHeight}" Opacity="0">

                        <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="AutocrossAwardedText" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_RaceMode_Gates_GatePassed}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>
                    </Grid>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="AutocrossPenaltyContainer" Opacity="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center">

                </Grid><!-- /AutocrossContainer -->

                            <ColumnDefinition Width="34"/><!-- right -->

                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_PitMissed_LFT" Background="{StaticResource AlmostBlack80Brush}" Visibility="{Binding PitLeft, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">

                        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_PitMissedBg" Grid.Column="1" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaDarkRed90Brush}"/>

                        </Grid>
                    </Grid><!-- /PitMissedNotification -->
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="PitMessageNotification" Height="34" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" 
                        Visibility="{Binding HavePitMessage, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="50"/><!-- left -->
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- message -->
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="50"/><!-- right -->
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_PitMessage_LFT" Visibility="{Binding PitLeft, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <Path Style="{StaticResource HudArrowLFTPathStyle}" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack80Brush}"/>
                            <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols_Nascar/Quickstop_Icon.png" Width="26" Height="26" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,4,0"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_PitMessageBg" Grid.Column="1" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack40Brush}"/>
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_PitMessage" Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="10,0">
                            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PitLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_PitIn}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PitDistance" Text="{Binding PitDistance}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}" Remeasure="True" FontFamily="Baksheesh HUD" Margin="0,6,0,0"/>
                            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PitDistanceUnits" Text="{Binding PitDistanceUnits}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_PitMessage" Text="{Binding PitMessage}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_PitMessage_RHT" Grid.Column="2" Visibility="{Binding PitLeft, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}">
                            <Path Style="{StaticResource HudArrowRHTPathStyle}" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack80Brush}"/>
                            <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols_Nascar/Quickstop_Icon.png" Width="26" Height="26" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid><!-- /PitMessageNotification -->
                </Grid><!-- /Grid_Quickstop -->
                
                <Grid x:Name="MergeMessageNotification" MinHeight="34" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" Opacity="0">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="50"/><!-- left -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- message -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="50"/><!-- right -->
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_MergeMessageBg" Grid.Column="1" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack40Brush}"/>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_MergeMessage" Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="10,0">
                        <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_MergeMessage" Text="{Binding MergeMessage}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>

                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_MergeMessage_LFT" Visibility="{Binding MergeLeft, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">

                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Grid.RenderTransform>
                        <Path Style="{StaticResource HudArrowLFTPathStyle}" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaQuickStopBrush}" Opacity=".8"/>
                        <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_DirtyLap_White.png" Width="24" Height="24" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,4,0"/>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_MergetMessage_RHT" Grid.Column="2" Visibility="{Binding MergeLeft, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                        <Grid.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </Grid.RenderTransform>
                        <Path Style="{StaticResource HudArrowRHTPathStyle}" Fill="{StaticResource ForzaQuickStopBrush}" Opacity=".8"/>
                        <Image Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_DirtyLap_White.png" Width="24" Height="24" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid><!-- /MergeMessageNotification -->
                
                <Grid x:Name="RaceTimeNotification" MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDLargerTitleHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" Opacity="0">
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_RaceTime_Background" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>                
                    <StackPanel x:Name="RaceTimeText" Orientation="Horizontal" RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5" FlowDirection="{Binding FlowDirection, ElementName=Page}">
                        <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                        <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding TimeLabel}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding TimeRemaining}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Grid><!-- /RaceTimeNotification -->
                
                <Grid x:Name="RaceCompletedNotification" MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDLargerTitleHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" Opacity="0">
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_RaceCompleted_Background" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>                           
                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Race_Completed}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </Grid><!-- /RaceCompletedNotification -->
                
                <Grid x:Name="PlayerEliminatedNotification" MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDLargerTitleHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" Opacity="0"
                    Visibility="{Binding IsElimination, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_PlayerEliminated_Background" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>
                    <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="PlayerEliminatedText" Text="{Binding EliminatedGamerTag}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </Grid><!-- /PlayerEliminatedNotification -->
                
                <ContentControl x:Name="HurryNotification" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_RaceMode_Elimination_Last_Place}" Style="{StaticResource HUDNotificationContentControlStyle}" 
                    Visibility="{Binding IsElimination, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                
                <ContentControl x:Name="YouAreEliminatedNotification" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_RaceMode_Elimination_Local_Player_Eliminated}" Style="{StaticResource HUDNotificationContentControlStyle}" 
                    Visibility="{Binding IsElimination, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                
                <Grid x:Name="OpponentQuitNotification" MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDLargerTitleHeight}" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="{StaticResource HudStackMargin}" Opacity="0">
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_OpponentQuit_Background" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>
                    <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="OpponentQuitText" Text="{Binding OpponentQuitMessage}" Style="{StaticResource HUDBodyTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </Grid><!-- /OpponentQuitNotification -->
                
                <ContentControl x:Name="CarPassedNotification" Content="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_RaceMode_Passing_CarPassed}" Style="{StaticResource HUDNotificationContentControlStyle}"
                    Visibility="{Binding IsPassingCars, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                
                <ContentControl x:Name="PitNotification" Tag="{Binding Pitting}" Style="{StaticResource HUDPitNotificationContentControlStyle}"/>

        </StackPanel><!-- /StackPanel_TopNotifications -->

        <local:CommonListBox x:Name="ListBox_HudArrows" ItemsSource="{Binding HudArrows}" Width="@W@" Height="1080" Background="White" Canvas.Left="0" Canvas.Bottom="100" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,1">

                    <SkewTransform/>
                    <RotateTransform/>
                    <TranslateTransform/>

                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_Rotation" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" VerticalAlignment="Stretch" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">

                                        <TransformGroup>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.Scenes.F901_HudBottomLeft" 
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns:converters="clr-namespace:ForzaUI.Converters"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:ed="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/2010/drawing" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      FlowDirection="LeftToRight">
        <!-- #################### Flow direction must be defined for Hebrew/Arabic #################### -->
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ShowPlaceStartLineStory">
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_LapsContainer">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="TransitionIn_Initial"/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.001" Value=""/>
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:9.5" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ShowPlaceStartLineStory -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="ShowSceneSlowStory">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_LapLabel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_Container_QuickStops">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_LapLabel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="144"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="TextBlock_QuickStopsLabel">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="354"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Lap">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_QuickStopsContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Lap">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="144"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="144"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_QuickStopsContainer">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="354"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="354"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.5" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!-- fade in ellipse earlier than other elements so that it appears to be the bg for "GO" -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Ellipse_MapBg">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.06" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Minimap">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:2.5" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ShowSceneSlowStory -->

        <Storyboard x:Key="ShowSceneFastStory">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /ShowSceneFastStory -->
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="HideAllStory">
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard><!-- /HideAllStory -->
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="CountdownGo" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowSceneSlowStory}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ShowFast" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowSceneFastStory}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HideAll" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideAllStory}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" Opacity="0">
        <Grid Visibility="{Binding ShowMinimap, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}" Canvas.Left="230" Canvas.Bottom="84">
            <Ellipse x:Name="Ellipse_MapBg" Fill="#1AFFFFFF" Height="215" Width="215"/>
            <local:MinimapRenderer x:Name="Minimap" Alpha="1.0" Height="215" Width="215"/>
        </Grid>
        
        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_LapContainer" Canvas.Left="211" Canvas.Top="714" Visibility="{Binding ShowLapContainer, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
            <Grid MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleHeight}" Style="{StaticResource ConditionalHudSmallerTitleGridStyle}" Tag="{Binding EndConUnits}">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                   <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                   <ColumnDefinition/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_LapBackground" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>
                
                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LapLabel" Text="{Binding EndConUnits}" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleTextBlockStyle}">
                    <local:FastTextBlock.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </local:FastTextBlock.RenderTransform>
                </local:FastTextBlock>
            </Grid>
            
            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Lap" Orientation="Horizontal">
                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                   <TransformGroup>
                       <ScaleTransform/>
                       <SkewTransform/>
                       <RotateTransform/>
                       <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding EndConCur}" Style="{StaticResource HUDCurrPositionTextBlockStyle}"/>
                <local:FastTextBlock Text="/" Margin="10,0,0,0" Style="{StaticResource SlashPositionsTextBlockStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowEndConditionSeparator, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding EndConFinal}" Margin="4,3,0,0" Style="{StaticResource TotalPositionsTextBlockStyle}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </StackPanel>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Container_QuickStops" Visibility="{Binding WrongWay, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}" Canvas.Left="411" Canvas.Top="714">
            <StackPanel Visibility="{Binding ShowQuickStops, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                <Grid MinHeight="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleHeight}" Style="{StaticResource ConditionalHudSmallerTitleGridStyle}" Tag="{Binding EndConUnits}">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_QuickStopsBackground" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>
                    
                    <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_QuickStopsLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_QuickStop}" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleTextBlockStyle}">
                        <local:FastTextBlock.RenderTransform>
                            <TransformGroup>
                                <ScaleTransform/>
                                <SkewTransform/>
                                <RotateTransform/>
                                <TranslateTransform/>
                            </TransformGroup>
                        </local:FastTextBlock.RenderTransform>
                    </local:FastTextBlock>
                </Grid>
                
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_QuickStopsContainer" Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <!-- Must remeasure because stops could be one or two digits -->
                    <local:FastTextBlock Style="{StaticResource HUDCurrPositionTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding QuickStops}" Remeasure="True"/>
                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="/" Margin="10,0,0,0" Style="{StaticResource SlashPositionsTextBlockStyle}"/>
                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding QuickStopsMax}" Margin="4,3,0,0" Style="{StaticResource TotalPositionsTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </StackPanel>
         </Grid>
        
        <Control Canvas.Left="340" Canvas.Bottom="310" Style="{StaticResource HUDWrongWayIndicatorControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding WrongWay}"/>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_LapsContainer" TargetName="StackPanel_LapContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
