<Page x:Name="Page" 
      x:Class="ForzaUI.Scenes.WPF.F902_HudTopLeft"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      Title="HUDTopLeftScene"
      FlowDirection="LeftToRight">
        <!-- #################### Flow direction must be defined for Hebrew/Arabic #################### -->
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <ResourceDictionary>
            
            
            <!-- Feat animation times -->
            <KeyTime x:Key="FeatsColorKeyTime1">0:0:0.3</KeyTime>
            <KeyTime x:Key="FeatsColorKeyTime2">0:0:0.5</KeyTime>
            <KeyTime x:Key="FeatsColorKeyTime3">0:0:0.7</KeyTime>
            
            <Style x:Key="SpeakingTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource HUDBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type local:FastTextBlock}">
                <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Baksheesh"/>
                <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource HUDWhiteBrush}"/>
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="10,0"/>
                <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup> 
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style><!-- /SpeakingTextBlockStyle -->
            
            <Style x:Key="MiniScoreboardControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                <Setter Property="Height" Value="24"/>
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,1"/>
                <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                            <Grid x:Name="Container" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Background="{StaticResource AlmostWhite00Brush}">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="42"/><!-- position -->
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/><!-- team -->
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="206"/><!-- driver -->
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="82"/><!-- gap -->
                                    <ColumnDefinition MinWidth="34"/><!-- gap units -->
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="24"/><!-- pitting icon -->
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Place" Tag="{Binding StyleTag}" Text="{Binding Place}"
                                    Style="{DynamicResource MiniScoreboardTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_TeamColor" Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,0,10,0" Width="5" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Visibility="Collapsed">
                                    <Rectangle.Fill>
                                        <SolidColorBrush Color="{Binding TeamColor}"/>
                                    </Rectangle.Fill>
                                </Rectangle>
                                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_GamerTag" Grid.Column="2" Tag="{Binding StyleTag}" Text="{Binding Gamertag}"
                                    Style="{DynamicResource MiniScoreboardTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Gap" Grid.Column="3" Tag="{Binding StyleTag}" Text="{Binding Score}" 
                                    Style="{DynamicResource MiniScoreboardNumTextBlockStyle}" Remeasure="True"/>
                                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_GapUnits" Grid.Column="4" Tag="{Binding StyleTag}" Text="{Binding ScoreUnits}" 
                                    Style="{DynamicResource MiniScoreboardTextBlockStyle}" Remeasure="True" Margin="2,0,0,0"/>
                                <Image x:Name="Image_Pitting" Grid.Column="5" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols_Nascar/Quickstop_Icon.png" 
                                    Margin="2" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Stretch="Uniform" Width="19" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                    Style="{DynamicResource HUDQuickstopIconImageStyle}"
                                    Visibility="{Binding IsPitting, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StyleTag}">
                                    <DataTrigger.Value>
                                        <System:Int32>0</System:Int32><!-- Disabled -->
                                    </DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="1" TargetName="Container"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StyleTag}">
                                    <DataTrigger.Value>
                                        <System:Int32>1</System:Int32><!-- Opponent -->
                                    </DataTrigger.Value>
                                </DataTrigger>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StyleTag}">
                                    <DataTrigger.Value>
                                        <System:Int32>2</System:Int32><!-- Player -->
                                    </DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="TextBlock_GapUnits"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StyleTag}">
                                    <DataTrigger.Value>
                                        <System:Int32>3</System:Int32><!-- Team -->
                                    </DataTrigger.Value>
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" TargetName="Rectangle_TeamColor"/>
                                    <!-- TODO: Remove the below setters after {Binding Score} & {Binding ScoreUnits} are both hooked up in Team scoring mode. -->
                                    <Setter Property="Style" Value="{DynamicResource MiniScoreboardTextBlockStyle}" TargetName="TextBlock_Gap"/>
                                    <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Right" TargetName="TextBlock_Gap"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" TargetName="TextBlock_GapUnits"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style><!-- /MiniScoreboardControlStyle -->
            
            
            <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionOut -->
            
            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowPlaceStartLineStory">
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_PlaceContainer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="TransitionIn_Initial"/>
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.001" Value=""/>
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:9.5" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard><!-- /ShowPlaceStartLineStory -->
            
            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowPlaceStory">
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_PlaceContainer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.001" Value=""/>
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:9.5" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard><!-- /ShowPlaceStory -->
            
            <!-- This sequence of storyboards need to be called in code, after assigning the TargetName.
                 This sequence allows showing up to 3 messages at a time, with most recent message above the others. -->
            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowHideFeat1Story">
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice1Container">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Canvas.Top)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice1Container">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="98"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.Y)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice1Container">
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Feat1Background">
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack50Color}"/>
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource FeatsColorKeyTime1}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientColor}"/>
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource FeatsColorKeyTime2}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource FeatsColorKeyTime3}" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack50Color}"/>
                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat1">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Feat1Background">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="72"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>            
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat1">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="72"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat1">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.167" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Feat1Background">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.167" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="72" KeySpline="0,1,0,0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>            
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat1">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.167" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="72" KeySpline="0,1,0,0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice1Container">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard><!-- /ShowHideFeat1Story -->
            
            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowHideFeat2Story">
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice2Container">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Canvas.Top)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice2Container">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="98"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.Y)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice2Container">
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Feat2Background">
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack50Color}"/>
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource FeatsColorKeyTime1}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusAmbientColor}"/>
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource FeatsColorKeyTime2}" Value="{StaticResource ForzaFocusColor}"/>
                    <EasingColorKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource FeatsColorKeyTime3}" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack50Color}"/>
                </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat2">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Feat2Background">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="72"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat2">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="72"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat2">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.167" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_Feat2Background">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.167" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="72" KeySpline="0,1,0,0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="StackPanel_Feat2">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.167" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="72" KeySpline="0,1,0,0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice2Container">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3.333" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard><!-- /ShowHideFeat2Story -->
            
            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowHideFeat3Story">
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice3Container">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Canvas.Top)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice3Container">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="98"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.Y)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_FeatNotice3Container">

                            <TranslateTransform/>

                <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Row02" DataContext="{Binding MiniScoreboardRow2}" Content="{Binding MiniScoreboardRow2}" Style="{StaticResource MiniScoreboardControlStyle}"/>

                <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Row04" DataContext="{Binding MiniScoreboardRow4}" Content="{Binding MiniScoreboardRow4}" Style="{StaticResource MiniScoreboardControlStyle}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Canvas>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_PlaceContainer" TargetName="PlaceContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

                Visibility="{Binding IsCatAndMouse, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Tag Virus Mode - Player's It Time -->

                Visibility="{Binding IsTagVirus, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Tag Mode - Player's It Time -->
            <Control x:Name="PlayerItTimeIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource ItTimeIndicatorControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding IsPlaceTimerAlwaysOn}" 
                Visibility="{Binding IsTag, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Cat and Mouse - Player's It Time -->
            <Control x:Name="PlayerCatTimeIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource ItTimeIndicatorControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding IsPlaceTimerAlwaysOn}" 
                Visibility="{Binding IsCatAndMouse, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Current Lap Time -->
            <Control x:Name="CurrLapIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource CurrLapIndicatorControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding IsPlaceTimerAlwaysOn}" 
                Visibility="{Binding ShowGoldTarget, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Gold Target for AutoCross, Passing, and Bowling -->
            <Control x:Name="GoldTargetIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource GoldTargetIndicatorControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding IsPlaceTimerAlwaysOn}" 
                Visibility="{Binding ShowGoldTarget, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Target Time -->
            <Control x:Name="TargetTimeIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource TargetTimeIndicatorControlStyle}" Tag="{Binding IsPlaceTimerAlwaysOn}" 
                Visibility="{Binding ShowTarget, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Split Time -->
            <Control x:Name="SplitTimeIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource SplitTimeIndicatorControlStyle}" 
                Visibility="{Binding IsFirstLap, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Best Lap Time -->
            <Control x:Name="BestLapIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource BestLapIndicatorControlStyle}" 
                Visibility="{Binding ShowGoldTarget, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>
            <!-- Last Lap Time -->
            <Control x:Name="LastLapIndicator" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource LastLapIndicatorControlStyle}" 
                Visibility="{Binding ShowGoldTarget, Converter={StaticResource InverseBoolVisConverter}}"/>
        </StackPanel>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_TotalTimeIndicator" TargetName="TotalTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_LeaderItVirusTimeIndicator" TargetName="LeaderItVirusTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_LeaderItTimeIndicator" TargetName="LeaderItTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_LeaderCatTimeIndicator" TargetName="LeaderCatTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_PlayerItVirusTimeIndicator" TargetName="PlayerItVirusTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_PlayerItTimeIndicator" TargetName="PlayerItTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_PlayerCatTimeIndicator" TargetName="PlayerCatTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CurrLapIndicator" TargetName="CurrLapIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_DirtyCurrLap" TargetName="CurrLapIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_SplitTimeIndicator" TargetName="SplitTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_BestLapIndicator" TargetName="BestLapIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_LastLapIndicator" TargetName="LastLapIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_TargetTimeIndicator" TargetName="TargetTimeIndicator"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_GoldTargetIndicator" TargetName="GoldTargetIndicator"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FinishInfoGridRow6Column1_Player2" Grid.Row="6" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Score}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsDescriptionTextBlockStyle}"/>

                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FinishInfoGridRow8Column0_Player2" Grid.Row="8" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_SplitScreen_BestTime}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_FinishInfoGridRow8Column1_Player2" Grid.Row="8" Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding BestLapScore}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsDescriptionTextBlockStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_321"  RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Canvas.Left="@E:126:S:0@" Canvas.Bottom="119">
            <Rectangle Fill="Transparent" Height="10" Width="10"/><!-- HACK to force FastTextBlocks to show -->
            
            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="ThreeText" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_3}" Style="{StaticResource 321TextBlockStyle}" Opacity="0"/>

            <Viewbox StretchDirection="DownOnly" Width="105">

            <Drawing:Arc x:Name="Arc_RingBG" Style="{StaticResource RingArcStyle}" StartAngle="0" EndAngle="360" Stroke="{StaticResource AlmostWhite40Brush}" Opacity="0"/>
            <Drawing:Arc x:Name="Ring_321" Style="{StaticResource RingArcStyle}" StartAngle="0" Opacity="0"/>
        </Grid><!-- /Grid_321 -->
        
        
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Completed_Player1"/>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F908_EndOfRace"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"  
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <ResourceDictionary>
            
            
            <Style x:Key="EndOfRaceCurrPositionTextBlockStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:FastTextBlock}">
                <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Planer"/>
                <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="65"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
                <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                    <Setter.Value>
                       <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style><!-- /EndOfRaceCurrPositionTextBlockStyle -->
            
            <Style x:Key="EndOfRaceTimeNoticeTextBlockStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:FastTextBlock}">
                <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Planer"/>
                <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="100"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                <Setter Property="Effect" Value="{StaticResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
                <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                    <Setter.Value>
                       <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
                <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>1</System:Int32><!-- Binding CurrTargetAchieved -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>2</System:Int32><!-- Binding CurrTargetAchieved -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>3</System:Int32><!-- Binding CurrTargetAchieved -->
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
            </Style><!-- /EndOfRaceTimeNoticeTextBlockStyle -->

            <Style x:Key="EndOfRaceStopsNoticeTextBlockStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:FastTextBlock}">
                <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Planer"/>
                <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="62"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                <Setter Property="Effect" Value="{StaticResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
                <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <Trigger Property="Tag">
                        <Trigger.Value>
                            <System:Int32>1</System:Int32>
                            <!-- Binding StopsTargetAchieved ScoringTarget::Top -->
                        </Trigger.Value>
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                    </Trigger>
                    <Trigger Property="Tag">
                        <Trigger.Value>
                            <System:Int32>100</System:Int32>
                            <!-- Binding StopsTargetAchieved ScoringTarget::Failed -->
                        </Trigger.Value>
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource HUDWhiteBrush}"/>
                    </Trigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style>

            <Style x:Key="ConditionalPlaceBorderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Border}">
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Place}" Value="{x:Null}">
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    </DataTrigger>
                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Place}" Value="">
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    </DataTrigger>
                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ShowTarget}">
                        <DataTrigger.Value>
                            <System:Boolean>True</System:Boolean>
                        </DataTrigger.Value>
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    </DataTrigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style><!-- /ConditionalPlaceBorderStyle -->
            
            <Style x:Key="NullResultStackPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type StackPanel}">
                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Place}" Value="">
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                    </DataTrigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style><!-- /NullResultStackPanelStyle -->
            
            <Style x:Key="InverseNullResultStackPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type StackPanel}">
                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Place}" Value="">
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                    </DataTrigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style><!-- /InverseNullResultStackPanelStyle -->
            
            <Style x:Key="StopsTargetAchievedBorderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Border}">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="35,8,0,0"/>
                <Setter Property="Height" Value="42"/>
                <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <Trigger Property="Tag">
                        <Trigger.Value>
                            <System:Int32>1</System:Int32>
                            <!-- Binding StopsTargetAchieved ScoringTarget::Top -->
                        </Trigger.Value>
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                    </Trigger>
                    <Trigger Property="Tag">
                        <Trigger.Value>
                            <System:Int32>100</System:Int32>
                            <!-- Binding StopsTargetAchieved ScoringTarget::Failed -->
                        </Trigger.Value>
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource HUDWhiteBrush}"/>
                    </Trigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style><!-- /StopsTargetAchievedBorderStyle -->
            
            
            <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_EndOfRace">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="90"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:2.767" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3" Value="-90" KeySpline="0.7,0,1,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_EndOfRace">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:2.767" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:3" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </Storyboard><!-- /TransitionIn -->
        </ResourceDictionary>
    </Page.Resources>
    
    
    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_EndOfRace" Margin="@E:190:F:0:-1@,0,0,0" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                <Grid.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Grid.RenderTransform>
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="190"/><!-- margin -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/><!-- content -->
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Player0Divider" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Width="950" Style="{StaticResource NullResultStackPanelStyle}">
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_TOP0" Height="1">
                        <Rectangle.Fill>
                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset="0"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset=".75"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack00Color}" Offset="1"/>
                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                        </Rectangle.Fill>
                    </Rectangle>
                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_BOT0" Height="1">
                        <Rectangle.Fill>
                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Color}" Offset="0"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Color}" Offset=".75"/>
                                <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite00Color}" Offset="1"/>
                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                        </Rectangle.Fill>
                    </Rectangle>
                </StackPanel>
                
                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Player1" Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Border x:Name="Border_Player1Place" Style="{StaticResource ConditionalPlaceBorderStyle}" Width="164" Height="164" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="50,22,0,0">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Player1Place" Visibility="{Binding ShowPlace, FallbackValue=Collapsed, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                            <Ellipse x:Name="Ellipse_Player1PlaceBg" Fill="{DynamicResource HUDWhiteBrush}"/>
                            <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Place" Text="{Binding FinishPlaceString}" Style="{StaticResource EndOfRaceCurrPositionTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Border>
                    
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_Player1Time" Tag="{Binding BestLapScore}" Style="{StaticResource ConditionalHudSmallerTitleGridStyle}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="60,36,0,0">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Player1BestLap">
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_BestLapLabel" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="5,0,0,-14">
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_Background" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>
                                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="Textblock_Label" Text="{Binding ScoreTitle}" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </Grid>
                            
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Player1Time" Orientation="Horizontal">
                                <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Player1Time" Text="{Binding BestLapScore}" Tag="{Binding CurrTargetAchieved}" Style="{StaticResource EndOfRaceTimeNoticeTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <Border x:Name="Border_DirtyLap" Style="{StaticResource HUDDirtyLapBorderStyle}"
                                    Visibility="{Binding BestLapIsDirty, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_DirtyLap" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_DirtyLap_HUD.png" Style="{DynamicResource HUDDirtyIconImageStyle}" Stretch="None"/>
                                </Border>
                                <!--Border x:Name="Border_Medal" Width="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleHeight}" Height="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleHeight}" Style="{StaticResource PodiumBorderStyle}" 
                                    Tag="{Binding CurrTargetAchieved}"/-->
                            </StackPanel>
                            
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Player1Divider" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Width="850" Margin="5,0,0,0" Style="{StaticResource InverseNullResultStackPanelStyle}">
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_TOP" Height="1">
                                    <Rectangle.Fill>
                                        <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                            <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset="0"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Color}" Offset=".75"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostBlack00Color}" Offset="1"/>
                                        </LinearGradientBrush>
                                    </Rectangle.Fill>
                                </Rectangle>
                                <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_BOT" Height="1">
                                    <Rectangle.Fill>
                                        <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,0.5" EndPoint="1,0.5">
                                            <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Color}" Offset="0"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Color}" Offset=".75"/>
                                            <GradientStop Color="{StaticResource AlmostWhite00Color}" Offset="1"/>
                                        </LinearGradientBrush>
                                    </Rectangle.Fill>
                                </Rectangle>
                            </StackPanel>
                            
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_QuickStopsContainer" Margin="0,12,0,0"
                                Visibility="{Binding ShowPitStops, FallbackValue=Collapsed, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_QuickStopsLabel" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="5,0,0,-4">
                                    <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_QuickStopsLabel" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleBackgroundStyle}"/>
                                    <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="Textblock_QuickStopsLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Stops}" Style="{StaticResource HUDSmallerTitleTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                </Grid>
                                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_QuickStops" Orientation="Horizontal">
                                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding NumPitStops}" Tag="{Binding StopsTargetAchieved}" Style="{StaticResource EndOfRaceStopsNoticeTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="/" Tag="{Binding StopsTargetAchieved}" Style="{StaticResource EndOfRaceStopsNoticeTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                    <local:FastTextBlock Text="{Binding StopsRequired}" Tag="{Binding StopsTargetAchieved}" Style="{StaticResource EndOfRaceStopsNoticeTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                    <Border x:Name="Border_QuickStopsComplete" Tag="{Binding StopsTargetAchieved}" Style="{StaticResource StopsTargetAchievedBorderStyle}">
                                        <local:FastTextBlock x:Name="Textblock_QuickStopsComplete" Text="{Binding StopsTargetAchievedString}" Style="{StaticResource HUDTitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" 
                                            Margin="22,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="18" Foreground="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
                                    </Border>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </StackPanel>
                            
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Grid>
                    
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

Scenes/WPF/F920_PreRace.xaml.full:
<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F920_PreRace"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource MidLightGrayBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="16"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,17,0,0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,3,0,0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,15,0,0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeGridStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type StackPanel}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="18,1,96,36"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Divider">
                            <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}" Height="1"/>
                            <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Brush}" Height="1"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle -->
        
        
        <DataTemplate x:Key="MiniLeaderboardPreItem">
            <DataTemplate.Resources>
                <Storyboard x:Key="RowTransitionIn">
                    <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContainer">
                        <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                    </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContent">
                        <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                        <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                    </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContent">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0.4"/>
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContent">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="20"/>
                        <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemBackground">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.001"/>
                        <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
            </DataTemplate.Resources>
            
            <Grid x:Name="ItemContainer" Height="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeight}">
                <Rectangle x:Name="ItemBackground" Fill="{StaticResource InfoPanelDarkBgBrush}" RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5" Margin="0,1,0,0">
                    <Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                </Rectangle>
                <Rectangle x:Name="ItemDivider" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemDividerStyle}"/>
                <Grid x:Name="ItemContent" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Margin="0,1,0,0">
                    <Grid.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Grid.RenderTransform>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn0Width}"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn1Width}"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn3Width}"/> 
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="RankValueText" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Position}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="GamertagValueText" Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Gamertag}"/>
                    <Image x:Name="Image_DirtyBest" Grid.Column="2" Margin="0,0,15,0" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_DirtyLap_White.png"
                        Stretch="Uniform" Width="19" VerticalAlignment="Center" Visibility="{Binding IsDirtyBest, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TimeValueText" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Score}"/>
                    <!--Rectangle Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                    <Rectangle Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/-->
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsEnabled, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" Value="True">
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource RowTransitionIn}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate>
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerHeader">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerIcon">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">

                </StackPanel>
            </ScrollViewer>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Body" Style="{StaticResource BodyGridStyle}">
            <Grid x:Name="Grid_InfoPanels">
                <StackPanel Margin="@E:0:F:0:-1@,0,0,0" x:Name="StackPanel_MiniLeaderboard" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_0_MiniLeaderboard" Grid.Column="1" Grid.Row="1" HorizontalAlignment="Left" 
                          Visibility="Collapsed" Opacity="0"><!-- Default Opacity="0" -->
                        <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_0_Bg" Grid.RowSpan="3" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_0_MiniLeaderboard" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                            <Border x:Name="Border_0_Title" Height="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderHeight}" Background="{StaticResource InfoPanelHeaderBgBrush}">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_0_Title" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_PreRace_MiniLeaderboard}" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}"/>            
                            </Border>
                            <Border x:Name="Border_0_Header" Style="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardHeaderStyle}">
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_0_HeaderContent">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn0Width}"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn1Width}"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn3Width}"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc Scoreboard.IDS_Rank}" Style="{StaticResource GridColoredTextBlockStyle}"/>   
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{local:Loc Scoreboard.IDS_Gamertag}" Style="{StaticResource GridColoredTextBlockStyle}"/>   
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" Text="{Binding TimeOrScoreTitle}" Style="{StaticResource GridColoredTextBlockStyle}"/> 
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                            <Grid x:Name="Grid_0_List">
                                <ListBox x:Name="MiniLeaderboardList" Style="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardListBoxStyle}" ItemTemplate="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardPreItem}" ItemsSource="{Binding MiniLeaderboard}"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Grid>
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
            
            <StackPanel Margin="0,0,@E:0:F:0:-1@,0" x:Name="StackPanel_SideBladeRHT" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_RaceToggle">
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_RaceInfo" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Width="438">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- poster -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- series / showcase -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- objective -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/><!-- track data -->
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_RaceInfoPanelBg"  Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}" Grid.RowSpan="4"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_SeriesPoster" Height="206">
                            <Image x:Name="Image_SeriesPoster" Source="{Binding Career.SeriesPosterSmall}" Stretch="UniformToFill" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Top" ClipToBounds="True"/>
                        </Grid>
                        
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_ShowcasePoster" Height="206" Visibility="Collapsed">
                            <Image x:Name="Image_ShowcasePoster" Source="{Binding ShowcaseEventInfo.EventImageSmall}" Stretch="UniformToFill" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" ClipToBounds="True"/>
                            <!--Image x:Name="Image_GroupImage" Source="{Binding ShowcaseEventInfo.GroupImage}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_GroupName" Text="{Binding ShowcaseEventInfo.GroupName}"/-->
                        </Grid>
                        
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CareerSeries" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeGridStyle}">
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CareerSeries" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle}">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_SeriesLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Series}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Series" Text="{Binding Career.SeriesTitle}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Race" Text="{Binding Career.CurrentRaceIndexDesc}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CareerShowcase" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeGridStyle}" Visibility="Collapsed">
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_CareerShowcase" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle}" Margin="18,1,96,15">
                                <!--TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CareerShowcaseLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Prerace_Event}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/-->
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CareerShowcase" Text="{Binding ShowcaseEventInfo.EventName}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,15,0,0"/>
                                <!--TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CareerShowcaseDescriptionLabel" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Description}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CareerShowcaseDescription" Text="{Binding ShowcaseEventInfo.EventDescription}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle}"/-->
                            </StackPanel>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Target" Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeGridStyle}">
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Target" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle}">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TargetScoreLabel" Text="{Binding Career.ObjectiveTitle}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TargetScore" Text="{Binding Career.ObjectiveDesc}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TargetPayout" Text="{Binding Career.TargetPayout, ConverterParameter=money, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <Grid Visibility="{Binding Career.Objective2Desc, Converter={StaticResource StringVisConverter}}">
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_TargetScore2" Text="{Binding Career.Objective2Desc}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}"/>
                                        <Image x:Name="Image_TargetScore2" Margin="0,15,15,0" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols_Nascar/Quickstop_Icon.png" Stretch="Uniform" Width="19" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Grid>
                            </StackPanel>
                            <ContentControl Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle}"/>
                        </Grid>

                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_TrackData" Grid.Row="3" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeGridStyle}">
                            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_TrackData" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle}">
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CircuitNameLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Track}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_CircuitName" Text="{Binding Career.ShortTrackName}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LapsLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_World_Tour_Race_Laps_Title}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Laps" Text="{Binding Career.Laps}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LengthLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_World_Tour_Track_Length_Title}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Length" Text="{Binding Career.Length}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
                
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_ModsToggle">
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_CardImpact" Style="{StaticResource CardImpactPanelGridStyle}" Visibility="{Binding ShowCards, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource ModsPanelHeightA}"/><!-- title -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource ModsPanelHeightB}"/><!-- slots -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource ModsPanelHeightC}"/><!-- title -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource ModsPanelHeightD}"/><!-- strings -->
                            <RowDefinition Height="{StaticResource ModsPanelHeightE}"/><!-- fill -->
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_CardImpactPanelBg" Grid.RowSpan="5" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_CardImpactDarken" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
                        <Rectangle x:Name="Rectangle_CardImpacDarken2" Grid.Row="2" Grid.RowSpan="3" Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_StotsLabel" Text="{local:Loc Cards.IDS_ModSlots}" Style="{StaticResource CardPanelHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_CardSlots" Grid.Row="1"
                            Focusable="False" 
                            FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False">
                            <!-- THIS CANNOT BE A ITEMSSELECTOR, OR HAVE A NAME, OR IT WILL BREAK SCENEMAPPER -->
                            <ListBox 
                                ItemsSource="{Binding CardSlotCardsCollection}" 
                                ItemTemplateSelector="{Binding CardSlotCardsCollection.TemplateSelector}">
                                <ListBox.Template>
                                    <ControlTemplate>
                                        <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Vertical"/>
                                    </ControlTemplate>
                                </ListBox.Template>
                            </ListBox>
                        </Grid>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ImpactLabel" Grid.Row="2" Text="{local:Loc Cards.IDS_ModsImpact}" Style="{StaticResource CardPanelHeaderTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Divider" Grid.Row="2" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
                            <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}" Height="1"/>
                            <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Brush}" Height="1"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <local:CommonListBox x:Name="EffectSpecialStringList" Grid.Row="3" Style="{StaticResource ModsImpactCommonListBoxStyle}"
                            ItemsSource="{Binding CardEffectSummary.SpecialEffectItemCollection}"
                            ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource SpecialEffectItemStyle}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_OK}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="X_QuickEquip" Button="X" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_QuickEquip}" Visibility="{Binding CardsQuickEquipEnabled, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="Y_QuickBuy" Button="Y" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_QuickBuy}" Visibility="{Binding CardsQuickBuyEnabled, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="Start_Toggle" Button="Start" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_ShowModsInfo}" Visibility="{Binding CanToggle, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
            <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_LoadingLiveries" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="144,0,0,0" Height="35" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Left" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" 
                        Visibility="Collapsed"><!-- default Visibility="Collapsed" -->
                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LoadingLiveriesLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Drivatar_Liveries_Loading}" Style="{StaticResource PanelSubtitleTextBlockStyle}" VerticalAlignment="Center" 
                           Margin="0"/>
                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LoadingLiveries" Text="{Binding LiveryCount}" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
        
        <!-- DO NOT REMOVE THIS BUTTON -->
        <Button x:Name="HackButtonForAutomation" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFire Targets #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerHeader" TargetName="Control_CareerHeader"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerIcon" TargetName="Control_CareerIcon"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
