<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F930_PostRace"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    
    
    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource MidLightGrayBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="16"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,17,0,0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,3,0,0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="20"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,15,0,0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeGridStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeGridStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle" TargetType="{x:Type StackPanel}">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="18,1,96,36"/>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeStackPanelStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="HorizontalMainMenuRectangleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
            <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource AlmostBlackBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.6"/>
        </Style>
        <!-- /HorizontalMainMenuRectangleStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="ShowcaseTitleTextBlockStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource TitleBaseTextBlockStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AlmostWhiteBrush}"/>
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="Planer"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18"/>
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
        </Style>
        <!-- ShowcaseTitleTextBlockStyle -->

        <Style x:Key="PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Bottom"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_Divider">
                            <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostBlack30Brush}" Height="1"/>
                            <Rectangle Fill="{StaticResource AlmostWhite30Brush}" Height="1"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle -->
        
        <!-- Career progress wheel -->
        <Style x:Key="CareerProgressTickImageStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Image}">
            <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick06.png"/>
            <Setter Property="Stretch" Value="None"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>1</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>2</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>3</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick03.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>4</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick04.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>5</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick05.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>6</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick06.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>7</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick07.png"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag">
                    <Trigger.Value>
                        <System:Int32>8</System:Int32>
                    </Trigger.Value>
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Tick08.png"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style><!-- /CareerProgressTickImageStyle -->
    
        <Style x:Key="CareerProgressHaloFZMaterialStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:FZMaterial}">
            <Setter Property="ImageSource" Value="/Textures/Data_Bound/UI_Symbols/CareerProgress_Halo.png"/>
            <Setter Property="Preset" Value="{StaticResource Normal_FZMaterialPresetAdditive}"/>
            <Setter Property="Stretch" Value="UniformToFill"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="300"/>
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="300"/>
            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransformOrigin" Value="0.5,0.5"/>
            <Setter Property="RenderTransform">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <TransformGroup>
                        <ScaleTransform/>
                        <SkewTransform/>
                        <RotateTransform/>
                        <TranslateTransform/>
                    </TransformGroup>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /CareerProgressHaloFZMaterialStyle -->
        
        <DataTemplate x:Key="MiniLeaderboardPreItem">
            <DataTemplate.Resources>
                <Storyboard x:Key="RowTransitionIn">
                    <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContainer">
                        <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                    </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Visibility)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContent">
                        <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Hidden}"/>
                        <DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="{x:Static Visibility.Visible}"/>
                    </ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContent">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="0.4"/>
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.3" Value="1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemContent">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.2" Value="20"/>
                        <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="ItemBackground">
                        <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.001"/>
                        <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.4" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0.7,1"/>
                    </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                </Storyboard>
            </DataTemplate.Resources>
            <Grid x:Name="ItemContainer" Height="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemHeight}" Margin="0,1,0,0" Visibility="Hidden">
                <Rectangle x:Name="ItemBackground" Fill="{StaticResource InfoPanelDarkBgBrush}" RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5">
                    <Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Rectangle.RenderTransform>
                </Rectangle>
                <Rectangle x:Name="ItemDivider" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelItemDividerStyle}"/>
                <Grid x:Name="ItemContent" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                    <Grid.RenderTransform>
                        <TransformGroup>
                            <ScaleTransform/>
                            <SkewTransform/>
                            <RotateTransform/>
                            <TranslateTransform/>
                        </TransformGroup>
                    </Grid.RenderTransform>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn0Width}"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn1Width}"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource MiniLeaderboardColumn3Width}"/> 
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="RankValueText" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Position}"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="GamertagValueText" Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Gamertag}"/>
                    <Image x:Name="Image_DirtyBest" Grid.Column="2" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,15,0" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Metadata_Icons/Meta_DirtyLap_White.png" Stretch="Uniform" Width="19" VerticalAlignment="Center" Visibility="{Binding IsDirtyBest, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>    
                    <TextBlock x:Name="TimeValueText" Grid.Column="2" Style="{StaticResource GridLightTextBlockStyle}" Text="{Binding Score}"/>
                    <Rectangle Grid.Column="0" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                    <Rectangle Grid.Column="1" Style="{StaticResource GridDividerStyle}"/>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
            <DataTemplate.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsEnabled, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" Value="True">
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard Storyboard="{StaticResource RowTransitionIn}"/>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </DataTemplate.Triggers>
        </DataTemplate><!-- /MiniLeaderboardPreItem -->
        
        
        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <!--ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"--><!-- Template : v0 10.31.14 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerHeader">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerIcon">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <!--/ParallelTimeline--><!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v0 10.31.14 -->
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Menu">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_CareerBar">
                <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
            </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>

                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_RaceProgressLabel" Text="{Binding NextRace.RaceProgressTitle}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_RaceProgress" Text="{Binding NextRace.RaceProgressData}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDataTextBlockStyle}"/>

                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Press" Text="{local:Loc Main.IDS_Press}" Style="{StaticResource HelpTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}" FontSize="16" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                            <Grid Height="32" Width="32">
                                <Image x:Name="Image_ButtonX" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_X.png"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_ToStart" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_PostRace_ToSkipTrack}" Style="{StaticResource HelpTextBlockStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaGoldBrush}" FontSize="16" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>


               <Grid x:Name="Grid_LeagueRaceInfo" Width="524" Visibility="Collapsed">
                <local:FZMaterial x:Name="FZMaterial_LeagueRaceInfoBg" Style="{StaticResource DarkGlassMed_FZMaterialStyle}"/>
                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_LeagueRaceInfo">
                   
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_LeaguePhoto" Height="200" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeGridStyle}">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="32"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                          <Image x:Name="Image_LeagueRaceInfoPhoto" Grid.RowSpan="2" Source="{Binding League.Poster}" Stretch="UniformToFill" VerticalAlignment="Center" ClipToBounds="True"/>
                    </Grid>
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_LeagueRaceInfoResults" Grid.Row="2" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeGridStyle}" Height="200">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="96"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <Image x:Name="Image_LeagueRaceInfoBadge" Source="{Binding League.Icon}" Height="186" Width="186" ClipToBounds="True" Stretch="Uniform"/>
                         <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_LeagueRaceResults" Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LeagueRaceName"  Text="{Binding League.Name}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,-6,0,0"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LeagueRaceFinish"  Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_PostRace_FinishPosition}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeLabelTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_LeagueRaceFinishPosition"  Text="{Binding FinishPlace}" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeTitleTextBlockStyle}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <ContentControl Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Style="{StaticResource PrePostBladeDividerControlStyle}"/>
                    </Grid>
                    
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </StackPanel>
        </Grid>

        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_Select}"/>
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl x:Name="SkipRaceButton" Button="X" Description="{local:Loc HelpButtons.IDS_SkipTrack}" Visibility="Collapsed"/>

                        Visibility="{Binding IsUnlockedRaceVisible, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->

        <local:AudioEvent x:Name="PanelAudio"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>

        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerHeader" TargetName="Control_CareerHeader"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerIcon" TargetName="Control_CareerIcon"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_CareerBar" TargetName="Control_CareerBar"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Menu" TargetName="ScrollViewer_MenuContainer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"

    <Page.Resources>

            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>

                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowGroupBgStory">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.633" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="390"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.633" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="HideGroupBgStory">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="190" KeySpline="0.5,0,1,1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </ControlTemplate.Resources>
                        <Grid x:Name="Container">
                            <ContentPresenter x:Name="ContentPresenter" RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Opacity="0">
                                <ContentPresenter.RenderTransform>
                                    <TransformGroup>
                                        <ScaleTransform/>
                                        <SkewTransform/>
                                        <RotateTransform/>
                                        <TranslateTransform X="390"/>
                                    </TransformGroup>
                                </ContentPresenter.RenderTransform>
                            </ContentPresenter>
                            <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                            <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                                <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ShowGroupBg_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowGroupBgStory}"/>
                                <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HideGroupBg_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideGroupBgStory}"/>
                            </local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                            <!-- end remote event -->
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style><!-- /RewardGroupBgContentControlStyle -->
        
        <Style x:Key="RewardGroupContentControlStyle" TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ContentControl}">
                        <ControlTemplate.Resources>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="ShowGroupStory">
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="0"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.433" Value="1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.Y)" Storyboard.TargetName="ContentPresenter">
                                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{StaticResource StartOffsetY}"/>
                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.233" Value="{StaticResource StartOffsetY}"/>
                                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.433" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>
                            <Storyboard x:Key="HideGroupStory">

                                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                            </Storyboard>

                        <Grid x:Name="Container">

                                        <SkewTransform/>
                                        <RotateTransform/>
                                        <TranslateTransform/>
                                    </TransformGroup>
                                </ContentPresenter.RenderTransform>
                            </ContentPresenter>
                            <!-- remote event: Event="EventTriggerValue" Storyboard="LocalStoryboard" -->
                            <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
                                <local:EventFireTrigger Event="ShowGroup_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowGroupStory}"/>
                                <local:EventFireTrigger Event="HideGroup_Start" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideGroupStory}"/>

                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>

                                        FontSize="45" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleLargeTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,-8,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel><!-- /StackPanel_2_TotalEarned -->
                            </StackPanel><!-- /XPRewards_StackPanel_Earnings -->
                        </StackPanel><!-- /StackPanel_2_XPRewards -->
                    </ContentControl>
                    
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_3_RewardGroup" Style="{StaticResource RewardGroupContentControlStyle}">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_3_AffinityRewards">
                            <!-- style elements taken from "{StaticResource RewardsContainerPanelStyle}" -->
                            <Grid.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Grid">
                                    <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Left"/>
                                    <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Margin" Value="102,0,0,0"/>
                                </Style>
                            </Grid.Style>
                            <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Affinity_Level}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleLargeTextBlockStyle}"/>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="AffinityRewards_StackPanel_Earnings" Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,80,0,0">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_3_LevelsContainer">
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_3_AffinityProgressCurrent" Text="{Binding AffinityLevelCurrent}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsLevelNumberTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,-3,0,0"/>
                                        <Viewbox x:Name="Viewbox_3_NewCurrentLevel" StretchDirection="DownOnly" Margin="0,-3,0,0" Opacity="0">
                                            <!-- Viewbox used to fit max Affinity Lvl 25 -->
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_3_NewCurrentLevel" Text="{Binding AffinityLVL}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelNumberTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                        </Viewbox>
                                    </Grid><!-- /Grid_3_LevelsContainer -->
                                    <Image x:Name="Image_3_AffinityLogo" Source="{Binding ManufacturerLogoPath}" Width="146" Height="146" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="16,0,0,0"/>
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_3_AffinityAwardMessage" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="28,0,0,0"
                                        Visibility="{Binding AffinityLVLCompensation, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}" Opacity="0">
                                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_You_Won}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelMessageTextBlockStyle}"/>
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_3_AffinityBonus" Text="{Binding AffinityLVLCompensation, ConverterParameter=money, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}" 
                                                Style="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelMessageTextBlockStyle}" Margin="6,14,0,0"/>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_AffinityCreditReward}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelMessageTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="20" Margin="0"/>
                                    </StackPanel><!-- /StackPanel_3_AffinityAwardMessage -->
                                </StackPanel>
                                
                                <local:LevelProgressBar x:Name="ProgressBar_3_AffinityProgress" Style="{StaticResource RewardsProgressBarStyle}" Margin="0,4,0,0"/>
                                
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,14,0,0">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_3_AffinityProgressStatus" Text="{Binding NextAffinityLevelXP}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0" FontSize="25"/>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_3_AffinityProgressStatusLabel" Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Next_Car_Level}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" Margin="6,0,0,0" 
                                        FontSize="25"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_AffinityRewards_ModsContainer" Margin="0,34,0,0"
                                    Visibility="{Binding IsCardAffinityBonusActive, Converter={StaticResource BoolVisConverter}}">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                       <ColumnDefinition Width="{StaticResource GridLength_RewardsCardSlotsWidth}"/>
                                       <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_3_CardSlots" Grid.Column="0"
                                        Focusable="False" 
                                        FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False"
                                        DataContext="{Binding CardsWithAffinityXPEffects}">
                                        <ListBox
                                            ItemsSource="{Binding RewardCardList}" 
                                            ItemTemplateSelector="{Binding RewardCardList.TemplateSelector}">
                                            <ListBox.Template>
                                                <ControlTemplate>
                                                    <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Vertical"/>
                                                </ControlTemplate>
                                            </ListBox.Template>
                                        </ListBox>
                                    </Grid> 
                                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_3_CardSlots_Strings" Grid.Column="1"
                                        Focusable="False" 
                                        FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False">
                                        <ListBox
                                            ItemsSource="{Binding CardsWithAffinityXPEffects.RewardImpactStrings}"
                                            ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource CardSlotRewardMessageStyle}">
                                            <ListBox.Template>
                                                <ControlTemplate>
                                                    <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Vertical"/>
                                                </ControlTemplate>
                                            </ListBox.Template>
                                        </ListBox>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Grid><!-- /Grid_AffinityRewards_ModsContainer -->
                                
                                <StackPanel x:Name="StackPanel_3_TotalEarned" Margin="0,36,0,0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Earned}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsDataLabelTextBlockStyle}"
                                        Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}" Margin="0"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding TotalEarnedAffinityXP, ConverterParameter=experiencepoints, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}"
                                        FontSize="60" Foreground="{StaticResource ForzaBlueBrush}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleLargeTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,-12,0,0"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_Total}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsDataLabelTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,24,0,0"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding TotalAffinityXP, ConverterParameter=experiencepoints, Converter={StaticResource NumUnitConverter}}"
                                        FontSize="45" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleLargeTextBlockStyle}" Margin="0,-8,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </StackPanel><!-- /AffinityRewards_StackPanel_Earnings_Right -->
                        </Grid><!-- /Grid_3_AffinityRewards -->
                    </ContentControl>
                    
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_4_RewardGroup" Style="{StaticResource RewardGroupContentControlStyle}">
                        <!-- The mod rewarded here will always be a crew mod, so we can specify the item template rather than use a selector -->
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_4_MaxAffinityLevelCardRewards" Style="{StaticResource RewardsContainerPanelStyle}" Margin="102,0,0,0">
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_4_CardSlots"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                    Margin="-20,0,0,0"
                                    Focusable="False" 
                                    FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False">
                                    <ListBox
                                        ItemsSource="{Binding MaxAffinityLevelCardList}"
                                        ItemTemplate="{StaticResource CrewCardItemTemplate}"
                                        HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                        <ListBox.Template>
                                            <ControlTemplate>
                                                <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Vertical"/>
                                            </ControlTemplate>
                                        </ListBox.Template>
                                    </ListBox>
                                </Grid>
                                <Viewbox StretchDirection="DownOnly" MaxWidth="1100" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_SuperRareCardUnlocked}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" FontFamily="Planer" FontSize="65" Margin="0,10,0,10"/>
                                </Viewbox>
                                <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_MaxAffinityLevelAchieved}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" TextWrapping="Wrap" FontSize="25" 
                                    Foreground="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelColorBrush}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </ContentControl>
                    
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_5_RewardGroup" Style="{StaticResource RewardGroupContentControlStyle}">
                        <!-- The mod rewarded here will always be a crew mod, so we can specify the item template rather than use a selector -->
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_5_RaceSpecificCardRewards" Style="{StaticResource RewardsContainerPanelStyle}" Margin="102,0,0,0">
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Grid x:Name="Grid_5_CardSlots"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                    Margin="-20,0,0,0"
                                    Focusable="False" 
                                    FocusManager.IsFocusScope="False">
                                    <ListBox
                                        ItemsSource="{Binding RaceSpecificRewardCardList}"
                                        ItemTemplateSelector="{Binding RaceSpecificRewardCardList.TemplateSelector}"
                                        HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                        <ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                            <Style>
                                                <Setter Property="FrameworkElement.Margin" Value="25"/>
                                            </Style>
                                        </ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyle>
                                        <ListBox.Template>
                                            <ControlTemplate>
                                                <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                                            </ControlTemplate>
                                        </ListBox.Template>
                                    </ListBox>
                                </Grid>
                                <Viewbox StretchDirection="DownOnly" MaxWidth="1100" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_SuperRareCardUnlocked}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" FontFamily="Planer" FontSize="65" Margin="0,10,0,10"/>
                                </Viewbox>
                                <TextBlock Text="{local:Loc InGame.IDS_RaceSpecificCardsAwarded}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" TextWrapping="Wrap" FontSize="25" 
                                    Foreground="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelColorBrush}" MaxWidth="900"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </ContentControl>
                    
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_6_RewardGroup" Style="{StaticResource RewardGroupContentControlStyle}">
                        <Grid x:Name="Grid_6_AffinityLevelTombolaSpinRewards" Style="{StaticResource RewardsContainerPanelStyle}">
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding DriverLevelTombolaSpinAwardMessage}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="65"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding AffinityLevelTombolaSpinAwardMessage}" Style="{StaticResource RewardsTitleTextBlockStyle}" FontSize="95" Foreground="{StaticResource RewardsNewLevelColorBrush}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </ContentControl>
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
        
        <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}" FlowDirection="{Binding FlowDirection, ElementName=Page}">
                    <!-- Buttons added in code -->
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>
        
        
        <!-- #################### EventFire Targets #################### -->
        <!-- IncrementingTextBlock Payout -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFirePayoutPlace" TargetName="TextBlock_1_TotalCr"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFirePayoutDriverXP" TargetName="TextBlock_2_EarnedXP"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFirePayoutAffinityXP" TargetName="TextBlock_3_AffinityBonusCr"/>
        <!-- Animate Progress Bar -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFirePayoutDriverLevel" TargetName="ProgressBar_2_DriverProgress"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFirePayoutAffinityLevel" TargetName="ProgressBar_3_AffinityProgress"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireDrivatarProgress" TargetName="DrivatarProgress"/>
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFireStoryboard" TargetName="LayoutRoot"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_RewardGroupBg" TargetName="Control_RewardGroupBg"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_1_RewardGroup" TargetName="Control_1_RewardGroup"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_2_RewardGroup" TargetName="Control_2_RewardGroup"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_3_RewardGroup" TargetName="Control_3_RewardGroup"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_4_RewardGroup" TargetName="Control_4_RewardGroup"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_5_RewardGroup" TargetName="Control_5_RewardGroup"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_6_RewardGroup" TargetName="Control_6_RewardGroup"/>
        <!-- FMOD event storyboard target -->
        <local:AudioEvent x:Name="PanelAudio"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
    
    
    <local:EventFire.FzTriggers>
        <!-- Fired by Code Behind -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showCreditRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowCreditRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideCreditRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideCreditRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showXPRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowXPRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideXPRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideXPRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showAffinityRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowAffinityRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideAffinityRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideAffinityRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showMaxAffinityLevelCardRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowMaxAffinityLevelCardRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideMaxAffinityLevelCardRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideMaxAffinityLevelCardRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showAffinityLevelTombolaSpinRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowAffinityLevelTombolaSpinRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideAffinityLevelTombolaSpinRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideAffinityLevelTombolaSpinRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showAffinityLevelTombolaSpin" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowAffinityLevelTombolaSpin}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideAffinityLevelTombolaSpin" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideAffinityLevelTombolaSpin}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showIEDriverLevelTombolaSpinRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowIEDriverLevelTombolaSpinRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideIEDriverLevelTombolaSpinRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideIEDriverLevelTombolaSpinRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showDriverLevelTombolaSpin" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowDriverLevelTombolaSpin}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideDriverLevelTombolaSpin" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideDriverLevelTombolaSpin}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showRaceSpecificCardRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowRaceSpecificCardRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideRaceSpecificCardRewards" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideRaceSpecificCardRewards}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="show1stUnlockedRace" Storyboard="{StaticResource Show1stUnlockedRace}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hide1stUnlockedRace" Storyboard="{StaticResource Hide1stUnlockedRace}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="showUnlockedRace" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowUnlockedRace}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="hideUnlockedRace" Storyboard="{StaticResource HideUnlockedRace}"/>
        <!-- Fired by Storyboards -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="startDriverLeveled" Storyboard="{StaticResource DriverLeveledStory}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="startAffinityLeveled" Storyboard="{StaticResource AffinityLeveledStory}"/>
        <!-- Fired by Code Behind -->
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="DriverLeveled" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowDriverLeveled}"/>
        <local:EventFireTrigger Event="AffinityLeveled" Storyboard="{StaticResource ShowAffinityLeveled}"/>
    </local:EventFire.FzTriggers> 
</Page>

<Page x:Name="Page"
      x:Class="ForzaUI.F936_Telemetry"
      xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI"
      xmlns:ForzaUI_Controls="clr-namespace:ForzaUI.Controls"
      xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
      xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008" 
      xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006" 
      xmlns:ed="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/2010/drawing"
      xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
      mc:Ignorable="d"
      WindowHeight="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}" WindowWidth="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}"
      DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">
    <!--NOTE: Window dimensions must be set for the friction circles to render properly-->


    <Page.Resources>
        <!-- Style that sets button height to 48 instead of 32. Required to display the right thumbstick up/down buttons at the proper size -->
        <Style x:Key="TelemetryHelpButtonStyle" TargetType="{x:Type local:ControllerButtonControl}">
            <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:ControllerButtonControl}">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="BtnContainer" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="20,0" Height="51" Background="Transparent">
                            <Image Name="PART_ButtonIcon" Source="/Textures/Data_Bound/Help_Buttons/Button_A.png" UseLayoutRounding="False" Height="48" Margin="0,0,0,0" Stretch="None"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding Description}" Style="{StaticResource HelpBaseTextBlockStyle}" Effect="{DynamicResource DefaultDropShadowEffect}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000">
                <!-- Template :  v3 05.15.13 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="0"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.833" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[3].(TranslateTransform.X)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="144"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="144"/>
                    <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:1" Value="0" KeySpline="0,0,0.3,1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline>
            <!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionIn : v3 05.15.13 -->

            <!--
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_MenuFiller">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0.001"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Menu">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Canvas_Content">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000">
                <!-- Template : v3 05.15.13 -->
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.567" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="HelpPanel">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.1" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline>
            <!-- TimelineTemplate_Fullscreen_TransitionOut : v3 05.15.13 -->

            <!--
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TransformGroup.Children)[0].(ScaleTransform.ScaleX)" Storyboard.TargetName="Rectangle_MenuFiller">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="1"/>
                <SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0.001" KeySpline="0,0,0,1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Menu">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Canvas_Content">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

        <!-- Storyboards for controlling color of the Hud Tire Heat Indicators -->
        <!-- Front Left Tire -->
        <Storyboard x:Key="TireHeatFLLStory">
            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="LeftFrontTireLeft">
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.000" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.485" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.514" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentColdTireColor}"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.515" Value="Transparent"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.735" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentYellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.765" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.870" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:1.000" Value="{DynamicResource RedTireColor}"/>
            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TireHeatFLRStory">
            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="LeftFrontTireRight">
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.000" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.485" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.514" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentColdTireColor}"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.515" Value="Transparent"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.735" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentYellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.765" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.870" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:1.000" Value="{DynamicResource RedTireColor}"/>
            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TireHeatFLMStory">
            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="LeftFrontTireMid">
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.000" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.485" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.514" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentColdTireColor}"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.515" Value="Transparent"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.735" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentYellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.765" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.870" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:1.000" Value="{DynamicResource RedTireColor}"/>
            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

        <!-- Front Right Tire -->
        <Storyboard x:Key="TireHeatFRLStory">
            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="RightFrontTireLeft">
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.000" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.485" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.514" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentColdTireColor}"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.515" Value="Transparent"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.735" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentYellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.765" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.870" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:1.000" Value="{DynamicResource RedTireColor}"/>
            </ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TireHeatFRRStory">
            <ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(Shape.Fill).(SolidColorBrush.Color)" Storyboard.TargetName="RightFrontTireRight">
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.000" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.485" Value="{DynamicResource ColdTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.514" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentColdTireColor}"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.515" Value="Transparent"/>
                <DiscreteColorKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.735" Value="{DynamicResource TransparentYellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.765" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:0.870" Value="{DynamicResource YellowTireColor}"/>
                <EasingColorKeyFrame   KeyTime="0:0:1.000" Value="{DynamicResource RedTireColor}"/>

<Page
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    xmlns:System="clr-namespace:System;assembly=mscorlib"
    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ForzaUI" 
    xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
    mc:Ignorable="d" 
    x:Class="ForzaUI.F999_ControllerPairing"
    x:Name="Page"
    WindowTitle="Page"
    FlowDirection="LeftToRight"
    Width="{StaticResource FullSceneWidth}" Height="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}"
    WindowWidth="{StaticResource MaxSceneWidth}" WindowHeight="{StaticResource MaxSceneHeight}"
    DataContext="{Binding RelativeSource={x:Static RelativeSource.Self}}">

    <Page.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="PopupMenuConditionalGridStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource DialogMessagePanelStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Grid}">
            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>

            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="{x:Null}">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="Tag" Value="">
                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionIn">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"><!-- Template :  v2 05.27.13 -->
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_GlassBg">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionIn_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.417" Value="0"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.584" Value="1"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline><!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionIn : v1 05.07.13 -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.667" Value="1"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard> <!-- TransitionIn -->

        <Storyboard x:Key="TransitionOut">
            <ParallelTimeline x:Name="TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut" BeginTime="0:0:0.000"><!-- Template :  v2 05.27.13 -->
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Header">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_Footer">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(local:EventFire.EventName)" Storyboard.TargetName="EventFire_GlassBg">
                    <DiscreteStringKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource BeginTransitionKeyTime}" Value="TransitionOut_Start"/>
                </StringAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="Grid_MessageContainer">
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                    <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.167" Value="0"/>
                </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
            </ParallelTimeline><!-- TimelineTemplate_MessageBox_TransitionOut : v1 05.07.13 -->
            <DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.Opacity)" Storyboard.TargetName="LayoutRoot">
                <EasingDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="1"/>
                <DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="0:0:0.333" Value="0"/>
            </DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
        </Storyboard>
    </Page.Resources>


    <local:ZPanel x:Name="LayoutRoot" Style="{StaticResource FullScreenZPanelStyle}">
        <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxGlassBgContentControlStyle}">
             <ContentControl x:Name="ContentControl_ModalBoxBg" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxBgContentControlStyle}">
                <Grid x:Name="Grid_DialogBoxContainer" Style="{StaticResource DialogMessagePanelStyle}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- header -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- message -->
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><!-- listbox -->
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    
                    <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Header" Content="{Binding Title}" Style="{StaticResource DialogHeaderStyle}"/>
                
                    <Grid x:Name="Grid_MessageContainer" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource PopupMenuConditionalGridStyle}" Tag="{Binding Message}">
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TextBlock_Message" Text="{Binding Message}" Style="{StaticResource InfoPanelDescriptionLightTextBlockStyle}" Margin="30,0,30,0"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </ContentControl>
        </ContentControl>

         <Grid x:Name="Grid_Footer" Style="{StaticResource FooterGridStyle}">
            <ContentControl x:Name="Control_Footer" Style="{StaticResource ModalBoxFooterContentControlStyle}">
                <local:ControllerButtonPanel x:Name="HelpPanel" Style="{StaticResource HelpBarControllerButtonPanelStyle}">
                    <local:ControllerButtonControl Button="A" Description="{local:Loc MainMenu.IDS_Controller_Play}"/>
                </local:ControllerButtonPanel>
            </ContentControl>
        </Grid>

        <!-- #################### EventFires #################### -->
        <!-- Start Storyboard -->
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_GlassBg" TargetName="ContentControl_ModalBoxGlassBg"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Header" TargetName="Control_Header"/>
        <local:EventFire x:Name="EventFire_Footer" TargetName="Control_Footer"/>
    </local:ZPanel>
</Page>
